Name: AutoTranslate
Summary: AutoTranslate automatically translates multiplayer chat messages in Casualties Unknown. No more language barriers—just seamless communication.
Description:
[b][size=5]AutoTranslate – Automatic Multiplayer Chat Translation / 自动多人联机聊天翻译[/size][/b]

[size=4]A simple mod that removes language barriers in [i]Casualties Together[/i]. Whether you're coordinating with teammates or chatting with strangers, AutoTranslate ensures everyone understands each other.[/size]
[size=4]
一个简洁的模组，为你消除《Casualties:Unknown》多人联机中的语言隔阂。无论是与队友配合，还是与陌生人交流，AutoTranslate 都能确保彼此理解。 [/size]

[size=4][b]Description / 模组说明[/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]AutoTranslate[/b] intercepts your outgoing and incoming chat messages, automatically translating them between supported languages. It integrates directly into the game’s own settings menu. Just set your preferred languages once and forget about it. The mod works silently in the background, translating messages in real time with minimal delay.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]The translation engine defaults to [b]MyMemory[/b], a free public service that works reliably for most common languages. For advanced users, the mod also offers alternative back‑end engines (Google, Lingva, SimplyTranslate) and even allows you to [b]plug in your own custom API endpoint[/b] (LibreTranslate‑compatible). This gives you full control over translation quality, privacy, and uptime.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]本模组[/b]会拦截你发送和接收的聊天消息，自动在支持的语言之间进行翻译。它直接融入游戏原有的设置菜单。只需一次设定好你偏好的语言，之后便可安心使用。模组在后台运行，实时翻译消息，延迟极低。 [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
翻译引擎默认使用 [b]MyMemory[/b] ——一个免费公共服务，对大多数常用语言都稳定可靠。对于进阶用户，模组还提供了备选[/color][color=#d4d4d8]后端引擎（Google、Lingva、SimplyTranslate），甚至允许你[/color][b][color=#d4d4d8]接入自定义 API 地址[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]（兼容 LibreTranslate 协议）。这让你能够完全掌控翻译质量、隐私和服务可用性。[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions / 安装说明[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Ensure you have [b]BepInEx 5.4.21+[/b] installed for the game.[/*]
[*]Install the required dependencies (see [i]Requirements[/i] below).[/*]
[*]Drop
[code]AutoTranslate.dll[/code] into
[code]BepInEx/plugins/[/code][/*]
[*]Launch the game. The mod will generate a configuration file at 
[code]BepInEx/config/AutoTranslate.cfg[/code][/*]
[*]Adjust settings either from the in‑game options menu (under [i]Game[/i] category) or by editing the config file directly.

确保你已为游戏安装 BepInEx 5.4.21 或更高版本。安装所需的前置模组（见下文-前置要求）。将本模组的dll文件放入模组文件夹。启动游戏。模组会在以上目录生成配置文件。你既可以从游戏内设置菜单调整选项，也可以直接编辑配置文件。[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features / 主要功能[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Outgoing translation[/b] – your messages are translated into your chosen target language before being sent to others.[/*]
[*][b]Incoming translation[/b] – messages from other players appear in your preferred language, with an optional  [b][original text]  [/b]suffix for clarity.[/*]
[*][b]Fully integrated into the game’s settings menu[/b] – all core options (enable/disable, outgoing language, incoming language, show original, auto‑match, hotkey) are available right where you’d expect them, with no extra UI clutter.[/*]
[*][b]23 supported languages[/b] – English, Chinese, Russian, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Polish, Ukrainian, Turkish, Arabic, Dutch, Czech, Swedish, Finnish, Hungarian, Romanian, Greek, Vietnamese, Indonesian.[/*]
[*][b]Smart auto‑match[/b] – automatically sets your outgoing language to match the language of the first message you receive in a session (optional, one‑time per session).[/*]
[*][b]Hotkey toggle[/b] – press [b][backslash][/b] to enable or disable translation on the fly. Fully rebindable from the settings menu.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Customisable translation engine[/b] – choose between Auto (fallback chain), MyMemory, Google, Lingva, or SimplyTranslate.[/*]
[*][b]Custom API endpoint support[/b] – advanced users can supply their own LibreTranslate‑compatible server URL, giving full control over translation quality and privacy.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]发送翻译[/b] – 你发送的消息会在发出前被翻译为你设定的目标语言。[/*]
[*][b]接收翻译[/b] – 其他玩家发送的消息会显示为你偏好的语言，并可选择在翻译后附加[b] [原文][/b] 以便核对。[/*]

[*][b]支持 23 种语言[/b] – 英语、中文、俄语、日语、韩语、法语、德语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、意大利语、波兰语、乌克兰语、土耳其语、阿拉伯语、荷兰语、捷克语、瑞典语、芬兰语、匈牙利语、罗马尼亚语、希腊语、越南语、印度尼西亚语。[/*]

[*][b]快捷键开关[/b] – 按下 [b][反斜杠] [/b]键即可随时开启或关闭翻译功能，并可在设置菜单中自由更改键位。[/*]
[*][b]可配置翻译引擎[/b] – 可在 Auto（自动回退链）、MyMemory、Google、Lingva 或 SimplyTranslate 之间选择。[/*]
[*][b]自定义 API 支持[/b] – 高级用户可填写个人 LibreTranslate 兼容服务器地址，全面掌控翻译质量和隐私。[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements / 前置要求[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx][b]BepInEx 5.4.21+[/b][/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/casualtiesunknown/mods/1][b]KrokoshaCasualtiesMP[/b][/url] – the multiplayer framework for [i]Casualties Unknown[/i].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/casualtiesunknown/mods/?][b]CUCoreLib[/b][/url] – provides the settings menu integration and other core utilities.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]All dependencies are available on Nexus Mods. Please install them before using AutoTranslate.
所有前置模组均可在 Nexus Mods 找到。请在使用 AutoTranslate 前先安装它们。[/color]
[heading][size=4][b]Working Principle / 工作原理[/b][/size][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]AutoTranslate stores all user preferences in [/color][color=#d4d4d8]BepInEx/config/AutoTranslate.cfg[/color][color=#D4D4D8], a plain‑text INI file. The mod reads this file on startup and writes changes back whenever you adjust settings via the in‑game menu or the hotkey.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]The actual translation is performed by one of the configured back‑end services. By default, the mod uses a fallback chain (MyMemory → Google → Lingva → SimplyTranslate) to maximise reliability. If you provide a [b]custom API URL[/b], the mod uses that endpoint exclusively – perfect for self‑hosted LibreTranslate instances or private translation services. This design ensures both simplicity for everyday users and flexibility for power users.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]本模组将所有用户偏好存储在 BepInEx/config/AutoTranslate.cfg中，这是一个纯文本 INI 文件。模组在启动时读取该文件，并在你通过游戏内菜单或快捷键调整设置时立即将改动写回。[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
实际翻译由配置的后端服务执行。默认情况下，模组使用回退链（MyMemory → Google → Lingva → SimplyTranslate）以最大程度保证可用性。如果你提供了[b]自定义 API 地址[/b]，模组将只使用该端点——非常适合自建 LibreTranslate 服务或私有翻译服务。这样的设计既保证了普通用户的简单易用，也为进阶用户提供了充分灵活性。[/color]

[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]CUCoreLib[/b] – for the excellent settings API and utilities that made seamless in‑game menu integration a breeze.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]The open‑source translation community[/b] – for maintaining free and accessible translation services like MyMemory, Lingva, and SimplyTranslate.[/color][/*]
[/list]Thanks for downloading!
Enjoy seamless communication across languages – and happy surviving!

Name: DisableDecay
Summary: Disable decay depending on item decay type.
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Github: [url=https://github.com/MCPO-Spartan-117/CU-DisableDecay]https://github.com/MCPO-Spartan-117/CU-DisableDecay[/url]

I've found that putting the decay modifier to zero disables the regen of the spacedrain and icepack, so i've made a mod that disables decay via transpilers in `Item::HandleDecay`, has 4 options,[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Container: Items in container decay types do not decay the container.
Wearables: Wear decay types don't decay.
Moving: Moving decay types don't decay, pretty much every item that decays.

Don't forget to press the apply button when changing this mod's settings.[/color]

Name: Multiplayer Cross-Session Inventory Patch
Summary: Fixes an issue where leaving a lobby and rejoining after the host has transitioned layers / reboots from menu wipes your inventory. Does not transfer inventories between different saves, but *should* work if you use a save manager mod.
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Fixes an issue where leaving a lobby and rejoining after the host has transitioned layers / reboots from menu wipes your inventory.
This allows people to leave and come back without wiping their inventory, as long as it's the same save file.

Tracks:
- Inventory contents
- Wearables and their contents
- Neural boosted state, and how many you've taken
- Disfigurements (sorry, rejoining won't fix you)
- Stat XP (str/res/int)

Does not transfer inventories between different saves, but *should* work if you use a save manager mod, since files are stored in the mod folder under a save id.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]

Name: Multiplayer Optimization Patch
Summary: Removes most instances of the MP issue where regular frame drops / lag spikes will occur, and improves desync issues considerably. Requires: KrokMP (Casualties Together)
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Removes most instances of the MP issue where regular frame drops / lag spikes will occur, and improves desync issues considerably. [/color]
Technical explanation below.

This mod took about a month of pain and suffering. Enjoy.

[size=4][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Simply drop into your plugins folder like any other mod.[/color][/size]
Requires: KrokMP (Casualties Together)


[size=4][b]KrokMP's Design Flaw[/b][/size]
(Tldr at bottom)
KrokMP causes frame drops after a certain amount of time, for one primary reason.

The UDP structure, and it's not UDP friendly queue system.

In the simplest terms, KrokMP uses a method in which it shotgun blasts "sync packets" across the internet. (UDP)
Not all of them are guaranteed to come back.

From a game sync perspective between host and players, this is tolerable. The game gathers information to sync in one primary loop.

`FastSync` - which queues up certain group of high priority targets, at a rate of **25** scans / second, **per player**.
This is a spatial scan near each player, at 70m.

`ObjectSync` - which sends gathered spatial data packets at 8 sends per second.

(There are other syncing loops that go on, but the primary offender this patch focuses on is the spatial data loop.)
As you can see above, it can gather information drastically faster than it can remove it.

Now, "ObjectSync" has the potential in it's code to scale up to 50 sends per second, depending on load - fixing that balance - but it's not doing that in practice. Why?


"Queue pinning". In other words, due to the flaw with UDP that I mentioned before, where some packets simply never come back - the ObjectSync queue indefinitely holds a slot in the queue for those "missing" packets, waiting for a response.
This clogs the queue, stops it from draining, and causes frame drops at regular intervals, generally coinciding with the Unity/Mono memory garbage collector.

--
TLDR:
In simpler terms, the multiplayer spatial data queue is programmed to retain a slot for each send until it hears a response for every packet (called syn/ack), but due to the UDP design of the system, it slows itself down waiting for responses that will never come.
Eventually, the queue gets filled with dead requests.

[Quickly gather data to send] -> [send and don't clear from queue until response received] -> [response never received] -> [slot in queue stuck, causing lag]

When the queue fills up, it drops half of the requests as an emergency measure, but since that doesn't solve the problem, it just causes more desync - another common complaint in the game.
Primarily, though, it causes the Unity garbage memory collector to cause a big spike in frame time (what controls your fps), every couple seconds.. Hence, the frame drops we pretty much all experience.[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Describe the core features of your mod[/color][/size]

Name: Warm Boot (Modding utility)
Summary: Loads the game directly into the sandbox or a preconfigured run setting, skipping intro and menus. Optionally runs console commands right after load.
Description:
[size=6][b]Warm Boot[/b][/size]

Skips the main menu on launch and starts the game directly into the sandbox, or a run built from a preset settings. It can also run a list of console commands as soon as the world is ready.

It was written for modding, where getting to a testable situation means four screens and two fades on every rebuild. It works just as well if you always play the same custom setup and would rather not pick it again each time.

[size=5][b]What it does[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Boots into a tutorial course, or into a full run[/*]
[*]Builds that run from a preset plus any of the settings on the game's custom screen[/*]
[*]Runs console commands once the world is up[/*]
[*]Takes its settings from environment variables, for scripts and Steam launch options[/*]
[*]Hold Shift at launch for the normal menu; press F10 to boot when the mod is off[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Config[/b][/size]
[code][General]
Mode = Run
# Or, to load tutorial course:
Mode = Course

[Run]
Preset = desolate
Settings = timelimit=300, ambientlight=bright, unchipped=true, oreamount=2

[Course]
Course = Sandbox[/code]
[b]Preset[/b] is the same list the menu offers: normal, relaxed, paradise, desolate, unchipped. [b]Settings[/b] applies on top and reaches every value on the custom screen, from loot density to bleed rate to temperature offset. Values outside a slider's range are clamped and unknown names are skipped, with a line in the log either way.

[b]Settings[/b] also accepts a share code. Set a run up in the menu, press its copy button, and paste the result into the config.

[size=5][b]Commands on load[/b][/size]

[code]
[Commands]
Commands = heal; spawn bandage; setbodyfield hunger 20
Delay = 0.5[/code]
The same commands and separator the in-game console uses. They run once the world exists, generation has finished and your expie is in it, plus [b]Delay[/b] seconds for anything that wants the UI settled. A mistyped command complains in the console as it normally would.

They run on every world that loads, including runs you start by hand. [b]warmboot exec[/b] tries a string without relaunching.

[size=5][b]Environment variables[/b][/size]

Any setting can be given for a single launch, without editing the config. In Steam, put it in front of [b]%command%[/b] in the launch options.

[code]
WARMBOOT_MODE=run WARMBOOT_PRESET=desolate \
WARMBOOT_SETTINGS="timelimit=300,ambientlight=bright" \
WARMBOOT_COMMANDS="heal; spawn bandage"[/code]
[list]
[*][b]WARMBOOT[/b]: on or off, overriding the config[/*]
[*][b]WARMBOOT_MODE[/b]: course or run[/*]
[*][b]WARMBOOT_COURSE[/b], [b]WARMBOOT_PRESET[/b]: a course or preset name[/*]
[*][b]WARMBOOT_SETTINGS[/b]: name=value list, or a share code[/*]
[*][b]WARMBOOT_COMMANDS[/b], [b]WARMBOOT_DELAY[/b]: what to run on load, and when[/*]
[*][b]WARMBOOT_KEY[/b], [b]WARMBOOT_FADE[/b]: the activation key, and the fade out of the menu[/*]
[/list]
Setting a preset or settings implies run mode, and setting a course implies course mode. Nothing is written back to the config file.

[size=5][b]Shift and F10[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Hold Shift while the game starts to stay in the menu for that launch.[/*]
[*]Press F10 while the game is loading, or any time the menu is up, to boot even with the mod switched off.[/*]
[*]Quitting a run leaves you in the menu. The automatic skip runs once per launch, so quitting does not bounce you straight back in. Press F10 to go again.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Console[/b][/size]

Everything is also reachable from the game's console. Changes take effect at the next launch.

[code]warmboot info                    what this launch was told to do, and what it did
warmboot off                     stop skipping the menu
warmboot mode run                boot into a run instead of a course
warmboot preset desolate         which preset a run starts from
warmboot set timelimit 300       one custom setting (no value clears it)
warmboot settings                what a run booted now would get, vs a normal run
warmboot commands heal; spawn bandage    what to run on load
warmboot exec spawn bandage      run that now, without relaunching
warmboot boot                    leave the menu now[/code]
[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases]BepInEx 5[/url].[/*]
[*]Extract the archive into [i]BepInEx/plugins/[/i], so the DLL lands at [i]BepInEx/plugins/WarmBoot.dll[/i].[/*]
[*]Run the game once to write the config at [i]BepInEx/config/dev.asserto.warmboot.cfg[/i].[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Limits[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]It cannot skip the Unity splash. That is a build setting in the executable.[/*]
[*]It does not unlock courses. First aid and crafting stay gated on how deep you have been, and it says so rather than doing nothing.[/*]
[*]It does skip the "do the tutorial first" prompt when starting a run. The run itself is unchanged.[/*]
[*]It only answers a course select it opened itself. Reach the tutorial by hand and the mod stays out of it.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer is untested.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

Built against Demo v7.0.1 (Unity 2022.3.62f3) and BepInEx 5.4.23.x. No dependencies; CUCoreLib is not required. It calls the menu's own start methods, the course select's own start call and the console's own command runner, so no game state is faked.

[size=5][b]Bugs and suggestions[/b][/size]

Please include [b]BepInEx/LogOutput.log[/b]. The mod logs what it was asked to do, what it built and what it ran, on every launch. [b]warmboot info[/b] prints the same in the console.

Name: Type 1 Diabetes
Summary: Makes the experiment type 1 diabetic. You will have to manage your blood glucose and ketones with insulin therapy.
Description:
[size=6][b]Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) or: Casualties: Your Pancreas[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Disclaimer[/b][/size]
The mechanics of this mod are not fully realistic. Liberties have been taken to make the gameplay simpler and make it easier for the player to treat themselves without help.
[b]Do not[/b] use any techniques from the mod on a real person with diabetes if you are not knowledgable about the treatment of diabetes in real life.

Diabetic people can normally take care of themselves, but if they are very confused, unresponsive, or unconscious, they need help: call your country's emergency number immediately and follow their directions.
Don't wait. Do not give them [b]any[/b] medication, [b]especially not insulin[/b], unless the dispatcher tells you to. Do not feed them anything if they're not alert enough to eat on their own.
They may carry a glucagon spray or injection for hypoglycemia; the dispatcher will tell you how and when to use it.

[size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size]

T1D adds a new persistent threat to the player: your blood sugar level, which is constantly rising and must be kept down with insulin. The consumption of carbohydrates will rise it further, requiring you to use
more of your limited supply to compensate for having tasty food. High blood sugar will dehydrate you and slow wound healing.
If you're without insulin for too long, ketone bodies will build up and begin to [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diabetic_ketoacidosis]make your blood more acidic[/url], with terrible consequences for your body.
But if you're not careful and take too much, your blood sugar can drop too low, leaving your cells without energy. That can go very wrong, very quickly...

This mod adds:
[list]
[*]A detailed simulation of type 1 diabetes mellitus, including the effects of low and high blood sugar and ketoacidosis, as well as the mechanics of insulin and glucagon[/*]
[*]8 new items and 4 liquids for the management of diabetes, including craftable insulin and medical devices[/*]
[*]5 custom run settings, complete with default values for the base presets[/*]
[*]Difficulty! Living with diabetes is hard and you'll have to learn the mechanics of this mod from the ground up. Failure to engage with the mechanics correctly will result in a quick death.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Author's note[/b][/size]

I really like how this game conveys the feeling of being in dire straits: starving, thirsty, bleeding out, desperately trying to hold on long enough to fix what's wrong. I also like how, while simplified,
it can serve as a platform to teach people a bit about the biology of the human body. I hope this mod can convey some of what it feels like to have type 1 diabetes. The constant management of your blood sugar,
the consequences to your health and mood when you get it wrong, the effects of hypoglycemia and ketoacidosis, and the amount that insulin pumps and continuous glucose monitors can help. I've experienced all of it
and more.

This mod shows a breadth of ways to manage T1D, all of which are based on real life. People use all of these methods, often solely due to cost. Pens that let you precisely control your dose are more expensive
than a syringe. A pump is more expensive still, both to get the gadget itself and to afford all the consumables you need in perpetuity. Getting it to track your glucose constantly and adjust accordingly is yet
more money for a fancier pump and even more consumables. Many people can't access insulin itself, let alone all these bells and whistles.

Thousands of people die of type 1 diabetes every year. Many of these deaths are preventable: they die because they can't afford insulin or because their country lacks the infrastructure to care for them.
Some die of diabetes before even being diagnosed. Everything that happens to you in this mod is happening to hundreds of people worldwide at the same time. I'm very lucky to have the resources I have to treat
my disease, and it's still difficult for me. Many people aren't nearly as lucky as me.

[size=4][b]On the implementation[/b][/size]

I had to take some liberties to turn this real disease into a game, as you do. Here are some notes on that for the benefit of fellow T1s who find it interesting:
[list]
[*]Insulin is 200x less effective. 1ml would normally be 100 units; I've made it more like 0.5 units. Syringes are normally 100ml, and as the game rounds liquids to the nearest millilitre, potency has to be turned down or managing the insulin you have would get really annoying. Doses are 2ml so that insulin pens aren't overpowered for injecting pure fentanyl. You don't get many units at a time in a cartridge to keep it as a scarce resource.[/*]
[*]ICR and ISF are fixed and configurable as run settings (10 and 2.0 by default), though I do like the idea of them being a bit random so you have to get a feel for it while playing each run! Might come back to that...[/*]
[*]Basal needs are basically completely flat (glycogenolysis/gluconeogenesis occur at a constant rate), though insulin sensitivity does change according to bodily state (e.g. more effective with exercise, less when sick).[/*]
[*]I worried this might make management too simple but it still felt pretty tricky and familiar to me. I'm pretty happy with the balance of how it feels to go low, go high, and control BG over time. It might be on the micro-managey side for a game, but if someone complains I can always go "now try being me and having to do it all the time"...[/*]
[*]Metformin is included although it's normally a T2 medication. It actually works for us too! It isn't normally given because we don't have as big of an issue with insulin resistance, but it has been shown to reduce insulin requirements in T1.[/*]
[*]Metformin overdose gives you ketones. This isn't correct (it should be lactic acid) but as they're both acids and the only treatment for acidosis in this mod is to wait for it to clear, I figured it doesn't really matter what kind of acid it is.[/*]
[*]Most item sprites are based directly on real products I've used. Recognize any of them?[/*]
[*]The experiment is in the early stages of the disease and still has some pancreatic function (a bit of insulin/glucagon production). I took this liberty to make it easier to control levels thanks to a slight push[/*]
[/list]  toward the 4.0-6.0 mark. It also serves as an abstraction of other factors that affect blood glucose and makes the glucose level "bounce around" a bit, so it's harder to predict and doesn't seem completely linear.
[list]
[*]Ketone levels and blood acidity are conflated for simplicity. In reality, ketones alone don't necessarily cause acidosis if there is sufficient bicarbonate to keep the pH stable. (That's the difference between DKA and a keto diet.) Experiments are also a little more sensitive to acidosis, so 5.0 mmol/l is nigh-unsurvivable for them, though humans have survived levels well beyond that.[/*]
[*]Related to the above point, ketones' role as an alternative energy source is entirely missing, making them purely negative. Maybe a mutation along the line in the Experiments' creation rendered them unable to utilize them?[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

The conviction with which I guarantee compatibility depends on the kind of mod:
[list]
[*]Multiplayer is supported in v4.0.1 of Casualties: Together. It will break soon when v5 comes out, but I intend to eventually support that version as well. I take responsibility for how this mod works with multiplayer and will try to support it as best as I can. Please report any issues with it to me.[/*]
[*]The mod [i]should[/i] work fine with unrelated mods that don't affect the health panel. Let me know if there's a conflict: I'll take a look and might fix it (especially if it's my fault). No guarantees.[/*]
[*]Conflicts are likely to occur with other mods that add information to the health panel or change how it looks, because this mod adds info to it. Don't bother reporting this unless you're the author of the mod and want to help improve support. I'm very unlikely to fix these issues.[/*]
[*]Note for later: integration with Casualty Vitals to make insulin lower potassium would be funny...[/*]
[/list]

Description:
[b][size=6]Description[/size][/b]

Differentiating Traits lets you shape your survivor before each run by selecting a set of positive and negative traits in a custom in-game panel.
差异特质让你在每局游戏开始前，通过游戏内的自定义面板选择一组正面与负面特质，塑造你的实验体。
Spend points on advantages like Agility, Sturdy Body, Iron Will, or Regeneration, and take flaws like Hemophobia, Hearing Loss, Addiction, or missing limbs to earn more points.
花费特质点选择敏捷、健硕、意志坚定、自愈等优势，也可以选择恐血症、听力障碍、成瘾者、肢体缺失等缺陷来获得更多点数。
Your choices directly affect your body, skills, mood, metabolism, immunity, and survival — every advantage has a cost.
你的选择会直接影响身体、技能、心情、新陈代谢、免疫力和生存能力——每一项优势都有代价。
All traits are managed through an original-style UI that fits the game's atmosphere and supports both Chinese and English.
所有特质都通过一个贴合游戏氛围的原版风格界面进行管理，并支持中文与英文。

下载 CUCoreLib，并将 CUCoreLib.dll 放入 BepInEx/plugins 文件夹。[/*]

下载差异特质，并将包含 DifferentiatingTraits.dll 的 mod 文件夹放入 BepInEx/plugins。[/*]

启动游戏。在主菜单点击左上角的“配置特质”按钮即可打开特质面板。[/*]
[*]Choose your traits, save your preset, and start a new run. Your selected traits will be applied to the new character.
选择特质，保存预设，然后开始新的一局。你所选择的特质会应用到新角色身上。[/*]

Description:
[b][size=5]GlassM — Streaming Generation Performance Mod for Casualties Unknown[/size][/b]

[line]

This project replaces the vanilla "full-layer generation" with [u]player-centered streaming chunk generation[/u], drastically reducing generation overhead and physics costs.

[line]

[b][size=4]Benchmark Results[/size][/b]

[b]FPS Performance:[/b]

[td]Unknown [/td]
[td][b]< 1 sec[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][line]

[b][size=4]Core Features[/size][/b]

[list]
Streaming World Generation: Chunks are generated/unloaded on demand based on the player(s) (including all players in multiplayer). Eliminates the full-layer load, resulting in faster entry and smoother gameplay.[/list][list]
Pre-filled Terrain Data & Streaming Rendering: The entire layer's terrain data is pre-filled at load time (a pure array, extremely low overhead). Chunks are then generated/unloaded on demand.[/list][list]
Dynamic Physics Zone: Colliders and rigidbody simulations are dynamically disabled for distant chunks. The rigidbody load is significantly reduced from vanilla's 256 blocks.[/list][list]
Vanilla-Aligned Ore Generation: We use Reflection to invoke the vanilla GenerateOres method. Distribution aligns with vanilla, and mods that patch these ore spawners remain fully compatible.[/list][list]
Precise Spawn-in: The spawn void is synchronized, and the PlaceBody collision scan lands correctly (Depth 0~15m). Only a 2×2 chunk generation is required for initial spawn.[/list][list]
Infinite Rock Protection: Streaming generation will not break the boundary Infinite Rock (ID 14).[/list][list]
Vanilla-Aligned Entities: Thornbacks, stalactites, turret placement parameters and coordinates have been meticulously checked against the vanilla decompiled source. Active creature alert ranges are restored to vanilla levels.[/list][list]
PerfDiag Built-in Diagnostics: Outputs system timings (WG/Fluid/Rigidbody), FPS, and scene load metrics every 5 seconds.[/list][list]
Multiplayer Compatibility: Compatible with KrokoshaCasualtiesMP. Chunks load/unload around all players. Client players will no longer fall through the world when the host unloads chunks.[/list][list]
Structural Fixes: Rendering and collision for large structures across chunk boundaries are now correctly synchronized.[/list][line]

Name: Analog Expie - Controller and Rumble
Summary: A gamepad control scheme that feels like it's always been there, with rumble that makes you feel every fall, every trap, every heartbeat.
Description:
Adds controller support to nearly every part of the game: movement, cursor, inventory, wound view, crafting and minigames. Actions (and consequences) come back as rumble, so you can feel exactly what you're putting your poor expies through.

[size=5][b]New in 1.1.0[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]The trader screen is navigable[/b] with the stick, and the list scrolls itself to keep up.[/*]
[*][b]The whole inventory takes stick navigation[/b], not only an open container, and lock-on reaches past it to the world behind.[/*]
[*][b]The lockpick reads the trigger as pressure.[/b] Ease into it to feel where it binds, force it and you get hurt faster. [b]A[/b] still turns it the old way.[/*]
[*][b]Aim mode draws its own dot[/b] rather than leaving the mouse pointer on screen.[/*]
[*][b]On-screen hints hide themselves[/b] the moment you touch the mouse.[/*]
[*]And a pile of fixes, including one that stopped a world item going into an inventory slot at all.[/*]
[/list]
The full list is on the Changelogs tab.

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Gamepad input[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Any XInput-compatible controller, auto-detected.[/*]
[*]Two control modes: [b]direct aiming[/b] and [b]cursor control[/b], toggled by clicking the right stick (R3)[/*]
[*][b]Lock-on[/b] to nearby items and objects, so interacting doesn't need precise stick work[/*]
[*][b]Quick slot access:[/b] Each inventory slot has its own button, labelled in game[/*]
[*]Gun handling on the d-pad: rack, eject, safety[/*]
[*]Custom bindings for the inventory, crafting menu, health panel and every minigame[/*]
[*]Smooth analog movement[/*]
[*]In-game button prompts, so you don't have to memorise (much)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Rumble[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Feel every fall, every injury[/*]
[*]Fully configurable; turn it down, or off, if you hate it[/*]
[*]Contextual, hand-tuned motor feedback for pain, gunfire, earthquakes, traps, explosions, screen shake, minigames, your own heartbeat, medical procedures, and plenty more[/*]
[*][i]Warning: eats batteries (if you're not careful...)[/i][/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Control scheme[/b][/size]

The left stick moves and the right stick aims, either as a cursor, or as a heading held out from your body. Click the right stick to switch between them.

In aim mode the mouse pointer is hidden and the mod draws a small dot instead. The pointer comes back for cursor mode, panels and minigames.

The [b]right trigger[/b] attacks and uses whatever is in your hand. The [b]left trigger[/b] interacts and picks things up, mirroring the mouse buttons it replaces.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/578/578-1787320800-334408688.png[/img]



Note that with a gun equipped, the d-pad becomes gun handling instead of speed control.

[size=4][b]Lock-on[/b][/size]

Holding the left trigger [b]half pulled[/b] locks onto the nearest thing you could actually interact with, and marks it on screen. Flick the right stick to cycle between targets.

Let go without committing and the lock [b]stays [/b]until you point at something else. Pull the trigger [b]all the way[/b] to grab, use or interact.

[size=4][b]Inventory[/b][/size]

Tap [b]X[/b] to toggle the inventory. [b]Hold[/b] X and it behaves like a proper radial menu: the left stick picks whichever slot lies at that angle, and letting go closes it.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/578/578-1787320806-1215681805.png[/img]


[list]
[*][b]A[/b] takes what's in a slot, or puts down what you're carrying[/*]
[*][b]B[/b] cancels; the item goes back where it came from, and the panel stays open[/*]
[*][b]Y[/b] uses or wears whatever you're holding[/*]
[*][b]L3[/b] drops it, [b]R3[/b] favourites the slot under the cursor[/*]
[*]Tapping [b]A[/b] on a container opens it; [b]holding[/b] A picks it up to move instead[/*]
[*]Hold [b]RT[/b] while placing one container onto another to transfer the contents across[/*]
[/list]
The left stick moves between slots while the inventory is open, so walking is
suspended until you close it. With a container open it reaches the contents
too, and opening one puts the cursor on the first thing inside. [b]B[/b] closes it.

[b]LT[/b] still locks on from in here, reaching past the inventory to the world
behind it. Point at a slot with something in it and it picks that up instead.

[size=4][b]Quick slots[/b][/size]

While the inventory or the health panel is open, the shoulder buttons and d-pad address body slots directly. Each slot is labelled in game with the button that reaches it:

[img width=399]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/578/578-1787079796-2099381403.png[/img]


Pressing a slot button picks up whatever is in that slot; or, if you're already carrying something, puts it there and swaps whatever was in the way.

So a transfer between any two slots is two presses. [b]LB[/b] then [b]D-pad down[/b] swaps your primary hand with your middle back.

[size=4][b]Health panel[/b][/size]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/578/578-1787320813-1648799476.png[/img]


The left stick moves between limbs, slots and the contextual action button. The cursor starts on the torso, so everything is within reach with a few flicks.

The quick slots are the fast path for what the panel is actually for: [b]RB[/b] to take the bandage out of your secondary hand, then [b]A[/b] on the limb to apply it. The cursor returns to the limb you were pointing at after it fetches from a slot, so the detour costs you nothing.

[b]L3[/b] toggles the armour view. [b]R3[/b] steps through the panel's buttons (sleep, workout, switch hands) and then back to the body. It only moves the cursor; you press [b]A[/b] yourself so you don't fall asleep by accident.

[size=4][b]Crafting[/b][/size]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/578/578-1787320821-690700340.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]D-pad up/down[/b] picks a recipe[/*]
[*][b]D-pad left/right[/b] changes category[/*]
[*][b]X[/b] crafts, [b]Y[/b] pins[/*]
[/list]
A long single column is the one panel a cursor is genuinely bad at, with no landmark to aim for and a list that reorders every time you craft. The search box still wants a keyboard.

[size=4][b]Minigames[/b][/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/578/578-1787320827-1299994238.png[/img]


Each minigame gets controls suited to what it actually asks of you. Most accept the right stick as an ordinary cursor and the left stick as a direct input: roll the left stick to wind a bandage around a limb, or point it at the angle you want to set the lockpick. [b]RT[/b] or [b]A[/b] grips and presses; [b]LT[/b] or [b]B[/b] leaves.

The lockpick reads the trigger as pressure rather than as a button. Ease into it and the pick stops where the lock stops it; lean on it and you get hurt faster than you would have. [b]A[/b] still turns it at the old fixed speed whenever you want that, and [b]Minigames.AnalogLockpick = false[/b] turns it off for good.

Pouring liquids gets its own dial: the left stick sets the amount, [b]A[/b] confirms.

[size=4][b]Trader[/b][/size]




The left stick moves between their list, the trader's buttons and your own slots. The list scrolls itself to keep up.

[list]
[*][b]A[/b] or [b]RT[/b] buys, talks, haggles, whatever is under the cursor[/*]
[*][b]Y[/b] hands what you're carrying to the trader[/*]
[*]The slot buttons work here too[/*]
[*][b]B[/b] closes[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Menus[/b][/size]

The left stick moves between controls, [b]A[/b] confirms, [b]B[/b] goes back. The main menu, tutorial selection, mode selection menu, and pause menu are all navigable without using the cursor.

[size=5][b]Also in there[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Mouse and keyboard keep working.[/b] Touch either one and the cursor hands itself straight back; touch the stick and the pad takes over again. Nothing stops you using both.[/*]
[*][b]Minigame instructions are rewritten for a pad[/b][/*]
[*][b]The button labels hide themselves[/b] when you use the mouse or keyboard, and come back when you pick the pad up[/*]
[*][b]The basic controls are visible in the pause menu[/b] (press [b]Back[/b] to hide/show)[/*]
[*][b]Ragdoll is a toggle[/b] (L3) rather than a hold.[/*]
[*][b]Throw won't fumble your gun.[/b] Short taps are ignored while a gun is in hand.[/*]
[*][b]Switch hands[/b] on B, [b]bark[/b] on d-pad down, [b]toggle item view[/b] (alt view) on Back, [b]game speed[/b] on d-pad left and right.[/*]
[*]Tapping [b]Back[/b] toggles item labels; [b]holding[/b] it also expands their descriptions.[/*]
[*]The locked item is highlighted in [b]alt view[/b] too, not just out in the world.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

Install [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases]BepInEx 5[/url] if you haven't already, then drop the .dll into [b]BepInEx/plugins/[/b]. That's it.

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

The config file appears at [b]BepInEx/config/com.asserto.gamepadsupport.cfg[/b] after you run the game once.

Every option is documented in the file itself. Anything still at its default is left [b]commented out[/b]. To change something, delete the [b]#[/b] at the start of the line and edit the value.

The file is re-read while the game is running, so you can tune deadzones, cursor speed and rumble strength without restarting.

[b]General.Hints = false[/b] turns off everything the mod writes on screen without changing what any button does.

[size=5][b]FAQ[/b][/size]

[b]Can I customise the controls?[/b]
Not yet. It's the top of the list for a future release.

[b]I hate rumble. Can I turn it off?[/b]
Yes. One line in the config, and it applies immediately. You can also turn off individual categories, or just scale the whole thing down.

[b]I hate [i]<some other feature>[/i]. Can I turn it off?[/b]
Probably. Aim mode, the aim dot, lock-on, the on-screen bracket, quick slots, stick navigation, crafting navigation, minigame controls, the button labels and the pause-menu card can all be switched off independently.

[b]The cursor drifts away from my mouse pointer.[/b]
Set [b]WarpHardwareCursor[/b] to false. The in-game cursor stays correct either way; that option only controls whether the actual Windows pointer is dragged along with it.

[b]Why did you build this?[/b]
They said it couldn't be done. They said C:U is impossible to play on a controller. Well... I don't know if I proved them wrong exactly, but at least I had some fun along the way!

[b]My controller doesn't work / I found a bug...[/b]
Please include:
[list]
[*]Your operating system[/*]
[*]Your display resolution [i]and[/i] the game's resolution, including any display scaling[/*]
[*]What controller you're using[/*]
[*]Your [b]BepInEx/LogOutput.txt[/b][/*]
[/list]The mod writes a short self-check to it at startup which usually identifies cursor problems on its own.

[b]I have a suggestion / request / feedback...[/b]
Feedback is welcome! Suggestions too but I can't promise they'll happen.

[size=5][b]Limitations and future work[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Tutorial messages still describe keyboard and mouse controls[/*]
[*]The crafting search box still wants a keyboard[/*]
[*]No rebinding, and no in-game config[/*]
[*]Only tested with one model of controller, so do let me know how yours gets on[/*]
[*]Many bugs a lurkin[/*]
[/list]
Hope you enjoy! <3


[b]Acknowledgements[/b]

The gamepad graphic is based on this free asset by xUMR: https://opengameart.org/content/controller-style-1

Name: Better Liquid Draining
Summary: Replaces the vanilla liquid draining to allow for completely accurate draining of containers based on several modes and inputs.
Description:
Disables the vanilla drain square and creates a UI when a liquid container is dragged to and released on it.
In the UI are options to choose how to drain from the given container, and a number input field. In addition there is a scrollable preview to show all liquids present in the container and how many will be left if the currently given settings were used to drain with.

3 Input variables are available:
[list]
[*]Mode[/*]
[*]Liquid (only available for certain modes)[/*]
[*]Value (the number to calculate from, allows decimals for some modes)[/*]
[/list]
Available modes:
[list]
[*]Drain mL: simply drain the given number of mLs.[/*]
[*]Drain %: drain a % of the containers capacity.  (example: draining 50% of a canteen will drain 150mL, as it can hold 300mL)[/*]
[*]Drain weight: drain an amount of weight in U, also accepts decimal places. (example: draining 2U from a water jug that weighs 5U, to end up with 3U) note: cannot be used for containers that do not change weight based on content, such as canteens.[/*]
[*]Drain liquid mL: drain a number of mLs from a selected liquid in the container. (example: draining 50mL of dirty water from a container with 200mL clean water and 100mL dirty water: resulting in 100mL clean and 50mL dirty water, or 150mL total drained)[/*]
[*]Drain to mL: drain until the given number of mL is left in the container.[/*]
[*]Drain to %: drain until the given % is left in the container.[/*]
[*]Drain to weight: drain until the given weight in U is left in the container, also accepts decimal places. note: cannot be used for containers that do not change weight based on content, such as canteens.[/*]
[*]Drain to liquid mL: you guessed it, drain until the given amount in mL is left of the selected liquid. (example: if you find a minibarrel full of random junk but also, say, braingrow, you can drain until there is 80mL of braingrow left and take the remaining for a future neural booster)[/*]
[/list]Simple controls, left click for most actions, right click to go backwards in the mode or liquid selections, and left click plus typing to enter a number.


A usage demonstration gif will be added later...


[size=4]Installation[/size]
[list]
[*]Download the file. (BetterLiquidDraining.zip)[/*]
[*]Extract into the BepInEx plugins folder. [/*]
[/list]The console will show if the mod is installed.


[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
Probably compatible with anything. If not, complain and I might fix it.
[color=#ffff00]Partial multiplayer compatibility: only functional for the host, when playing as a client the mod will deactivate itself. [/color]


This is by far my largest mod so far, and while I wasn't planning on making more mods I had this idea one day and decided to take it up as an opportunity to learn some basic UI modding. Indeed, this was mostly just a challenge I set for myself rather than actually a mod I would likely use myself unlike any of my other ones.


[size=4]Announcement and rant (feel free to ignore this part)[/size]
I have run out of mod ideas (for real this time), so I likely wont be making anything else, at least not until the game releases. I will still be maintaining the mods and improving them if I figure out any ways to do so.
If someone has a suggestion feel free to send it on one of my mods or message me about it or whatever, though I am only going to be taking ideas for quality of life mods like the ones I have already made (and I mean actual quality of life, not making the game easier)

(this genuinely will be my last mod until game releases)

Another thing, content mods. I will not be making any. For one: I don't have any interest in adding new stuff to the game, and for two: I acknowledge and respect Orsoniks's wish for modding to be kept to a minimum until the game is released.
Obviously I have made a few mods, however these are just tiny tweaks to the game that I find convenient, and the mods I release are simply those but polished up to be released. I don't intend to take the show away from Orson and the vanilla game, instead, my mods are meant to be as unnoticeable as possible, without altering anything related to difficulty or gameplay (closest it gets is auto minigame tools making it slightly faster to deal with dislocations/shrapnel, but neither of those are life or death issues in my opinion, and the configuration exists for a reason). The point being, my mods are tiny tweaks for convenience, nothing more, and this will remain the case at least until the game releases.

Name: Project Telchak
Summary: Delve into an intense progression line to resurrect your fallen comrades.
Description:
[size=4]The main point of this mod is to create an Ancient object called the Reanimator, or 'Telchak device,' as it was known by the humans. The device is capable of reviving the dead sawians that scatter the caves, as well as significantly healing its living user directly. There are a plethora of other progression pathways which have different benefits, like endgame fluid and item containers, among others.[/size]

[size=3]Like the mod itself, this description is not complete. I will finish it if I find myself with the time to do so.[/size]

[size=4]Main progression line:[/size]
- Mini fusion device
- Naquadah slab
- Naquadah battery array
- Ancient repository of knowledge
- Control crystals
- Universe in a bottle
- Zero-point module
- Ancient reanimator
These are, in approximate order, the main items of the mod. The sole goal is the creation of the reanimator, a.k.a. the Telchak device, in order to revive fallen Sawians. Using the device in the inventory while standing very close to a corpse will bring them back to life in the form of a trader. It also heals the player significantly, by increasing brain health by 10, resetting fibrillation, healing all limbs by 25 skin and muscle health, and potentially reversing disfigurements.

[size=4]Items that cannot be crafted:[/size]
- Gold (see below) must be bought from any trader type, or found in drop capsules, container crates, or by corpses.
- Garnets can be found in certain structures:
  - Mining charge, a deposit of ores with an inverted landmine above.
  - Meteor: a crashed extraterrestrial object whose impact site is littered with toxirock.
  - Ore deposit: some ores and a garnet contained in a locked steel container, accompanied by magma and a barrel of radioactive waste.
- Plutonium-239 can be found by breaking rad barrels (the yellow ones, not spend fuel).
- Courage emblems are dropped by elder thornbacks when they are killed.
- Iridium ore can be synthesised from UU-matter, but it can also be found in a structure.
- Ardite ore is spawned as one of the effects of sacrificing an expie voodoo doll in lava. Around a hundred tiles of it are placed at random locations.
- Cobalt ore is spawned within the vicinity of a demon altar when it is broken.
- Manyullyn bars are created by placing 3 cobalt slabs into one basin of a smelter and 3 ardite bars into the other, with at least one tile of magma in the brick basin in the centre. Smelters are spawned around the world when a voodoo doll is sacrificed.

[size=4]General: [i]many of the following items may sound OP or unbalanced, but believe me, they are not easy to obtain by any means.[/i][/size]
- Larger carcass, hefty carcass, huge carcass, and arachnoplastic
Have you ever found yourself with an abundance of stiff carcasses? Well, now you can put them to use! After combining two of them into a large carcass, you can repeat the process up until obtaining a huge carcass, composed of sixteen stiff carcasses in total. It can be used to make arachnoplastic, a key ingredient in tretonin.
- Gold slab types
Used mainly as an unperishable store of value for trading; they can be converted between five different sizes, with the regular gold slab, the middle item, being worth 50. The material is also used to make gold thread and gilded alloy.

- UU-Matter [LIQUID]
Used for the synthesis of iridium ore; it can be generated by a mass fabricator, a handheld, battery-powered tool.
- Tretonin [LIQUID]
An extremely powerful antibiotic, in a sense. It gives 600 minutes of antibiotic immunity time per ml. Its description says you will form a dependency on it, but this is currently only an upcoming feature.
- Blue blood [LIQUID]
For only one mililitre, instantly sets blood oxygen to 100%, alongside acting as an insanely powerful opiate antagonist.
- Heartstoppers [LIQUID]
Instantly heals strokes, pulmonary embolisms, and all internal bleeding, at the cost of causing sudden asystole.

Item containers:
- Golden satchel
Holds 6.5u, with 3u max weight per item, and 100% encumbrance reduction.
- Gilded satchel
Holds 12.5u, with 6u max weight per item, and 100% encumbrance reduction.
- Bloodlust bag
Holds 25u, with 12u max weight per item, and 100% encumbrance reduction.
- Iridium med-kit
Holds 8u, with 1.5u max weight per item, and 90% encumbrance reduction. Only medical items can be stored inside.

Liquid containers:
- Bronze canteen
Holds 1,000 ml, and does not become heavier when fuller. Weighs 0.2u.
- Titanium canteen
Holds 3,000 ml, and does not become heavier when fuller. Weighs 0.3u.
- Golden canteen
Holds 5,000 ml, and does not become heavier when fuller. Weighs 0.4u.

- Two new layer modifiers! Corrupted, which spawns patches of corrupted tiles around the world, and arctic, which coats every surface in snow, freezes all water and drops the temp, and allows the growing of spearmint. Patches of corruption in the former modifier may have a demon altar, which will bless the world with a cobalt ore or two upon being broken.

- Hardened resin alloy
Made from 3 processed copper and 4 refined resin, the latter being composed of 2 resin and some sap; the resin itself is made of 1 litre of tree sap. One unit of this alloy contains 8,400ml in total, therefore.
- Gilded alloy
Made from two each of hardened resin alloy, titanium slabs, and gold slabs.
- Bronze plate
Made from three processed copper and two recycled tin, obtained by melting down a nondescript can.
- Steel slab
Made from three pieces of scrap metal and a charcoal.
- Mixed metal blend
Made from two each of processed copper, bronze plates, and steel slabs.
- Iridium reinforced plate
Made from four mixed metal blend, four iridium ore, and one exquisite garnet.
- Bloodlust blend
Made from two gilded alloy, two sanguinite blobs, a hardened resin alloy, and an iridium reinforced plate.
- Cobalt slab and ardite bar
Made from a brimflame shard and three of, respectively, cobalt ore or ardite ore.
- Manyullyn bar
Made from three each of cobalt slabs and ardite bars in a smelter, a structure that populates the world after sacrificing an expie voodoo doll.
- Demonic alloy
Made from two bloodlust blend, one manyullyn bar, and one cobalt slab, along with two brimflame shards as an additive.

Name: RedStone Craft
Summary: Experience a Redstone system reminiscent of Minecraft within Casualties Unknown. Build complex mechanisms, utilize Command Blocks, and construct your own minecart tracks.
Description:
[size=5][b]RedStone Craft - Redstone System, Command Blocks & Trains[/b][/size]

This mod adds a complete redstone system, command blocks with a graphical editor, rails and minecarts, redstone-triggered traps, and craftable storage containers to [i]Casualties Unknown[/i].

[b]Redstone Components[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Redstone Dust[/b]: Transmits signals from 0 to 15 strength, decaying by 1 per block. Automatically connects to neighbors in 16 possible shapes (straight, corner, T-junction, cross).[/*]
[*][b]Redstone Torch[/b]: Constant 15-strength power source. Turns off when the block it is attached to is powered.[/*]
[*][b]Lever / Button / Pressure Plate[/b]: Manual and entity-triggered power sources. Buttons emit a 0.5-second (10 tick) pulse. Pressure plates detect players and creatures stepping on them.[/*]
[*][b]Redstone Repeater[/b]: Refreshes signal strength to 15 and transmits it in one direction. Right-click to switch delay between 1 and 4 ticks. Input is on the back side.[/*]
[*][b]Comparator[/b]: Reads the fullness of adjacent containers (1 per slot, max 15) and outputs a signal. Right-click to toggle Compare / Subtract mode.[/*]
[*][b]Redstone Lamp[/b]: Lights up when powered, turns off when signal is lost.[/*]
[*][b]Piston / Sticky Piston[/b]: Pushes block chains (up to 12 blocks) when powered, and retracts when unpowered. Sticky pistons pull the front block back when retracting. Won't push if blocked by an immovable block or entity.[/*]
[*][b]Observer[/b]: Detects changes in the block directly in front of it and emits a 1-tick 15-strength pulse.[/*]
[*][b]Redstone Block[/b]: Constant 15-strength power source.[/*]
[*][b]Target Block[/b]: When hit by a projectile, outputs a 1-15 strength signal based on how close the hit is to the center.[/*]
[/list]Redstone signals (strength > 0) can trigger adjacent command blocks for automated logic.

[b]Command Blocks & Editor[/b]
Includes [b]Impulse[/b], [b]Repeat[/b], and [b]Chain[/b] command blocks. Right-click any command block to open the graphical editor:
[list]
[*][b]Left Panel[/b]: Adjust block type, execution condition (Unconditional / Conditional), trigger mode (Always On / Redstone Control), facing direction, and execution delay (in ticks, 1 tick = 0.05s).[/*]
[*][b]Right Panel[/b]: Enter a single in-game console command. Supports [b]Tab auto-completion[/b] for commands and arguments.[/*]
[/list]After saving a command, Impulse blocks are automatically armed and will trigger once on the next tick. Chain blocks can be linked in sequence based on their facing direction.

[b]Rails & Minecarts[/b]
[list]
[*]Four rail types: [b]Normal[/b], [b]Powered[/b], [b]Detector[/b], and [b]Activator[/b]. Each has 16 shape variants that automatically connect to neighboring rails.[/*]
[*][b]Powered Rails[/b]: Redstone signals travel along rail chains and decay (max 15 blocks). Minecarts accelerate to 3× speed on powered sections, and slow down to 0.3× on unpowered sections.[/*]
[*][b]Detector Rails[/b]: Output a 15-strength redstone signal when a minecart is on top.[/*]
[*][b]Activator Rails[/b]: Signals travel along rails and decay. Affects passing minecarts (ejects riders, ignites TNT carts, disables hopper carts, etc.).[/*]
[*][b]Minecarts[/b]: Physical entities that can only be placed on rails. Players can ride and control them with WASD. Speed is affected by powered and unpowered rails.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Redstone-Activated Traps[/b]
Traps can be placed by left-clicking. When a redstone rising edge is detected, the trap activates:
[list]
[*]Landmines, Turrets, Bear Traps, Spike Stabbers, Geysers, Jump Pads, Gun Mines, Coils, Sound Cannons.[/*]
[*]Turrets are placed facing away from the player by default.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Crafting Recipes & Containers[/b]
[list]
[*]All redstone components, rails, minecarts, and traps have crafting recipes in the vanilla workbench.[/*]
[*][b]Chests[/b] (27 slots, double chests combine to 54).[/*]
[*][b]Hoppers[/b] (5 slots, pulls items from above, pushes to output direction, locks when powered).[/*]
[*][b]Crafters[/b] (3×3 auto-crafting, triggered by a redstone rising edge, outputs forward or into adjacent containers).[/*]
[/list]
[b]Creative Mode Commands[/b]
Use these in the in-game console:
[list]
[*][b]rsc gamemode creative[/b]: Toggle creative flight and instant block destruction.[/*]
[*][b]rsc items[/b]: Spawn all RedStone Craft items around the player. Pick them up from the ground.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
[list]
[*]Requires [b]BepInEx 5[/b].[/*]
[*]Place [b]CommandBlock.dll[/b] into:
[code]BepInEx/plugins/[/code][/*]
[*]Launch the game.[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[i]Note: This mod is still in early development. Core systems are implemented, but some mechanics may receive ongoing adjustments and bug fixes. Feedback and suggestions are always welcome.[/i]

[/list][color=#D4D4D8]The goal is simple: [b]make the game feel like a shooting gallery without actually turning it into one.[/b] Every weapon has been balanced against vanilla progression, so you'll still need to scavenge, craft, and make choices – but now you'll have [i]way more options[/i] for how to deliver lead-based therapy to your enemies.
All weapons support the [b](attachment system)[/b] – so go ahead, slap a suppressor on that magnum. We don't judge.（in progress)[/color]

[line]

[list=1]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Install CUCoreLib[/b] – this is the backbone of the mod. No exceptions.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Drop the [/b][/color]

[code]gouxismorefirearm.dll[/code][color=#D4D4D8] into your [/color]

[code]BepInEx/plugins/[/code][color=#D4D4D8] folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Launch the game[/b] – if you see a new gun in your inventory, it worked. If you don't, you probably put it in the wrong folder. Double-check.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b](Optional)[/b] – Thank jimmy_king for the UI. He worked hard on it, and it looks great.[/color][/*]
[/list][line]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Full(not yet) Attachment Compatibility[/b] – every new weapon works with the existing attachment system. Sights, suppressors, grips, lasers – mix and match to your heart's content.[/color][/*]

Changelogs.Changelog: nope

[v1.0.2] – 2026-08-14
Added
Chinese localization (zh-CN.json) – because we respect our Chinese-speaking trigger-happy friends. Now you can read gun names in your native language while mag-dumping.
Changed
Ammunition matching overhaul – every gun now uses the correct ammo type. No more shooting 9mm out of a .45 – that's not how physics works.
Weapon damage rebalance – guns now deal damage that actually makes sense relative to their caliber and intended use. Shotguns are scary again. Pistols aren't peashooters. You're welcome.
All magazines added – every weapon now has a proper magazine item. No more magical bottomless clips. Reload like a normal person.
Fixed
Fixed several bugs. (Some new ones may have appeared. That's just how it works. Don't look at me like that.)
Next Update
Crafting recipes – coming soon, because finding guns isn't enough – you should be able to build them too.
Attachment system compatibility – I swear I'll get around to it. Just... give me a bit more time.
Rant
Localization took longer than expected because I had to translate all the gun names and descriptions. If something sounds off, blame my keyboard.
I know I said attachment compatibility was coming last update. I meant it this time. Probably.
If you find a bug that makes you invincible or gives you infinite ammo – keep it to yourself and enjoy it while it lasts.
Still Broken
Multiplayer is still held together with duct tape and hope. Use at your own risk.
The attachment system may or may not work with some new guns. I'll fix it. I promise. (Fingers crossed.)
Hope you enjoy! And remember – more guns = more fun, until you run out of ammo. Then it's just sad.
— G0ux1

[v1.0.3] – 2026-08-18
Added
Nothing new. This is a fix update. Don't get your hopes up.
Changed
Weapon damage rebalanced – again. I swear this is the last time. SMGs now deal around 100 damage, which means they're finally useful for something other than sounding cool and missing everything. Everything else got tweaked upward too. I think it's in a good spot now. Probably. Maybe.
Fixed the "all loot is guns" issue. Turns out the spawn rates were so high that even lunchboxes started spawning sniper rifles. Let me repeat that: you could open a lunchbox and pull out a sniper rifle. Not a sandwich. Not a juice box. A sniper rifle. If you think that's not American enough, I don't know what is. I have dialed it back – you can now expect to find food in your lunchbox again. You're welcome.
Fixed???
Tried to fix the bug where magazines could give you more than one bullet at a time when unload from it. I didn't fully fix it. But I'm thinking about it. That counts for something, right?
Next Update (I swear)
Crafting recipes – still not done. I've been busy. Life is on fire. I'm running on fumes and bad decisions. I'll get to it. Eventually.
Attachment system compatibility – this is tied to another one of my mods, so that update has to come first. It's in the pipeline. Somewhere. Buried under a mountain of other things I haven't done.
Rant
I've opened a new Minecraft mod project. I know I shouldn't. I know I should finish this first. But my brain keeps telling me "ignore the bugs, make the new fun thing," and I keep listening. I am my own worst enemy.
I don't know why I have zero motivation to finish the todo list right now. Maybe it's the burnout. Maybe it's the heat. Maybe I just need a nap. Or a vacation. Or to be put in a coma for a week.
The magazine bug? I'm still working on it. It'll probably be fixed by September. Or October. Or whenever I stop adding unnecessary side projects to my life.
Still Broken
Multiplayer is still held together with prayers and bubblegum.
My mental sanity is about as stable as a three-legged chair.
I have no idea when the next full-content update will drop. But when it does, it'll be great. I promise. (Maybe.)
Thanks for sticking with me. I know this update is small and boring, but sometimes small and boring is better than nothing. I'll get the big stuff done eventually. I just... need a minute.
— G0ux1(might dead)

Name: MechThornback
Summary: Adds two fearsome mechanical bosses, Mech Thornback Elder V1 and V2, each with unique three-phase combat, sabotage interactions, and a shared rare drop: the Wireless Assistant.（Sprites were AI-assisted at first, then manually redrawn and cleaned up for a more hand-drawn look. Minor flaws may remain.）
Description:
[heading][size=6]Description / 描述[/size][/heading]
[size=4]Background Story / 背景故事[/size]
The company throws countless test subjects into a bottomless pit to recover lost equipment. These subjects are spliced from human, fox, and rat DNA, treated as disposable tools. No one expects them to come back alive.
企业把成千上万的实验体丢进深不见底的坑洞，让他们去回收那些坠落的物资。这些实验体由人类、狐狸和老鼠的基因拼凑而成，被当作用完即弃的工具，没有人指望他们活着回来。

Far below the surface, in abandoned mine layers, something else is waiting. War machines built in the image of the Thornback Elder lie dormant in the dark. They were not made by the company, and they belong to no modern faction. They are simply old weapons abandoned long ago, waiting for a signal that should never come.
而在远离地表的废弃矿层深处，还沉睡着另一批东西：模仿棘背兽长老外形制造的战争机械。它们不是企业造的，也不属于任何现代组织，只是很久以前被遗弃在黑暗中的仿生兵器，一直等待着某个永远不会响起的指令。

One day, a piece of company equipment falls from above, tumbles through a crack, and lands inside their nest.
某一天，一件企业设备从上层坠落，穿过裂缝，滚进了它们长眠的洞穴。

The object is damaged, but it still sends out a faint signal. That signal does not connect to any company system. Instead, it accidentally activates ancient receivers buried inside the machines. Like an unintended pairing, V1 and V2 wake up.
那东西已经损坏，却仍然发送着微弱的信号。这段信号没有接入任何企业网络，却意外激活了机械体内的古老接收器。就像一次不经意的配对，V1 和 V2 被唤醒了。

Not long after they awaken, something strange happens in the cave. Light fixtures that should have been dead for years flicker back on. A few long-broken terminals blink with faint light, as if some unseen force is feeding them power again.
它们苏醒后不久，洞穴里出现了某种变化。那些本该彻底断电的照明装置重新亮起，几台早已死去的终端也偶尔闪烁出微光。仿佛有什么看不见的东西正在重新给它们供给能量。

V1 and V2 become part of that same energy chain. They recognise the fallen object as an external power source. As long as the signal remains, they can keep drawing energy from it, connected by an invisible thread.
V1 和 V2 也成为了这条能量链的一部分。那件坠落物被它们识别为外部能量来源。只要信号还在，它们就能持续补充动力，如同被一根无形的线连接着。

The company knows nothing about this. All they see is lost equipment, so they send wave after wave of test subjects down into the pit to search.
企业对此毫不知情。他们只知道有设备掉进了坑洞，于是照例派出一批又一批实验体下去搜索。

When those subjects come close to the machines' nest, V1 and V2 attack immediately. Not out of cruelty, but because they cannot lose their only source of energy. Anything that comes near is seen as a threat trying to cut their power.
当实验体靠近机械巢穴时，V1 和 V2 会立刻发起攻击。不是因为它们天生嗜血，而是因为它们不能失去唯一的能量来源。任何靠近的生物，都会被它们当成试图切断电源的威胁。

V1 is the original prototype. It is heavy, crude, and full of unfinished design marks. It is the template for everything that followed.
V1 是最早被制造出来的原型体。它笨重、粗暴，带着大量未完成的设计痕迹，是所有后续型号的模板。

V2 is the later model, refined from V1. It is larger, calmer, and closer to what its creators originally intended. But on its body, there is a sealed lock port.
V2 则是从 V1 改进而来的后续型。它更庞大，更冷静，也更接近设计者原本想要的样子。但在它身上，有一个被封死的锁口。

That port once connected to an external command channel, built to call for reinforcements. The original plan was for each machine to remotely awaken another V2 when near destruction. But the system never truly worked. By the time V2 was produced, the port had been sealed shut.
那个锁口曾经连接着一条外部指令通道，用于在受损时呼叫增援。设计者原本希望每一台机械在濒临损坏时，都能远程唤醒另一台 V2。但这套系统从未真正启用过。到了 V2 这一代，他们直接封死了它。

Even so, the transmitter deep inside both machines still lives. When V1 or V2 suffers serious damage, they still try to send that ancient signal. It never receives an answer.
即使如此，V1 和 V2 体内的信号发射装置仍然活着。每当它们受到重创，它们仍会尝试发送那个早已失效的信号，只是永远不会得到回应。

These machines still carry abilities far beyond ordinary weapons. Their high-level system authority lets them access most terminals and security devices. Their constant self-diagnostics let them adapt when damaged. And that broken signal channel now remains only as an unanswered hum in the dark.
这两种机械还保留着很多远超普通兵器的能力。它们拥有极高的系统权限，能接入大多数通用终端与安全装置。它们能够持续检测自身状态，并在受损时调整行动。它们体内那条早已断开的信号通道，如今只会在黑暗深处偶尔发出一阵无人应答的嗡鸣。

The company will never know the truth. They only care about getting their equipment back. Down in the pit, the machines just want to keep the one thing that keeps them alive.
企业永远不会知道真相。他们只关心设备能不能找回来。而洞底的那些机械，也只是在守护唯一让它们继续运转的东西。
[line]
[size=6][font=Arial Black]Overview / 概览[/font][/size]
Mech Thornback adds two fearsome mechanical bosses to Casualties Unknown: the Mech Thornback Elder V1 and the Mech Thornback Elder V2.
机械棘背兽为《Casualties Unknown》添加了两个可怕的机械 Boss：机械棘背兽长老 V1 和机械棘背兽长老 V2。

These heavily-armoured spider-like machines bring intense three-phase battles, custom threat music, devastating electric discharges, and a unique one-phase sabotage mechanic.
这些重甲蜘蛛型机械拥有紧张的三阶段战斗、专属威胁音乐、毁灭性放电攻击，以及独特的一阶段破坏机制。

Also included is the Wireless Assistant, a rare utility item dropped by both bosses.
模组还包含“无线电子助手”，这是一件由两个 Boss 掉落的稀有实用物品。

It can charge batteries, report your body status, and bypass several common electronic locks.
它可以给电池充电、汇报身体状态，并绕过多种常见的电子锁。

The mod supports English and Chinese, switching automatically based on the game language.
模组支持英文和中文，会根据游戏语言自动切换。
[line]
[heading][size=6]Installation instructions / 安装说明[/size][/heading]
Install BepInEx for Casualties Unknown.
为《Casualties Unknown》安装 BepInEx。

Install CUCoreLib and CreatureKit.
安装 CUCoreLib 和 CreatureKit。

Extract the mod archive into 
[code]BepInEx/plugins/[/code]将模组压缩包解压到 
[code]BepInEx/plugins/[/code]Make sure the mod DLL is placed inside its own subfolder, for example: 
[code]BepInEx/plugins/MechThornback/MechThornback.dll[/code]确保模组 DLL 放在自己的子文件夹中，例如：
[code]BepInEx/plugins/MechThornback/MechThornback.dll[/code]Launch the game. The mod will load automatically.
启动游戏，模组会自动加载。

If you play multiplayer, both the host and all clients must install this mod, CUCoreLib, CreatureKit, and KrokoshaCasualtiesMP.
如果进行多人游戏，主机和所有客户端都必须安装本模组、CUCoreLib、CreatureKit 以及 KrokoshaCasualtiesMP。
[line]
[heading][size=6]Main features / 主要特性[/size][/heading]
[size=5]Mech Thornback Elder V1 / 机械棘背兽长老 V1[/size]

[b][size=4]Three-phase health system / 三阶段血量系统[/size][/b]
As the boss loses health, it enters phase 2 and then phase 3.
随着 Boss 生命值下降，它会进入第二阶段和第三阶段。
Each phase changes its movement speed, turning speed, and wall-burrowing damage.
每个阶段都会改变移动速度、转向速度和钻墙伤害。

[b][size=4]Custom AI / 自定义 AI[/size][/b]
The boss tracks the nearest player over long distances, reacquires targets after taking damage, and loses interest only when the player moves far away.
Boss 会远距离追踪最近的玩家，受伤后会重新锁定目标，只有玩家远离后才会放弃追击。

[b][size=4]Wall burrowing / 钻墙能力[/size][/b]
The boss can destroy terrain blocks while moving.
Boss 可以破坏地形方块移动。
Burrow damage changes per phase.
钻墙伤害随阶段变化。

[b][size=4]Periodic gunfire / 周期性开枪[/size][/b]
Every few seconds, the boss fires a powerful piercing shot.
每隔几秒，Boss 会发射一次强力的穿透性射击。
A visible warning line and audio cue appear before each shot.
射击前会出现可见的预警线和音效提示。
Warning time, cooldown, and damage multiplier change per phase.
预警时间、冷却和伤害倍率随阶段变化。

[b][size=4]Electric shock mechanism / 漏电机制[/size][/b]
In phase 2 and phase 3, staying in contact with the boss for too long triggers a massive electric discharge.
在第二阶段和第三阶段，与 Boss 接触过久会触发强力电击。
This damages the player, causes forced ragdoll, and briefly stuns the boss.
这会对玩家造成伤害、强制倒地，并让 Boss 短暂瘫痪。
The boss and nearby area show electric particle effects.
Boss 和附近区域会出现电弧粒子特效。

[b][size=4]Amputation stun / 截肢瘫痪[/size][/b]
If the boss successfully amputates a limb, it becomes stunned for 2 seconds, giving the player a short escape window.
如果 Boss 成功截断玩家肢体，它会瘫痪 2 秒，给玩家短暂的逃脱窗口。

[b][size=4]Emergency Stop Device / 紧急停止装置[/size][/b]
In phase 1 only, you can interact with V1 to open a keypad minigame.
仅在第一阶段，你可以与 V1 交互打开数字键盘小游戏。
The screen shows a random 8-digit code.
屏幕显示随机 8 位密码。
Enter it correctly and the boss is paralysed for 20 seconds with electric particle effects.
输入正确后，Boss 会瘫痪 20 秒，并出现电击粒子特效。
This has a 5-minute cooldown and cannot be used in phase 2 or 3.
该机制有 5 分钟冷却，在第二阶段和第三阶段无法使用。

[b][size=4]Player aura / 玩家光环[/size][/b]
Close to the boss, the player gains adrenaline and stamina but suffers maximum horror.
靠近 Boss 时，玩家肾上腺素提高、体力恢复，但恐惧值拉满。
Slightly farther away, the effect weakens but remains active.
稍远距离效果减弱但仍会生效。
The aura also prevents sleep.
光环还会阻止玩家入睡。

[b][size=4]Death rewards / 死亡奖励[/size][/b]
If you kill the boss while close to it, you gain a large happiness boost and long-lasting caffeine, hear a victory sound, and lose all horror.
如果你在 Boss 附近将其击杀，会获得大量快乐值、长时间咖啡因效果、胜利音效，并清除所有恐惧。

[b][size=4]Custom threat music / 专属威胁音乐[/size][/b]
The boss uses three phase-specific drone tracks.
Boss 使用三首随阶段切换的背景无人机音轨。
Music plays when you are within range and fades out when you leave.
玩家进入范围后音乐播放，离开后淡出。

[b][size=4]Spawn rules / 生成规则[/size][/b]
One V1 appears when you revisit Layer 2 after having travelled deeper.
玩家从深层返回并再次进入第二层时，生成一只 V1。
If a layer expansion mod is installed, one V1 also appears on Layer 6.
如果安装了层级扩展模组，第六层也会生成一只 V1。
Spawn position is always at least 300 tiles away from the player.
生成位置始终距离玩家至少 300 格。
Only one V1 spawns per layer.
每层只生成一只 V1。
[line]
[size=5]Mech Thornback Elder V2 / 机械棘背兽长老 V2[/size]
Stronger version of V1 with higher health and more dangerous stats.
V1 的强化版本，拥有更高的生命值和更危险的属性。
Uses the same three-phase AI and combat framework.
使用相同的三阶段 AI 和战斗框架。

[b][size=4]Brute Force Lockpick / 暴力撬锁[/size][/b]
In phase 1 only, you can interact with V2 to open a lockpick minigame with 0.5 degree effective range.
仅在第一阶段，你可以与 V2 交互打开撬锁小游戏，有效开锁范围为 0.5 度。
Success paralyses the boss for 20 seconds with electric particles.
成功撬锁后 Boss 瘫痪 20 秒，并出现电击粒子特效。
This has a 5-minute cooldown and cannot be used in phase 2 or 3.
该机制有 5 分钟冷却，在第二阶段和第三阶段无法使用。
Distinct visual style with orange lighting.
拥有独特的橙色灯光视觉风格。
[line]
[size=5]Wireless Assistant / 无线电子助手[/size]
Dropped by both V1 and V2.
由 V1 和 V2 掉落。

[b][size=4]Battery charging / 电池充电[/size][/b]
The item has a battery slot that accepts all battery types.
物品自带电池槽位，支持所有类型电池。
Any battery inserted is fully charged in 5 seconds.
放入的电池会在 5 秒内充满。

[b][size=4]Body status reports / 身体状态汇报[/size][/b]
While carried, the assistant speaks periodic updates about estimated bleedout time, infected body parts, fracture and dislocation recovery times, weight changes, and fibrillation risk.
携带时，助手会定期播报预计失血致死时间、感染部位、骨折和脱臼恢复时间、体重变化以及纤颤风险。

[b][size=4]Remote hacking / 远程破解[/size][/b]
While the assistant is in your inventory, you can instantly bypass keypad and lockpick doors, general terminals, biometric DNA terminals, and scrap eater machines.
只要助手在背包中，你可以立即绕过密码门和撬锁门、通用终端、生物 DNA 终端以及废料吞噬者机器。
The assistant's own battery charge does not affect its hacking or reporting functions.
助手自身的电池电量不影响黑客或汇报功能。
[line]
[heading][size=6]Requirements / 前置要求[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*]BepInEx[/*]
[*]CUCoreLib[/*]
[*]CreatureKit[/*]
[*]KrokoshaCasualtiesMP（optional，用于多人游戏 / optional, for multiplayer）[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][size=6]Shout outs / 致谢[/size][/heading]
Special thanks to the BepInEx team for making it possible to mod this game.
特别感谢 BepInEx 团队，他们让这款游戏的模组化成为可能。
Thanks also to the CUCoreLib developers for providing a stable and flexible modding framework.
同时感谢 CUCoreLib 开发者提供了稳定且灵活的模组框架。
Author: CIXINLIN

Name: What Mod Is This From (WMITF)
Summary: When you look at a modded item, block, crafting recipe entity, WMITF will show you the name of the mod which it came from. Adds mod sources in tooltips for items and crafts, as well as WAILA-style UI for blocks and entites.
Description:
[size=5][b][color=#ff7700]What Mod Is This From? (WMITF)[/color][/b][/size]
[color=#38761d][size=2](The expie is pointing at the emerald ore, [/size][/color][color=#38761d][size=2]you see)[/size][/color]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/552/552-1786593363-1779952297.png[/img]
[center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/552][img]https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Fjimmyking9999999%2FMetadata-generator%2Fmain%2Fbadges%2Fwhat-mod-is-this-from-wmitf.json[/img][/url] [/center]

[size=3]WMITF is a simple mod that lets you know what stuff is from, adding a customizable WAILA/Jade-style tooltip and mod-source detector for Casualties Unknown.[/size]

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Features:[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Shows the owning mod’s name on custom item tooltips for items[/*]
[*]Adds a compact top-screen inspector for blocks and building entities. (What am I looking at?)
^ Displays name, health, condition/mining percentage, icon, and source mod.[/*]
[*]Shows recipe/result ownership in the crafting pane.[/*]
[*]Works in multiplayer, intentionally sleek.[/*]
[*]Supports CUCorelib, RshCCL, and RshLib. Want another addition? Ask us in the [url=https://discord.gg/ehCptz9pwU]Discord[/url]![/*]
[*]Now in Simplified Chinese and Russian! [/*]
[/list][color=#f1c232]All features can be toggled independently in the Gameplay settings tab ^[/color]

[size=4][color=#ff7700][b]For Mod Developers:[/b][/color][/size]
Want WMITF attribution for a mod that does not use a supported library? Choose one option below.
[spoiler][b]Option A - Optional in-mod registration (recommended)[/b]
[code]using BepInEx;
using BepInEx.Bootstrap;

[BepInDependency("com.jimmyking.whatmodisthisfrom", BepInDependency.DependencyFlags.SoftDependency)]
public sealed class Plugin : BaseUnityPlugin
{
    public const string ModGUID = "your.mod.guid";

    // Checks if WMITF is loaded and in the correct version, otherwise silently skips
    private dynamic Wmitf => Chainloader.PluginInfos.TryGetValue(
        "com.jimmyking.whatmodisthisfrom", out var plugin) &&
        plugin.Metadata.Version >= new Version(1, 0, 1)
            ? plugin.Instance
            : null;

    private void Awake()
    {
        Wmitf?.RegisterItem("my_item_id", ModGUID);
        Wmitf?.RegisterTile(myTileIndex, ModGUID); //ushort
        Wmitf?.RegisterBuildingEntity("my_building_id", ModGUID);
    }
}[/code]
[b]Option B - Adding metadata through GitHub
[/b]
Open a pull request adding the mod’s GUID and content IDs to [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/Metadata-generator/blob/main/WMITF-metadata.json]WMITF-metadata.json[/url]
[/spoiler]


(Inspired by the Minecraft mod WAILA by ProfMobius, and Terraria mod WMITF by HilariousWalnut34. [size=2]Hey, wait a second...[/size])

Note: [b]CUCoreLib v1.0.4 is required! This mod uses features from the latest release.[/b]

Name: Cu-BloodBank
Summary: Add a Donate Blood / Draw Blood mechanism to the merchant trading system in Casualties Unknown
Description:
[size=4][b]Casualties Unknown - Blood Bank[/b][/size]
[b]Version:[/b] v1.2.0 | [b]Author:[/b] ouse114514

A BepInEx plugin that adds "Donate / Draw Blood" mechanics to the trader system in Casualties Unknown.

[line]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Donate blood[/b]: Click the new "Donate / Draw Blood" button in the trade menu to donate your own blood (500ml; 1500ml for Dune) in exchange for trade credit (better price at higher reputation: ≥125 high, ≥75 medium, else low).[/*]
[*][b]Draw blood[/b]: Drag an [b]empty blood bag[/b] onto the button to draw blood from the trader using trade credit (up to 750ml per bag). The more you draw, the pricier it gets (price doubles every 1000ml drawn cumulatively, up to x16); the less blood the trader has, the higher the price.[/*]
[*][b]First draw free[/b]: When 0ml drawn in total and reputation ≥200, the first draw is free.[/*]
[*][b]Credit cap[/b]: If the draw price exceeds the 60 credit cap, the trader refuses (consistent with vanilla credit rules).[/*]
[*][b]Price label[/b]: Left of the button, showing live price, trader's remaining blood, and total drawn (also shows both blood types when the blood-type mod is installed).[/*]
[*][b]Trader refuses his own blood[/b]: Blood drawn from a trader cannot be sold back to him (EXP gets awkward / MIKY is speechless); Dune is a simple creature and accepts it. Other traders buy it normally.[/*]
[*][b]Blood type integration[/b] (optional): If Alexx_'s MedicalBrutalism is also installed, blood drawn from a trader carries the trader's blood type. Hovering a bag shows its type and compatible types. EXP/MIKY refuse incompatible blood bags (Dune excepted), unless the trader's own blood is below 25%, in which case they accept anything.[/*]
[*][b]Emergency gift[/b]: A non-hostile, non-Dune trader gives you a free 750ml bag of blood when your blood volume drops below 70% (once per trader).[/*]
[*][b]Localization[/b]: Supports Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English.[/*]
[/list][line]

[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Copy
[code]Cu-BloodBank.dll[/code]to:
[code]<Steam>\steamapps\common\Casualties Unknown Demo\BepInEx\plugins\[/code][/*]
[*]Requires [b]BepInEx 5[/b] (same environment as Cu-SaveManager and other mods).[/*]
[*]Launch the game. To uninstall, just delete the DLL.[/*]
[/list][line]

[b]Pricing Rules[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Base price[/b] (per 750ml bag):
[list]
[*]Reputation > 100:
[code]23.5 - 0.1 × Reputation[/code][/*]
[*]Reputation ≤ 100:
[code]28 - 0.14 × Reputation[/code][/*]
[/list]Rep 50→21, 100→14, 150→9, 200→4.[/*]
[*][b]Trader blood factor[/b]:
[code]1.0 ~ 2.0[/code](lower blood = higher price; Dune cap 15000ml, others 5000ml).[/*]
[*][b]Cumulative tier[/b]: Doubles every 1000ml drawn (
[code]x1, x2, x4, x8, x16[/code]).[/*]
[/list][line]

[b]Log File[/b]
[code]%LocalLow%\Orsoniks\CasualtiesUnknown\BloodBank.log[/code]
