Name: CatPatchCustomLinesLoader
Summary: Allows you to replace the default hugging/kissing lines in CatPatch with your own. Additionally, it adds extra dialogue pools.
Description:
[size=5]An unofficial mod for CatPatch for loading custom dialogue lines[/size]

CatPatch: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/69]https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/69[/url]

Allows you to replace the default hugging/kissing lines in CatPatch with your own. Simply edit the CatPatchCustomLines.json file to add new lines or remove existing ones. The file is hot reloaded, no need to restart the game.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download CatPatchCustomLinesLoader.zip[/*]
[*]Unzip it and place the extracted CatPatchCustomLinesLoader folder in "Casualties Unknown Demo/BepInEx/plugins"[/*]
[*]Edit the CatPatchCustomLinesLoader/CatPatchCustomLines.json file as you wish. By default it comes with all of CatPatch's base dialogue.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Main features[/size][/b]

For Hosts, this mod allows them to set up [u]custom dialogue for everyone on the server to see[/u], even if they don't have this mod installed. Simply add or remove any dialogue you want in CatPatchCustomLines.json, the file is hot reloaded - no need to restart the game.

For Clients, they can filter unwanted dialogue by enabling 'Filter Incoming Lines' in CatPatch's in-game settings. Any dialogue lines not present in your CatPatchCustomLines.json will be replaced by lines you do have. [b]This setting is disabled by default[/b].

[size=4][b]Extra dialogue pools
[/b][/size]Besides the default Vulnerable/Comfort/Cheerful cases, the mod also adds extra dialogue pools for use in specific conditions. Adding dialogue lines for all these cases is [i]not[/i] necessary. If they're empty, that case will simply be skipped.
I've ordered them here in descending priority. Speaker is the player who initiated the hug and Receiver whoever accepted the hug.
Hug lines:
[list=1]
[*]FinalHugLines - Speaker dying[/*]
[*]GoodbyeHugLines - Receiver dying[/*]
[*]GleefulPairHugLines - Speaker & Receiver happiness >= 75[/*]
[*]VulnerableHugLines - Speaker happiness <= -40[/*]
[*]ComfortHugLines - Receiver happiness <= -40[/*]
[*]IrradiatedHugLines - Receiver radiation > 10[/*]
[*]SickHugLines - Speaker sickness >= 50[/*]
[*]OpiateOverdoseHugLines - Speaker opiate reception > 5[/*]
[*]OpiateWithdrawalHugLines - Speaker opiate reception < -5[/*]
[*]SpeakerMissingArmHugLines - Speaker is missing an arm[/*]
[*]ReceiverMissingArmHugLines - Receiver is missing an arm[/*]
[*]HotHugLines - Speaker temperature > 38[/*]
[*]ColdHugLines - Speaker temperature < 35.5[/*]
[*]DirtyHugLines - Receiver dirtiness >= 75[/*]
[*]OverweightHugLines - Receiver weightOffset > 15[/*]
[*]CheerfulHugLines - Speaker happiness >= 40[/*]
[*]HostHugLines - Receiver is host[/*]
[*]NeutralHugLines - Default hug lines[/*]
[/list]Kiss lines:
[list=1]
[*]FinalKissLines - Speaker dying[/*]
[*]GoodbyeKissLines - Receiver dying[/*]
[*]VulnerableKissLines - Speaker happiness <= -40[/*]
[*]ComfortKissLines - Receiver happiness <= -40[/*]
[*]DisfiguredKissLines - Speaker or Receiver is disfigured[/*]
[*]DirtyKissLines - Receiver dirtiness >= 75[/*]
[*]CheerfulKissLines - Speaker happiness >= 40[/*]
[*]KissLines - Default kiss lines[/*]
[/list]

[color=#D4D4D8]vee[/color]

Name: Casualties Overlevelled
Summary: Makes stats - sorry, "skills" much more impactful, and flattens the levelling curve.
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Want your Expie to be able to grow incredibly powerful and tough?
This is a crude and not fully tested mod that makes skills more impactful and evens out the levelling curve. Inspired by the "Comprehensive Rework" mod - as it wasn't updated in a while, i tried making my own version.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Unfortunately, i couldn't figure out how to do this without editing this game's dll files, so it's [b]not[/b] a BepInEx mod.
Go to Casualties Unknown Demo > CasualtiesUnknown_Data > replace the Assembly-CSharp.dll file with the one from this mod.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]the levelling curve has been flattened with a steamroller - getting skills into the 100's is now possible[/*]
[*]RES now multiplies healing speed (by 10% per point, so 15 RES = 150% speed) and adds limb damage reduction. Just try not to fistfight any overgrown Salad monsters...[/*]
[*]INT now increases exp gain speed, and also increases the healing speed of brain health as an added bonus.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]The mod was made for version 7.0 of the Steam Demo. It will almost certainly brick the game on any other version..[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Shoutouts to Comprehensive revision by SoulDRoul, which is probably a much more thorough mod than my crude imitation.[/color]

Name: More Plastic
Summary: Adds more sources of plastic to the game.
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Adds more sources of plastic to the game, certain traps/entities have a chance to drop plastic, mostly starting from layer 3, also added a recipe for crafting plastic.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Sources of plastic are: Sound Cannon, Turrets, Recharging Stations, Bioterminals, Landmines.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Suggestions welcome.[/color]

(the only reason why this mod exists is cus i got fed up of how rare plastic can be depending on your luck and if you are playing desolate)  

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]

Name: CustomGenerator
Summary: Use objects to form text or image patterns!Supports multiplayer gaming. No installation is required on the client to view printed images and text. CustomGenerator is a BepInEx plugin that lets you spawn prefabs for printing.
Description:
[b]CustomGenerator[/b]

[b]Description[/b]

CustomGenerator is a BepInEx plugin that lets you spawn prefabs and print text or images as object patterns. It allows you to place objects using configurable scale, rotation, and spread, or to generate patterns from text and images through dot‑matrix or rectangle‑coverage algorithms.

CustomGenerator 是一个 BepInEx 插件，可用于生成预制体，并将文字或图片打印为物体图案。它支持自定义缩放、旋转和散布来放置物体，也支持通过点阵或矩形覆盖算法从文字和图片生成图案。

Installation Instructions

1. Make sure BepInEx 5 is installed in your game folder. 
2. Copy `CustomGenerator.dll` into `BepInEx\plugins\`. 
3. Launch the game. The configuration file will be created at `BepInEx\config\CustomGenerator.cfg`. 
4. Press `F9` (default) to open/close the UI window.

安装方法

1. 确保游戏目录已安装 BepInEx 5。 
2. 将 `CustomGenerator.dll` 复制到 `BepInEx\plugins\`。 
3. 启动游戏，配置文件将生成在 `BepInEx\config\CustomGenerator.cfg`。 
4. 按下 `F9`（默认）打开/关闭 UI 窗口。

Main Features

- **Object Generation** – Spawn multiple copies of a prefab with adjustable scale, rotation, spread radius, and mouse placement. 
- **Text & Image Printing** – Render text or load image files, then place objects in a grid (dot matrix) or as oriented rectangles that cover the shape. 
- **Advanced Print Options** – For rectangle coverage, tune parameters such as coverage threshold, angle step, white‑ratio limit, and maximum iterations. 
- **Multisave Management** – Save and load spawned object layouts with custom archive names. The “Save & Unload” button saves objects and then removes them from the scene – recommended before using other save tools. 
- **Live Process Control** – Rectangle generation runs as a coroutine and can be stopped at any time with `F8` or the on‑screen Stop button. 
- **Language Support** – Switch between English and Simplified Chinese directly in the GUI. 

主要功能

- **物体生成** – 批量生成预制体，支持自定义缩放、旋转、散布半径及鼠标定位。 
- **文字与图片打印** – 渲染文字或载入图片，然后以点阵或矩形覆盖的形式排列物体。 
- **高级打印选项** – 在矩形覆盖模式下，可调节覆盖率阈值、角度步长、白色占比限制、最大迭代次数等参数。 
- **多存档管理** – 可保存和加载已生成物体的布局，支持自定义存档名称。“保存并卸载”按钮可在保存后清除场景内的所有生成物，建议在使用其他存档工具前使用。 
- **实时过程控制** – 矩形覆盖以协程运行，可随时通过 `F8` 或界面上的停止按钮安全中断。 
- **语言支持** – 可在界面底部直接切换英文和简体中文。

Requirements

- Casualties Unknown Demo 
- BepInEx 5 for Unity Mono

Name: Say Again - hearing protection
Summary: Adds hearing protection and hearing aids to Casualties: Unknown demo. Your Expie's ears will thank you.
Description:
[size=6]Say Again?[/size]
[size=4][b]Adds wearable hearing protection to [i]Casualties: Unknown[/i].[/b][/size]

Safety first!
[heading]Requires[/heading]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx 5[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CUCoreLib]CUCoreLib[/url][/*]

[code]BepInEx/plugins/[/code] inside your game folder, so the DLL lands in 
[code]BepInEx/plugins/HearingConservation.dll[/code][/*]
[*]Launch the game.[/*]
[/list]To uninstall, simply remove the DLL from the 
[code]plugins[/code] directory.
[heading]What it adds[/heading]
3 kinds of hearing protection plus hearing aids, all occupy the [i]ears[/i] head slot so you wear them alongside other head gear.
[list]
[*][b]Makeshift ear muffs[/b]: craftable from basic ingredients, offer basic protection[/*]
[*][b]Earplugs[/b]: loot only, good protection[/*]
[*][b]Earmuffs[/b]: offer decent protection, harder to craft, more durable[/*]
[/list]Hearing protection reduces hearing loss from loud sounds (explosions, gunshots, etc.). Wearing earplugs:
[list]
[*]Rifle shots to first deafness moodle: 5->35. 2nd moodle: >200 shots[/*]
[*]Withstand mine, turret explosion without instant deafness[/*]
[*]Sound cannon hearing damage also reduced (it still scrambles your innards, though)[/*]
[/list]Note that hearing loss from neurological sources (brain damage, mindwipe etc.) is not affected.
Wearing hearing protection while sleeping also reduces the bad sleep debuff.

[size=4]Hearing aids[/size]
Hearing aids are a craftable (at INT 11) item that amplifies incoming sound - i.e., it reduces deafness, when worn and charged. It affects mood, trader rep, and the muffling effect of incoming sounds. It also provides very light hearing protection.

While you're wearing anything, a moodle shows what it's doing.

Name: Second Thoughts - Let Me Go Back
Summary: Lets your expie jump away from the descent prompt in Casualties: Unknown (demo)
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
In vanilla demo, the moment you touch the bottom of a layer, the game opens the descend/save panel and puts you into a forced-walk state. Nothing ever takes it back except descending or quitting to the menu.

This mod patches this behavior:
[list]
[*]Movement and jumping are released as soon as the save/descend panel appears, so you can leave.[/*]
[*]The panel dismisses itself once you've climbed clear of the trigger.[/*]
[*]Walking back down re-opens it exactly as before. Descending is unchanged.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx 5[/url].[/*]
[*]Extract the archive into [i]BepInEx/plugins/[/i] inside your game folder, so the DLL lands at [i]BepInEx/plugins/SecondThoughts.dll[/i].[/*]
[*]Launch the game.[/*]
[/list]To uninstall, simply delete [i]BepInEx/plugins/SecondThoughts.dll[/i].

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]BepInEx 5.4.23.x[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]C:U demo 7.0.x[/color][/*]
[/list]

Name: CU-MCP-Bridge
Summary: A mod that lets AI directly control the game : the AI can read character stats, move around the world, use items, heal injuries, and even summon an AI clone to act alongside it.
Description:
[size=5]CU-MCP-Bridge v1.0.0 (Test Build) Released[/size]

[quote][i]Note: This is a [b]test release[/b] for experimentation only. Bugs may exist, play at your own risk.[/i][/quote][size=4]What is it[/size]

A mod that lets AI control your game of [u]Casualties Unknown[/u]. The AI can read your character's state, move around the world, use items, heal wounds, and even summon an AI companion to fight alongside you.

[size=4]Features[/size]

[list]
[*]Move, jump, and navigate the world[/*]
[*]Pick up items, use consumables, treat injuries[/*]
[*]Sleep to recover energy, set local contingency rules (e.g. auto-heal below 30% HP, no AI needed)[/*]
[*]Summon / remove an AI companion[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]Requirements[/size]

[list]
[*]Windows 10 / 11 + Steam version of the game[/*]
[*]Python 3.10+[/*]
[*]An MCP-capable AI client (e.g. opencode)[/*]
[/list]
Three-step setup, ready in 5 minutes. Full instructions are in the README.

[size=4]Known issues[/size]

When installed alongside some skin mods, the AI companion may grow two tails (one of them mirrors the player's tail in real time). Not present in vanilla, will be fixed in a future release.

[size=4]Feedback[/size]

Testers welcome. Report any issues you find. If possible, please use Chinese; it would be greatly appreciated.

Original version of landmines: Add variants that are attached to the wall and rotate in the air. On the third layer, there will be variants that hang upside down from the ceiling (like stalactites, they will fall down). In addition, all landmines can be removed, and removing landmines will reward waste or circuit boards as the original version of landmines has too few waste rewards
In addition, there are mines of different colors that may be replaced by the following mines after the original mine is generated

The first layer will display a red landmine: it will jump up and explode when you try to jump, with the same reaction time as the original landmine
The second layer will display a gray landmine: it will randomly summon the creatures that will appear in the current layer after being detonated, as all the creatures generated in the original version have been intercepted
The third layer will display purple mines, which are similar to the turret mechanism and are fired when the player passes by. However, purple mines are disposable and can explode, so they will give players twice the reaction time of the turret
The fourth layer will display yellow landmines, which are similar to the sound wave cannon mechanism, locking the player. After the warning period, the player's body will explode directly, unless you hide behind an obstacle. It also has very cool special effects
On the fifth layer, white/ghost landmines will appear. When the player passes by (without visually impaired obstacles), it will rotate at the position where you first appeared within range, increasing in speed and then exploding. It is usually bitten off by elders
Also added some items about landmines
Green landmine: intercepts explosions. If you carry a green landmine, the explosion that will cause damage to you will be directly intercepted. In addition, it can also intercept the sound wave impact of the explosion
Blue landmines: can be immediately removed when carried
Both types of landmines can be prevented from being used by pressing F to collect items

Finally, the game will also generate rare landmines with a 1% probability, waiting for you to find them


原版地雷：增加贴在墙上的，和在空中旋转的变体，在第三层会出现倒挂在天花板上的变体（和钟乳石一样，会掉下来），此外，所有地雷都可以被拆除，拆除地雷会额外奖励废料或者电路板因为原版地雷废料奖励太少了

此外还有不同颜色的地雷，在原版地雷生成后，会有概率被以下地雷取代
第一层会出现红色地雷：它会在你尝试跳过的时候跳起来并爆炸，反应时间和原版地雷一致
第二层会出现灰色地雷：它在被引爆后会随机召唤当前层会出现的生物，因为原版所有生物的生成都被拦截了
第三层会出现紫色地雷，它和炮台机制差不多，都是检查玩家经过时发射，不过紫色地雷时一次性的，且会爆炸，因此它会给玩家一倍于炮台的反应时间
第四层会出现黄色地雷，它和音波炮机制差不多，锁定玩家，预警期过后，玩家身上会直接爆炸，除非你躲到障碍物后面，它还有非常炫酷的特效
第五层会出现白色/幽灵地雷，当玩家经过时（无视障碍物），它会在你第一次出现在范围内的位置旋转，转速会越来越快然后爆炸，它通常会被长老咬掉
还增加了一些关于地雷的物品
绿色地雷：拦截爆炸，如果你携带绿色地雷，那么会对你造成伤害的爆炸会直接被拦截，此外还可以拦截爆炸的音波影响
青色地雷：携带时，可以立刻拆除地雷
两种地雷都可以通过按F收藏物品的方式防止被使用

最后，游戏还会以1%的概率生成稀有地雷，等你找到

Name: Shiri's Substances Expanded
Summary: Adds a huge variety of new substances to the game. Pharmaceuticals are one of the most profitable kinds of products on Earth, as the corporation knows.
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]Pharmaceuticals are one of the most profitable kinds of products on Earth. As it turns out, the corporation has been producing a lot more than we thought.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
This mod adds a huge variety of new substances to the game, from the disorienting pain relief of ketamine to the full visual assault of dimethyltryptamine.

Made with real pharmacology data to be as medically accurate as possible without sacrificing fun, as well as creating as much depth as possible from simple foundations. Substances have not only primary, but secondary, and even tertiary effects, as well as interactions and knock-ons.

[b]Disclaimer: DMT causes extreme flashing lights. Do not use if you suffer from photosensitive epilepsy. This mod does not glorify substance use; reckless administration results in overdose and potential death, and repeated use leads to addiction.[/b]

[size=5]Sedatives[/size][/color]
Four classes of sedatives, each with their own drawbacks.
[size=4]Diphenhydramine[/size]
A sedative antihistamine. Safe and hard to overdose on, but not as effective as other methods.
[size=4]Clonidine[/size]
An older partial alpha-2 adrenergic agonist. Safe and highly effective, but causes hypotension.
[size=4]Diazepam[/size]
The classic benzodiazepine. Safe, effective, and easy to dose, but extremely addictive with horrific withdrawals.
[size=4]Phenobarbital[/size]
The classic barbiturate. Highly effective and not very addictive, but extremely dangerous to overdose on, with a very small margin of error.

[size=5]Pain Relief[/size]
One dissociative anaesthetic.
[size=4]Ketamine[/size]
Provides entirely unmatched pain relief, but causes effects mimicking brain damage for its duration.

[size=5]Performance Enhancement[/size]
One anabolic steroid.
[size=4]Testosterone[/size]
Increases your strength over time, but holds a potential for abuse.

[size=5]Nutrition Management[/size]
One appetite suppressant and one thirst suppressant (the only fictional drug in the roster) along with a diuretic.
[size=4]Semaglutide[/size]
Pauses your hunger.
[size=4]Vigatrodipsin[/size]
Pauses your thirst, but drains fluid if above 60.
[size=4]Hydrochlorothiazide[/size]
Rapidly drains fluid from your body.

[size=5]Mood Management[/size]
Three psychedelics.
[size=4]Psilocybin[/size]
A mild psychedelic. Lifts your mood slightly and causes effects mimicking brain damage for its duration.
[size=4]LSD (Lysergic Acid Diethylamide)[/size]
A moderate psychedelic. Lifts your mood and causes effects mimicking brain damage for its duration.
[size=4]DMT (Dimethyltryptamine)[/size]
An exceptionally strong psychedelic. Greatly lifts your mood but causes an extreme effect for a short time. [b]If you suffer from photosensitive epilepsy, do not use this drug, as it creates an extremely intense flashing effect.[/b]

[size=5]Recreation[/size]
A stimulant, two cannabinoids, and an entactogen.
[size=4]Nicotine[/size]
The classic stimulant. Lifts mood, pauses hunger, and increases energy. Can be smoked or used through patches/gum. Three times as addictive as heroin, it becomes less effective over time and causes severe withdrawals. Also impacts lung function if smoked, with the filter type determining how intensely lung function is impacted.
[size=4]Cannabis[/size]
Contains both CBD and THC at levels depending on which strain of 4 is rolled. Can be smoked or ingested via edibles.
[size=4]CBD (Cannabidiol)[/size]
A non-psychoactive cannabinoid. Reduces pain and anxiety.
[size=4]THC (Tetrahydrocannabinol)[/size]
A psychoactive cannabinoid. Improves mood temporarily and makes you hungrier.
[size=4]MDMA (Methylenedioxymethamphetamine)[/size]
An entactogen. Boosts energy and mood, as well as making you more sociable and charismatic. Causes mood loss when the high is over.

[size=5]Crafting[/size]
Several substances can be synthesised from raw materials found in the world. Chemistry gear, precursor items, and reagents spawn throughout the layers and can be combined to produce drugs in multiple batches, making synthesis more resource-efficient than relying on loot alone.

Precursors are hidden in plain sight. Nail polish, perfume, road markers, and other everyday cargo contain the chemical building blocks for substances in the roster. Some recipes require the full chemistry kit, while others only need a few components.

Cannabis and tobacco can be broken down and recombined into new products. Joints, spliffs, blunts, and cigarettes can all be crafted from raw materials, and cannabis can be infused into food using a heat source to produce edibles.

The three psychedelics can be synthesised from forageable plants and fungi found deeper in the layers, requiring heat and in DMT's case, filtration.

Thank you to comradefoxx for creating some of the mod's sprites.

Name: Casualties Under the Influence
Summary: Adds several new alcohol types, specialised containers, and a full intoxication system.
Description:
Casualties: Under the Influence is a content mod that adds multiple types of new liquor made from the ambiguous vanilla "alcohol" liquid. Each one has a unique recipe as well as a distinct level of intoxication that it gives you when drank.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. Make sure you have installed CUCoreLib (see [i]Requirements[/i])[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]2. Download this mod and place CasualtiesUnderTheInfluence.dll into Bepinex/plugins, alongside CUCoreLib.dll.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]3. Get hammered! >:3[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]As of now, this mod adds:[/b][/size]
- Red wine, vodka, champagne, rum, and whiskey, made with 100 ml of alcohol and, respectively, a geofruit, a rye bulb, a popfruit, 50 ml of tree sap, and a rye flour. 
- Pox, a liquor made from 75 ml of alcohol, 25 ml of tree sap, a helluce, and a rye flour.
- Two grades of shot glass, the makeshift one made from a scrap panel, and the regular one which can only be found as loot or bought from traders. The makeshift shot glass has a capacity of 30 ml, and the regular one, 50.
- A metal flask which can be stored on a belt or trauma rig and holds 230 ml. Can be crafted.
- Findable bottles of the first three liquors (red wine, vodka, and champagne) that come pre-filled with their respective fluid.
- A findable bottle of pox as well.
- Liquid courage, a synthetic alcohol that causes more mild intoxication like wine, but also provides a relatively safe stimulant boost, provided you don't overdo it. It can only be found, not crafted.
- An in-depth system for the concentration of alcohol in your blood. Each liquor gives a different amount, which firstly is dampened or increased based on your current weight and fullness. A moodle with 5 levels of severity will show you how smashed you are; each level corresponds to 20 units of alcohol blood volume, compared to the maximum of 100. Certain effects constantly scale with the amount of alcohol in your system, starting off rare and increasing in frequency as you get more drunk:
 - Blood viscosity, consciousness, respiratory rate, and pain decrease
 - Sickness and mood increase
 - You may periodically vomit, trip and fall, or say a random line
At 80 ABV or more, brain health will slowly decrease, and ventricular fibrillation will slowly increase. ABV slowly decreases on its own over time.
- In an emergency, you can find a new medication called xylnase, which will instantly reduce ABV by 25, which at even the highest possible ABV, will save you from alcohol poisoning. The medication can also make you instantly vomit, as well as causing some fatigue and increase in temperature. All three of these side effects scale with how drunk you are (vomiting scales by increasing the chance; at 100 ABV you have an 85% chance to vomit when taking xylnase).
- A drinking session that exceeds 50 ABV will result in a subsequent hangover shortly after becoming fully sober. This reduces mood and increases pain and sickness.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/341]CUCoreLib[/url] by Jimmyking[/color]
[/size]That's it :3

[size=4][b]Credits![/b][/size]
- Comradefoxx, developer
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/nullrot]Nullrot[/url], idea-haver and sprite editor
Author: comradefoxx

Changelogs.Changelog:
- Fixed bug where different severity intoxication moodles would briefly overlap.
- Intoxication now applies a wavy effect to the screen similar to that of heatstroke, and also slurs the player's speech above 50%.
- Added hangovers, which kick in one minute after full sobriety following an intoxicaion of 50% or more. Causes sickness, unhappiness, poor consciousness, and pain. Lasts for 2 minutes.
- All three liquor bottles now scale their weight as they fill.
- Halved the sell values of all liquors.
- Vanilla "alcohol" liquid now gives ABV (0.15 base amount per ml, compared to 0.21 of vodka for example).
- Renamed ethanex to xylnase.
- Added a description to whiskey.
- Added liquid courage, a new liquor which can only be found in mini barrels. It provides alcohol as well as stimulant when drank.
- Added pox, a new liquor made from alcohol, tree sap, flour, and helluce.
- Slightly retextured the regular-tier shot glass and drunk and wasted moodles.
- Decreased the weight of the makeshift shot glass and increased the weight of the metal flask.
- Fixed a bug where drinking after using the heal command would absolutely destroy your mood.
- Pain is now constantly numbed while drunk instead of only at the beginning.
- Fixed a bug where the alcohols' antiseptic qualities did not work.

- Fixed bug where an MP host drinking liquor would intoxicate all clients.
- Fixed bug where the intoxication moodles could appear on the death screen.

Name: Variant Organisms
Summary: VariantOrganisms adds 10 carefully designed variant creatures to Casualties Unknown, seamlessly integrated into vanilla world generation. Each creature features unique ecological niches, stats, and behaviors.为《Casualties Unknown》新增 10 种精心设计的变种生物，无缝融入原版世界生成，每种生物拥有独立的生态位。
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
[b]English:[/b]
VariantOrganisms adds 10 brand-new variant creatures to [i]Casualties Unknown[/i], each with unique stats, behaviors, and ecological niches. All creatures are seamlessly integrated into the game's vanilla world generation, appearing in specific layers at appropriate densities. The mod is built on top of [b]CreatureKit[/b], a powerful enemy registration and spawning API that makes creature creation as simple as filling out a form — no complex prefab assembly required. All creature names and descriptions automatically switch between English and Chinese based on the game's current language setting, with full support for community Chinese translations (WC.json).

Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Item: Portable blast shower. Activate to start a five second timer. At the end of the timer, the item blasts hot steam at you, cleaning off dirt and increasing wetness and temperature. Standing too close to the blast increases the other effects, but causes skin damage and pain as well as weakly launching the player. The searing heat also burns away a moderate amount of infection. Failing to refill the tank causes a large explosion.

Trap: Blast vent. Spawns on the walls similar to oil pipes. Getting too close triggers a 1.2 second timer that once again causes a blast of steam. The steam from the blast vent causes far more pain and skin damage than the blast shower, and launches the player much farther. The blast vent only triggers once before deactivating.

Name: Player List Patch
Summary: A manual and incredibly crude fix for a multiplayer bug. (Version 4.0.1). Bug being caused by latejoining players, who are not shown by arrow when off screen.
Description:
Adds a new console command that theoretically fixes a problem with multiplayer.
This mod was originally meant only for myself but after hearing someone else have this bug as well I decided to release it.

The original bug this is meant to fix is that when playing as a client, players who join after you mid game aren't properly added by the multiplayer mod, leading to several bugs. (ones I have seen myself: holding shift or opening the menu does not create the arrow that shows where and how far said player is if they are off screen, inability to spectate said player, if sleeping is enabled and all but the affected players are asleep the game goes mad and tries to increase timescale when it shouldn't making sleeping very buggy though still sort of functional)
Might also fix an issue with multiplayer sprite replacer if this bug occurs but this is just speculation. (Skins of players joining after you always having your skin, rather than their own.)

Added commands are:
[list]
[*]PLPreset: Tries to fix the bug by clearing the player lists kept by multiplayer and readding all players into them.[/*]
[*]PLPstatus: Reads the relevant player lists and outputs to console, will also suggest running PLPreset if it sees a different number of players than there should be.[/*]
[/list]I only recommend using PLPreset if PLPstatus says to do so or if either of the following apply: 
[list=1]
[*]You are willing to risk completely breaking possibly everything.[/*]
[*]You know what you're doing.[/*]
[/list]Otherwise don't
The mod has been effective and bug free in my own usage, however I do not promise anything.
I also can't promise that any reported bugs will be fixed.
[line]
[color=#ff0000][size=4]I say again: This mod was not meant for public release. And it could easily break multiplayer.
I TAKE NO RESPONSIBILTY FOR ANYTHING THIS MIGHT BREAK![/size][/color]
[line]
[size=4]Installation  [/size]
[list]
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/341]CuCoreLib[/url] [/*]
[*]Download the file. (PlayerListPatch.zip)[/*]
[*]Extract into the BepInEx plugins folder. [/*]
[/list]
The console will show if the mod is installed.

[spoiler][size=3]To support vibration in your mod, add CUButt to your mod's soft dependencies. Also, check for CUButt each time you trigger vibration.[/size]
[i]Speed is a float between zero and one. Priority is integer[/i].

Almost all triggers have priority 0. Death - 100, dying, fibrillation and sound cannon - 1.


[i][b]VibrationManager.SetSpeed(speed, priority)[/b][/i] - sets the speed at the moment

[b][i]VibrationManager.AddSpeedSequence(list of speeds, priority)[/i][/b] - sets the vibration speed for the next few seconds. Each number in list represents 100 ms of vibration.[/spoiler]

Name: Cave Diver
Summary: A gameplay mod that adds new aquatic items and mechanics. It's time to take the plunge.
Description:
[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]
Cave Diver adds new aquatic items and gameplay mechanics to Casualties: Unknown (AKA Scav Prototype). As of version 1.03 the mod is still WIP and has a few minor bugs. It has NOT been tested with multiplayer, so I have no idea if it works.

*** NOTE ***
As of version 1.03 the Advanced Scuba Gear SHOULDN'T spawn naturally OR appear in the crafting menu. IT HAS NO FUNCTIONALITY because this mod's items are meant to replace it. If you playing version 1.03 and find an Advanced Scuba Gear spawn, PLEASE let me know immediately.

[b][size=5]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
Unpack the contents of the mod into Game/BepInEx/plugins

Your plugins folder should look like this:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/505/505-1785338932-505471934.png[/img]

[size=5][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Cave Diver adds new items that split the functionality of the vanilla game's Advanced Scuba Gear, adding new items with multiple tiers. It also add a special "Force Flooded Modifier" setting, which will force every layer to generate with a flooded modifier. The strength of the flooded modifier can be adjusted (up to 10x), and can even be set to increase with each subsequent layer. This setting can be disabled if you just want the new items and mechanics. [b]THESE NEW SETTINGS ARE IN GAME SETTINGS NOT RUN SETTINGS!!![/b][/color]

[b][size=4]ITEMS:[/size][/b]
[b]
[img width=97]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/505/505-1785339271-1241301393.png[/img] [/b]
[b][size=4]Swim Goggles[/size][/b]
The Swim goggles are a new wearable item that allows for clear vision underwater. Be careful though! They will start to leak when below 50% integrity, and you'll have to take them off to drain the water from them. They can also be knocked off your face if you take a strong blow too the head.


[img width=97]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/505/505-1785339473-559925466.png[/img] 
[b][size=4]Diving Mask[/size][/b]
The Diving Mask functions similarly to the Swim Goggles, allowing for clear vision while underwater. They have a higher durability than the Swim Goggles, and have a special feature. Because the Diving Mask covers your nose, water can be cleared from them with a strong exhale through the nose. This can be done while submerged, allowing you to restore clear vision ever while underwater. Just like the Swim Goggles, the Diving Mask will start to leak below 50% integrity, and can also be knocked off your face.


[img width=95]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/505/505-1785339818-621864159.png[/img]
[b][size=4]Wetsuit[/size][/b]
The Wetsuit is a bodysuit designed specifically to increase heat retention while in the water. It does this by trapping a layer of water between itself and the wearer, which is then heated by the wearer's body heat, keeping them warm. This means that then Wetsuit provides little insulation while dry, but provides significant insulation when wet. The Wetsuit is essential to preventing hypothermia while diving.


[img width=89]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/505/505-1785340019-414031892.png[/img]
[b][size=4]Life Vest[/size][/b]
The Life Vest is a type 2 Personal Flotation Device. When worn it drastically increased the wearer's buoyancy, causing them to float to the water's surface. The Life Vest will even keep the wearer's head above the water while they are unconscious. It can save your life if you unexpectedly tumble into the water, or is you are too exhausted to swim.



[img width=82]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/505/505-1785340215-1327148363.png[/img]
[b][size=4]Weighted Harness[/size][/b]
The Weighted Harness functions opposite of the Life Vest, drastically decreasing buoyancy when worn, making swimming virtually impossible. While dangerous it does have it's uses, as it will make the wearer sink in dense liquids like Lumalgae. The Weighted Harness is essential for navigating layers with high amounts of Lumalgae.



[img width=80]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/505/505-1785340495-1813605471.png[/img]
[b][size=4]Buoyance Control Device[/size][/b]
The Buoyancy Control Device (AKA BCD) does what the name suggests. When worn it manages the user's buoyancy for them automatically, keeping it as close to neutral as possible. It also allows the wearer to freely float or sink at will, allowing for fully freeform underwater movement with no stamina cost. Take note that due to input mapping, you cannot drink any fluids you are standing in while wearing it.



[img width=48]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/505/505-1785340768-795254350.png[/img]
[b][size=4]Air Tank[/size][/b]
The lifeline of every diver. The Air Tank holds pressurized air that can be breathed through the attached mouthpiece, called a Regulator. The Air Tank holds enough air for 30 minutes when submerged, and only decays when the user is breathing from it directly. Make sure that you have the Regulator in your mouth before you dive, or you won't be able to breathe! You can't use the Regulator if you're disfigured, and can't hold anything in your mouth while the Regulator is there. Additionally, a strong blow to the head will knock the Regulator out of your mouth so be careful! When crafted, the Air Tank will be empty, but can be refilled using the pumps sometimes found  in Lifepods, though this will break the pump since they were designed to pump liquid, not air.



[b]
[img width=89]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/505/505-1785341196-1993171521.png[/img][/b]
[b][size=4]Rebreather[/size][/b]
The Rebreather is another respiration device. It works by taking the air you exhale and re-oxygenizes it, allowing it to be breathed again. It runs on a large battery and supplies air for a whopping 80 minutes on a single charge. It also has a Regulator, just like the Air Tank, and all of it's specific interactions also apply here. It can be knocked out of your mouth by a strong blow to the head, and has to be in your mouth in order for you to breathe.



[img width=83]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/505/505-1785341609-107077360.png[/img]
[b][size=4]Makeshift Fins[/size][/b]
The Makeshift fins provide faster lateral movement while in the water. They have decent durability and are reletively easy to craft.



[img width=102]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/505/505-1785341705-185630707.png[/img]
[b][size=4]Fins[/size][/b]
The Fins are much more effective than the Makeshift Fins, and have higher durability. They also prevent you from getting washed away by water currents.


[b][size=5]ASPIRATION:[/size][/b]
[img width=110]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/505/505-1785341865-1040089944.png[/img]
Aspiration is a new status that makes drowning more dangerous and distinct from suffocation. Aspiration is when fluid is accidentally inhaled into the lungs, usually triggered by a gasp reflex. 

When Spo2 reaches below 45%, and the player has been holding their breath for at least 5 seconds, their gasp reflex will trigger, causing them to inhale. They'll swallow the liquid in an attempt to prevent it from entering the lungs but to no avail. Aspiration is very painful and causes rapid damage to the thorax while the lungs are filled with liquid. Luckily the player will automatically cough up the liquid once they are exposed back to air, but only if they are conscious and their thorax isn't too damaged.

BepinEx 5.4 and CUCoreLIb https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/341?tab=files

[size=5][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
MASSIVE thanks to JimmyKing, who lead me be the hand through the entire development process. This mod would not have been possible if not for their constant help and work on CUCoreLib.

Also thanks to Corells for playtesting and feedback.

[color=#efefef][size=4]Announcement and rant (feel free to ignore this part)[/size]
I have run out of mod ideas, so I likely wont be making anything else, at least not until the game releases. I will still be maintaining the mods and improving them if I figure out any ways to do so.
If someone has a suggestion feel free to send it on one of my mods or message me about it or whatever, though I am only going to be taking ideas for quality of life mods like the ones I have already made (and I mean actual quality of life, not making the game easier)

Another thing, content mods. I will not be making any. For one: I don't have any interest in adding new stuff to the game, and for two: I acknowledge and respect Orsoniks's wish for modding to be kept to a minimum until the game is released.
Obviously I have made a few mods, however these are just tiny tweaks to the game that I find convenient, and the mods I release are simply those but polished up to be released. I don't intend to take the show away from Orson and the vanilla game, instead, my mods are meant to be as unnoticeable as possible, without altering anything related to difficulty or gameplay (closest it gets is auto minigame tools making it slightly faster to deal with dislocations/shrapnel, but neither of those are life or death issues in my opinion, and the configuration exists for a reason). The point being, my mods are tiny tweaks for convenience, nothing more, and this will remain the case at least until the game releases.[/color]

Fixed scopes not zooming in
Your red dots, holos, and sniper scopes are no longer just fancy stickers! you can actually zoom in, instead of feeling like you're squinting at ants. Warning: zooming may reveal your enemies' ugly mugs – that's a feature, not a bug, mate.
Added ammo counter

Fixed attachments not adding weapon weight
That heavy stock finally feels heavy! Your gun now actually gains weight, slowing you down and draining stamina – we "fixed" a bug to make it more realistic and more painful. You're welcome.
Shotguns now have a muzzle slot
Shotty lovers, rejoice! You can now slap on silencers, brakes, and flash hiders. Sure, a silenced shotgun still sounds like a thunderclap, but at least it looks tacticool. Go ahead and turn your boomstick into a "tactical breaching tool" – we won't judge, but the wall will.

Added portable recipes for all attachments
No workbenches needed – just craft right from your inventory anytime, anywhere. All recipes use circuit boards and scrap metal (call it scraps if you like). The recipes were randomly generated by my silly head, but they totally make sense (probably). Your homemade parts might be a bit off, but they'll fit – just aim slightly left and call it "custom tuning".

We'll probably look at those bugs after we finish those three. Or not. But we'll say we will.

Name: CreatureKit
Summary: CreatureKit（有中文教程） lets you create custom enemies for Casualties Unknown as easily as filling out a form—no external dependencies needed. It fully supports the vanilla spawn command, includes three built-in AI types, and allows you to attach your own AI scripts for unlimited flexibility.
Description:
[size=6]CreatureKit v2.0.0[/size]

[size=5]Description[/size]
CreatureKit is a standalone enemy creation framework for *Casualties Unknown*, built on BepInEx and CUCoreLib. It turns the complex process of assembling a custom creature into a simple configuration object. Just define your enemy's stats and appearance, call one registration method, and CreatureKit handles the rest. 
CreatureKit 是一个为《Casualties Unknown》设计的独立敌人创建框架，基于 BepInEx 和 CUCoreLib 构建。它将组装自定义生物的复杂过程简化为一个配置对象。只需定义你的敌人属性和外观，调用一个注册方法，其余全部由 CreatureKit 处理。

The mod ships with three built‑in AI types—**SpiderHandler**, **SpiderHandlerTBE**, and **CrystalEnemy**—covering the most common vanilla behaviours. If you need completely custom logic, the `ConfigurePrefab` callback lets you attach your own MonoBehaviour scripts without touching the API source. 
本 Mod 内置三种 AI 类型——**SpiderHandler**、**SpiderHandlerTBE** 和 **CrystalEnemy**——覆盖了最常见的原版行为。如果你需要完全自定义逻辑，`ConfigurePrefab` 回调允许你挂载自己的 MonoBehaviour 脚本，而无需修改 API 源码。

All registered creatures are automatically compatible with the vanilla `spawn` command (with Tab autocomplete), so players can test and use them immediately. 
所有注册的生物都自动兼容原版的 `spawn` 命令（并支持 Tab 补全），玩家可以立即测试和使用它们。

Full documentation and tutorials are included in the download archive.
下载压缩包中包含完整文档、教程。

[size=5]Installation instructions[/size]
1. Install BepInEx 5.x for *Casualties Unknown* (if not already present). 
  安装适用于《Casualties Unknown》的 BepInEx 5.x（如果尚未安装）。

2. Install **CUCoreLib** (hard dependency) and place it in `BepInEx/plugins/CUCoreLib/`. 
  安装 **CUCoreLib**（硬依赖）并放入 `BepInEx/plugins/CUCoreLib/` 文件夹。

3. Download and extract this archive. 
  下载并解压本压缩包。

4. Copy `CreatureKit.dll` into your `BepInEx/plugins/CreatureKit/` folder. 
  将 `CreatureKit.dll` 复制到你的 `BepInEx/plugins/CreatureKit/` 文件夹。

5. Reference `CreatureKit.dll` in your own mod project and declare hard dependencies on `net.cucorelib` and `com.cixin.creaturekit`. 
  在你的 Mod 项目中引用 `CreatureKit.dll`，并声明对 `net.cucorelib` 和 `com.cixin.creaturekit` 的硬依赖。

6. Check the included TXT documentation for a step‑by‑step guide and example code. 
  查看附带的 TXT 文档以获取分步指南和示例代码。

[size=5]Main features[/size]
- Three built‑in AI types – SpiderHandler (standard shadecrawler), SpiderHandlerTBE (Thornback Elder), and CrystalEnemy (laser‑dash enemy). 
  三种内置 AI 类型 – SpiderHandler（标准暗影爬行者）、SpiderHandlerTBE（棘背兽）和 CrystalEnemy（水晶冲刺敌人）。

- Full customisation – Health, damage, perception, speed, leg appearance, collider shape, loot tables, sounds, and more. 
  全面自定义 – 生命值、伤害、感知、速度、腿部外观、碰撞体形状、掉落表、音效等。

- Custom AI support – Attach your own scripts via the `ConfigurePrefab` callback; disable or extend the built‑in AI as needed. 
  自定义 AI 支持 – 通过 `ConfigurePrefab` 回调挂载你自己的脚本；根据需要禁用或扩展内置 AI。

- Vanilla spawn integration – Your creatures work with the game's own `spawn` command and appear in its Tab‑completion list. 
  原版生成命令集成 – 你的生物可与游戏自带的 `spawn` 命令配合使用，并出现在 Tab 补全列表中。

- Multiplayer ready – Automatic sync across all clients when CUCoreLib and KrokMP are installed. 
  多人游戏就绪 – 当安装 CUCoreLib 和 KrokMP 时，自动在所有客户端间同步。

- Performance optimised – Spider enemies can automatically freeze physics and IK when far away or during time acceleration. 
  性能优化 – 蜘蛛敌人在远离玩家或游戏加速时可自动冻结物理和 IK。

- Attack animation scaling – Easily adjust the size of claw attack effects with `ClawAnimScale`. 
  攻击动画缩放 – 使用 `ClawAnimScale` 轻松调整爪击动画的大小。

- Asset loading via CUCoreLib – Use CCL's `AssetLoader` for embedded sprites; `TextureHelper` is provided for custom leg materials. 
  通过 CUCoreLib 加载资源 – 使用 CCL 的 `AssetLoader` 加载嵌入式精灵；提供 `TextureHelper` 用于自定义腿部材质。

Requirements
- Casualties Unknown (Playtest / Demo) 
- BepInEx 5.x 
- CUCoreLib v1.0.3 or newer  
- (Optional) KrokoshaCasualtiesMP for multiplayer

Shout outs  
- The BepInEx team for the powerful plugin framework. 
  感谢 BepInEx 团队提供强大的插件框架。

- The CUCoreLib project for inspiration on clean API design and solid multiplayer backbone. 
  感谢 CUCoreLib 项目提供清晰的 API 设计灵感和坚实的多人游戏基础。

- The modding community for constant feedback and testing. 
  感谢 Mod 社区不断的反馈和测试。
Author: CIXINLIN

Changelogs.Changelog:
CreatureKit v1.0.1
Fixed white border on sprites – Sprites now use FullRect mesh and proper texture settings, eliminating unwanted edges.
Added ResourceLoader.LoadMaterialFromEmbedded – Easily load leg materials from embedded textures.
Fixed Spider‑type enemy IK crash – Spider enemies now ignore body optimization by default, preventing null references in leg IK at long distances.
Added EnemyRegistry.ready property – Check this before spawning to ensure CreatureKit is fully initialized.

CreatureKit v1.0.3
Due to my capability issues, the multiplayer update in version 1.0.2 did not have the desired effect.
1-Reworked multiplayer sync – CreatureKit now uses CUCoreLib's MultiplayerApi as the sole bridge for multiplayer support. If CUCoreLib and KrokMP are installed, custom enemies are automatically synchronized across all clients. No hard dependency on CCL; if it's absent, sync is gracefully disabled after a timeout.
2-Added freezeOnHighTimeScale option – Spider-type enemies can now automatically freeze their rigidbodies and leg IK when the game is sped up and far from the player, preventing performance drops. Enabled by default; mod authors can disable it for boss units.

Name: EMI
Summary: A featureful and accessible crafting assistant and recipe viewer for Casualties: Unknown.（支持中文）
Description:
[size=5][b]EMI for Casualties: Unknown[/b][/size]
[quote]A featureful and accessible crafting assistant and recipe viewer for Casualties: Unknown.[/quote]This mod adds a crafting-tree assistant similar to the Minecraft [url=https://modrinth.com/mod/emi]EMI[/url] mod to the base game.
[b][url=https://github.com/Exmeow/EMI_for_CU]GitHub repo[/url][/b] here.

[img]https://pic.imgdd.cc/i/033xe7YZjA3vvjhnxPUrEe.png[/img]
[size=4][b]
What Does This Mod Bring to Crafting?[/b][/size]
EMI turns complex crafting processes into clear, actionable routes.
[list]
[*][b]Complete Crafting Tree planning[/b]: Break down recipes step by step, from the final product to the base materials you actually need to collect.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Remaining Materials list[/b]: Automatically accounts for items in your inventory, containers, and the surrounding area while skipping intermediate products you already have.[/*]
[*][b]Accurate handling of batch outputs and leftovers[/b]: Different branches can share surplus items produced by the same batch, preventing duplicate calculations.[/*]
[*][b]Proper tool durability handling[/b]: Needing to cut five times does not mean you need to craft five knives.[/*]
[*][b]Automatic step highlighting[/b]: Recipes you can currently perform are highlighted and moved to the top, guiding you through the entire crafting route.[/*]
[*][b]Intelligence risk warnings[/b]: Checks the highest INT requirement among the remaining steps and warns you when your INT may be insufficient.[/*]
[*][b]Flexible route selection[/b]: Choose between different recipes for the same product, or assign specific items and liquids to abstract quality requirements.[/*]
[*][b]Persistent defaults[/b]: Favorite commonly used recipes and quality choices to apply them automatically in future plans.[/*]
[*][b]Complete resource catalog[/b]: Browse and search all items, liquids, and crafting qualities in the game.[/*]
[*][b]Quick recipe lookup[/b]: Left-click to view how a resource is produced, or right-click and middle-click to see where it is used, with the original in-game tooltips.[/*]
[*][b]Collapsible Crafting Tree[/b]: Hide downstream steps you do not currently need to see. Nodes using the same recipe are collapsed together without affecting planning calculations.[/*]
[*][b]Analysis and display only[/b]: EMI does not modify the base game's crafting rules, material consumption, or recipe execution logic.[/*]
[/list]From “I want to make this item” to “What should I collect, and what should I craft first?”, EMI organizes everything in between.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
Make sure you have installed BepInEx first.
Place the EMI folder in BepInEx/plugins/. It should contain:
[list]
[*]EMI.dll[/*]
[*]EMI.pdb[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]For instructions, see: [url=https://github.com/Exmeow/EMI_for_CU/blob/main/guide-en.md]User Guide[/url][/b][/size]

EMI 能把复杂的制作过程变成一条清晰、可执行的路线。
[list]
[*][b]中文与英文界面支持[/b]：同时兼容游戏的社区中文语言包。[/*]
[*][b]完整的合成树规划[/b]：从最终产物逐层拆解配方，直至得到实际需要收集的基础材料。[/*]

[*][b]精确处理批量产出与副产物余量[/b]：不同分支可以共享同一批配方产生的剩余物品，避免重复计算。[/*]
[*][b]正确处理工具耐久[/b]：需要切割五次，并不意味着你需要制作五把刀。[/*]
[*][b]自动标记当前步骤[/b]：当前能够执行的配方会高亮并置顶，让你按顺序完成整条制作路线。[/*]
[*][b]智力风险提示[/b]：汇总剩余步骤的最高智力要求，并自动提示智力不足的风险。[/*]
[*][b]灵活的路线选择[/b]：为同一产物选择不同配方，或为抽象性质需求指定具体物品和液体。[/*]
[*][b]可持久化的默认方案[/b]：收藏常用配方与性质选择，之后规划时会自动应用。[/*]
[*][b]完整的资源图鉴[/b]：浏览和搜索游戏中的所有物品、液体及合成性质。[/*]
[*][b]快速查询配方关系[/b]：左键查看产出方式，右键或中键查看物品用途，并沿用原版悬浮提示。[/*]

Name: Simon Says
Summary: Looks like the researchers decided to implant your chip with a Simon Says modifier! Better listen to what it says or else punishments may be swift to come... Made for multiplayer!
Description:
[b][color=#d4d4d8][size=5]Simon Says[/size][/color][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8]
A host-run game of Simon Says for Casualties Unknown multiplayer. While you host a world, every so often it calls out a command in chat (e.g. [i]"Simon says JUMP!"[/i], [i]"Simon says look up!"[/i]) and every living player has a few seconds to obey. Miss the command, or fall for a "Simon didn't say" fake-out, and you get a random punishment: flung across the map, knocked out, electrocuted, amputated, and worse. Every action, punishment, message, and weight is editable in the config.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]KrokMP[/b] required. SimonSays only runs while you host a multiplayer world and stays idle without it.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Cheats enabled[/b] on the host.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Only the [b]host[/b] needs SimonSays. Other players just need KrokMP; effects replicate to them.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[/color]
[list=1]

[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install BepInEx and KrokMP first.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extract this archive into your game folder so you get [font=Courier New]BepInEx/plugins/SimonSays/SimonSays.dll[/font] and [font=Courier New]BepInEx/config/simonsays.cfg[/font].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game and host a world.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]Usage[/b][/size]
Open the dev console and type [font=Courier New]simon[/font]:
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][font=Courier New]simon on[/font] / [font=Courier New]off[/font] / [font=Courier New]toggle[/font] - enable/disable[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][font=Courier New]simon interval <seconds>[/font] - time between rounds[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][font=Courier New]simon decoy <0..1>[/font] - chance of a "Simon didn't say" fake-out round[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][font=Courier New]simon round[/font] - fire one now[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][font=Courier New]simon reload[/font] - reload the config after editing[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][font=Courier New]simon update[/font] - check for a new version[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][font=Courier New]simon status[/font] - current settings[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
Edit [font=Courier New]BepInEx/config/simonsays.cfg[/font], then [font=Courier New]simon reload[/font]. Set the announce prefix, response window, and decoy chance; give every action its own weight and announce lines; and give every punishment a weight and custom display names. The success/fail messages are fully editable too, with [font=Courier New]{player}[/font] and [font=Courier New]{punishment}[/font] placeholders.

[size=4][b]Updates[/b][/size]
SimonSays checks for new versions on startup and offers a one-click update when one is available.[/color]

Name: Auto Minigame Tools
Summary: Tired of digging around your material pouch for tweezers and lockpicks? Well good news, This fixes that! Minigames (configurable: lockpicking, dislocation, shrapnel) will always use their respective tools if it is present anywhere in your inventory, including containers.
Description:
Lockpicking, dislocation, and shrapnel minigames will search your inventory and containers for the applicable tool (lockpick, wrench, tweezers) before starting the minigame, and if found will automaticaly place it in your hand when the minigame starts.

This mod is also configurable, allowing you to choose which tools should be checked for, or none if you wish to disable the mod.

[size=4]Installation  [/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/341]CuCoreLib[/url] 
[color=#ff7700]Note: If you have CuCoreLib 1.0.3, the settings menu will be buggy although still functional. however I would recommend updating to 1.0.4.[/color] [/*]
[*]Download the file. (AutoMinigameTools.zip) [/*]
[*]Extract into the BepInEx plugins folder. [/*]
[/list]
The console will show if the mod is installed.

[size=4]Compatability[/size]
Should be compatible with anything. If not, complain and I might fix it.
It is multiplayer compatible (client and/or host side).

[size=4]Announcement and rant (feel free to ignore this part)[/size]
I have run out of mod ideas, so I likely wont be making anything else, at least not until the game releases. I will still be maintaining the mods and improving them if I figure out any ways to do so.
If someone has a suggestion feel free to send it on one of my mods or message me about it or whatever, though I am only going to be taking ideas for quality of life mods like the ones I have already made (and I mean actual quality of life, not making the game easier)

Another thing, content mods. I will not be making any. For one: I don't have any interest in adding new stuff to the game, and for two: I acknowledge and respect Orsoniks's wish for modding to be kept to a minimum until the game is released.
Obviously I have made a few mods, however these are just tiny tweaks to the game that I find convenient, and the mods I release are simply those but polished up to be released. I don't intend to take the show away from Orson and the vanilla game, instead, my mods are meant to be as unnoticeable as possible, without altering anything related to difficulty or gameplay (closest it gets is auto minigame tools making it slightly faster to deal with dislocations/shrapnel, but neither of those are life or death issues in my opinion, and the configuration exists for a reason). The point being, my mods are tiny tweaks for convenience, nothing more, and this will remain the case at least until the game releases.

Name: Colorful Insides
Summary: Changes the color of blood and anything relevant (mini-games, moodles, world hazards). Compatible with Krokosha's MP, zv7i's MSR and most other mods.
Description:
[quote][size=4]"Bro is skittles."

[i]- GILGAMESH[/i][/size][/quote]


[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
All this mod does is replace the textures of your blood to another color of your choice in the RGB spectrum. It also replaces the visible blood on world hazards like spikestabbers, sawblades, and barbed wire fence and blood-related moodles (like bleeding, hemothorax, etc). The color should be visible to others in multiplayer if others also have the mod and [i][b][color=#ff7700][u]SPECIFICALLY[/u][/color][/b][/i] on skins with zv7i's Multiplayer Sprite Replacer. The mod should be universally compatible with other mods that add blood related textures, more on it in the README.txt that comes with the mod.

Built and tested on the v7.0.1 (Demo) version of Casualties: Unknown.


[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
1.) Have BepInEx (if not already installed, here is the [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases]link[/url])
2.) Drag "ColorfulInsides.dll" into "Bepinex\Plugins\"
3.) Enjoy.

[b][size=5]Main features[/size][/b]
1.) Changes the blood color that gets onto the walls and ground.
2.) Changes the moodle colors that have relation with blood.
3.) Adjusts the textures of blood-stained hazards.
4.) Changes the colors of mini-games (like shrapnel, amputations, and self-harm).
5.) Visible for other players in multiplayer and works with Multiplayer Sprite Replacer.
6.) Changes the color of other creatures.

[b][size=4]Commands for tech wannabes[/size][/b]
Sets the color of blood to the RGB values indicated:
[code]bloodcolor set [ R ] [ G ] [ B ][/code]Sets the color of blood to its default yellow:
[code]bloodcolor reset[/code]Saves the color to an assigned slot:
[code]bloodcolor save [ Slot name ] [ Slot number (1-10) ][/code]Loads the color from an assigned slot:
[code]bloodcolor load [ Slot name ][/code]
[b][color=#980000][size=5]Important:[/size][/color][/b]

Due to how the mod works, some unwanted textures might change colors if their hue resembles too much of the original yellow blood and its gradient. The settings can be adjusted in the config files that are generated after the first launch, world enter and meeting with a creature.

Also, if the blood you want to recolor is not the default yellow, it obviously will not be caught by the mod. Don't expect it to be affected.

Pretty recommended to read the README.txt. It is long but informative.

[size=5]Note[/size]
[size=3]- [i][u]No compatibility was or will be made with any other skin mods beside zv7i's Multiplayer Sprite Replacer[/u][/i]. So do not be surprised if other skin mods do not work, and if they do, well, good.[/size]

[size=3]- Jimmyking's QoL Unknown mod shifts the tab button from outside the frame to inside the frame. This is expected behavior and does not affect mod's functionality.[/size]

[size=3]- Skin damage shown on the Expie might look distorted and leaning towards red. The explanation to it is given in "NOTE" in the "Troubleshooting" section inside the README.txt.[/size]

[size=5]Hand-tested Compatibilites [/size][size=2](does not follow the updates, just the first-time test)[/size][size=5]:[/size]

[size=4]- Casualties Together[/size]
[size=4]- Multiplayer Sprite Replacer[/size]
[size=4]- Shrapnel Variants[/size]
[size=4]- Casualties Unknown Resprite[/size]
[size=4]- QoL Unknown[/size]
[size=4]- Mood Reimagined[/size]
[size=4]- Alexx_'s Medical Brutalism [/size][size=2](add "hemo" into the BloodTextures.txt file)[/size]
[size=4]- Transparent Syringes[/size]
[size=4]- Cu-BloodBank [/size][size=2](follows the "Unknown Owner Uses Your Color" parameter.)[/size]

[size=5]Incompatible mods:[/size]

[size=4]- Red Blood[/size]   [size=2](Works together but you will see inconsistencies and bugs. Pick either one or the other.)[/size]

[size=4]Shoutouts:[/size]
[size=3][u]Everyone[/u] who pointed out bugs and suggested me things (even if they were not added).[/size]

Name: ServerModLoader
Summary: KrokMP add-on: on Join, clients pull missing mod folders from the host (DLL + Content). Always allows join. Full download, then Steam relaunch and auto-rejoin. Defender scan, outdated-mod warning, cache cleanup. Required on both host and client.
Description:
[center][size=5][b]ServerModLoader by Staili[/b][/size]
[b]Version:[/b] 1.2.0 · [b]Plugin:[/b] ServerModLoaderByStaili.dll
[b]Requires:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/67]KrokMP[/url]
[b]GitHub:[/b] [url=https://github.com/naduvaha/ServerModLoader/releases]Releases[/url]
[/center]

[size=4][b]Русский[/b][/size]

[b]Описание[/b]
Дополнение к мультиплеер-моду [b]KrokoshaCasualtiesMP (KrokMP)[/b] для [b]Casualties Unknown[/b].
При Join клиент может получить недостающие моды [b]с хоста[/b] (DLL + Content и прочие файлы).
[b]Nexus / GitHub CDN нет[/b] — только передача с хоста.
На сервер [b]всегда пускает[/b], даже если модов не хватает или хост без этого плагина.

[b]Синхронизация при Join[/b]
[list]
[*]Если у хоста есть ServerModLoader и моды, которых нет у клиента — хост шлёт [b]папки модов[/b] во время коннекта.[/*]
[*]Передаётся вся папка: DLL, Content/, resources, аудио, xml, png и т.д.[/*]
[*]Сохранение: [font=Courier New]BepInEx\plugins\SERVERCACHE\<хост>_<сервер>\[/font][/*]
[*]После [b]полной[/b] передачи (папки проверены на диске) — рестарт через Steam (+2 сек), затем автозаход в тот же лобби.[/*]
[*]Если мод уже есть, но версия старше хоста — предупреждение по центру (RU/EN): возможны баги.[/*]
[*]Если у хоста нет ServerModLoader или передача не удалась — клиент всё равно заходит (без зависания).[/*]
[/list]
[b]Очистка кеша[/b]
[list]
[*]В браузере серверов KrokMP: [b]Очистить кеш модов / Clear mod cache[/b][/*]
[*]Можно удалить кеш одного сервера или все сразу[/*]
[*]UI на русском / английском (язык игры)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Защита[/b]
[list]
[*]После скачивания: Windows Defender (MpCmdRun) → онлайн hash-lookup (MalwareBazaar + ThreatFox)[/*]
[*]Для онлайн нужен бесплатный Auth-Key: [url=https://auth.abuse.ch/]auth.abuse.ch[/url] → [font=Courier New]Security.AbuseChAuthKey[/font][/*]
[*]При угрозе: [b]Довериться моду[/b] или [b]Исключить[/b][/*]
[*]Таймаут / недоступный скан — шаг пропускается, синк идёт дальше[/*]
[/list]
[b]Зависимости[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Обязательно:[/b] BepInEx 5.4.x[/*]
[*][b]Обязательно:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/67]KrokMP[/url][/*]
[/list][i]Для автораздачи плагин нужен и хосту, и клиенту. Без SML на хосте Join работает, но моды сами не приедут.[/i]

[b]Установка[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Установите BepInEx и KrokMP[/*]
[*]Скопируйте [font=Courier New]ServerModLoaderByStaili.dll[/font] в [font=Courier New]Casualties Unknown\BepInEx\plugins\[/font][/*]
[*]В логе: [font=Courier New]ServerModLoader by Staili loaded.[/font][/*]
[/list]
[b]Конфиг[/b]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]Sync.AutoSyncOnJoin[/font] (true) — тянуть моды с хоста при Join[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Sync.AutoRelaunch[/font] (true) — рестарт после успешной передачи[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Sync.AutoRejoinAfterRelaunch[/font] (true) — автозаход после рестарта[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Security.ScanWithWindowsDefender[/font] (true) — скан Defender[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Security.ScanOnlineHashLookup[/font] (true) — онлайн SHA256[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Security.AbuseChAuthKey[/font] — ключ с auth.abuse.ch[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Security.BlockIfScanUnavailable[/font] (false) — блокировать при ошибке скана[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Security.ScanTimeoutSeconds[/font] (120) / [font=Courier New]OnlineScanTimeoutSeconds[/font] (10)[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]English[/b][/size]

[b]About[/b]
An add-on for [b]KrokoshaCasualtiesMP (KrokMP)[/b] for [b]Casualties Unknown[/b].
On Join, the client can pull missing mods [b]from the host[/b] (DLL + Content and other files).
[b]No Nexus / GitHub CDN[/b] — host transfer only.
[b]Always allows join[/b], even if mods are missing or the host lacks this plugin.

[b]Sync on Join[/b]
[list]
[*]If the host has ServerModLoader and mods the client lacks — the host streams [b]full mod folders[/b] during connect.[/*]
[*]Full folder: DLL, Content/, resources, audio, xml, png, etc.[/*]
[*]Saved under: [font=Courier New]BepInEx\plugins\SERVERCACHE\<host>_<server>\[/font][/*]
[*]After a [b]full[/b] transfer (folders verified on disk) — Steam relaunch (+2s), then auto-rejoin.[/*]
[*]If a mod is already installed but older than the host — centered warning (RU/EN): bugs may occur.[/*]
[*]If the host has no ServerModLoader or transfer fails — the client still joins (no hang).[/*]
[/list]
[b]Clear cache[/b]
[list]
[*]KrokMP server browser: [b]Clear mod cache / Очистить кеш модов[/b][/*]
[*]Delete one server cache or all[/*]
[*]UI follows game language (RU/EN)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Protection[/b]
[list]
[*]After host-pull: Windows Defender (MpCmdRun) → online hash lookup (MalwareBazaar + ThreatFox)[/*]
[*]Online needs a free Auth-Key from [url=https://auth.abuse.ch/]auth.abuse.ch[/url] → [font=Courier New]Security.AbuseChAuthKey[/font][/*]
[*]On threat: [b]Trust mod[/b] or [b]Exclude[/b][/*]
[*]Timeout / unavailable scan — step skipped, sync continues[/*]
[/list]
[b]Dependencies[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Required:[/b] BepInEx 5.4.x[/*]
[*][b]Required:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/67]KrokMP[/url][/*]
[/list][i]For auto-share, both host and client need this plugin. Without SML on the host, Join still works — mods just won’t be sent.[/i]

[b]Install[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install BepInEx + KrokMP[/*]
[*]Drop [font=Courier New]ServerModLoaderByStaili.dll[/font] into [font=Courier New]Casualties Unknown\BepInEx\plugins\[/font][/*]
[*]Log should show: [font=Courier New]ServerModLoader by Staili loaded.[/font][/*]
[/list]
[b]Config[/b]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]Sync.AutoSyncOnJoin[/font] (true) — pull mods from host on Join[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Sync.AutoRelaunch[/font] (true) — Steam relaunch after successful transfer[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Sync.AutoRejoinAfterRelaunch[/font] (true) — auto-rejoin after relaunch[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Security.ScanWithWindowsDefender[/font] (true) — Defender scan[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Security.ScanOnlineHashLookup[/font] (true) — online SHA256[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Security.AbuseChAuthKey[/font] — key from auth.abuse.ch[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Security.BlockIfScanUnavailable[/font] (false) — reject on scan error[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Security.ScanTimeoutSeconds[/font] (120) / [font=Courier New]OnlineScanTimeoutSeconds[/font] (10)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Release contents[/b]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]ServerModLoaderByStaili.dll[/font] — into BepInEx\plugins\[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]README.md[/font] — this readme[/*]
[/list]
[line]

(example being: for clients when playing multiplayer, the host will always have accurate countdowns)

[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
Uhh
I don't know, but it should be compatible with anything? If not, complain and I might fix it.
It is multiplayer compatible (client and/or host side) the host's countdowns will always be accurate, but the countdowns seen by clients are only roughly accurate.

[size=4]Announcement and rant (feel free to ignore this part)[/size]
I have run out of mod ideas, so I likely wont be making anything else, at least not until the game releases. I will still be maintaining the mods and improving them if I figure out any ways to do so.
If someone has a suggestion feel free to send it on one of my mods or message me about it or whatever, though I am only going to be taking ideas for quality of life mods like the ones I have already made (and I mean actual quality of life, not making the game easier)

Another thing, content mods. I will not be making any. For one: I don't have any interest in adding new stuff to the game, and for two: I acknowledge and respect Orsoniks's wish for modding to be kept to a minimum until the game is released.
Obviously I have made a few mods, however these are just tiny tweaks to the game that I find convenient, and the mods I release are simply those but polished up to be released. I don't intend to take the show away from Orson and the vanilla game, instead, my mods are meant to be as unnoticeable as possible, without altering anything related to difficulty or gameplay (closest it gets is auto minigame tools making it slightly faster to deal with dislocations/shrapnel, but neither of those are life or death issues in my opinion, and the configuration exists for a reason). The point being, my mods are tiny tweaks for convenience, nothing more, and this will remain the case at least until the game releases.
