Name: MultyModik
Summary: KrokMP add-on: team respawn, mob scaling, spider boss, hugs, per-layer extra weapons, sleep-buddy mood. Run-rules menu.
Description:
[center][b]MultyModik[/b]
[size=2][i]Multiplayer gameplay expansion for Casualties Unknown[/i][/size][/center]
[line]

[b]Description[/b]
[size=2]A BepInEx plugin by [b]Staili[/b] — add-on for [b]KrokoshaCasualtiesMP (KrokMP)[/b] in [b]Casualties Unknown[/b]. One DLL, no game file edits, drop into [i]BepInEx\plugins\[/i].

Extends the KrokMP run-rules menu with team respawns, mob scaling, a spider mini-boss, hugs, extra weapons per layer, sleep mood bonus, and more. Host configures everything in the lobby rules — settings sync to all clients.[/size]
[line]

[b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Team respawns[/b] — shared team pool (configurable). Spectator self-respawn near a living ally (cooldown). Code-based ally revive: dead player gets a code, any living player can type it to bring them back. Honors [i]keep inventory[/i] / [i]keep stats[/i] rules.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Mob scaling[/b] — hostile spawn multiplier 100% (vanilla) up to 1000%. Floor scales with respawn limit (4+ → 200%, 40+ → 600%, 50 → 1000%). Separate [i]mission time[/i] slider (1–300%) with spawn penalties.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Water physics[/b] — [i]no water knockdown[/i] option. Trade-off: +100% to minimum hostile spawn while enabled.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Big Spider boss[/b] — checkbox in rules menu. Spawns on layer 2 at ~60% depth. 1000 HP, aggressive AI, chews through blocks, horrified effect, +40 team mood on kill. Console: [i]bigspider spawn[/i], [i]bigspider spawn force[/i], [i]bigspider spawn cursor[/i], [i]bigspider pos[/i].[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Hugs[/b] — button below CPR in the wound view. Hugger loses nothing; huggee +1 mood every 4 s. Visual [i]+1[/i] floats and chat barks. Uses KrokMP piggyback attach when allowed.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Extra weapons[/b] — per-layer tabs [i]1..6[/i] + 5 sliders (sound cannon, sand turret, electric coil, gun mine, mine). 0% = vanilla untouched, 100% = natural density, up to 1000%. Placed after worldgen, synced via rules preset.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Sleep mood[/b] — 2+ players sleeping within ~6 blocks slowly gain mood. Fully server-side, automatic.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases]BepInEx 5.4.x[/url] — [i]winhttp.dll[/i] next to [i]CasualtiesUnknown.exe[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/67]Casualties Together (KrokMP)[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Install CUCoreLib and [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/QoL-Unknown/releases]QoL.Unknown[/url] → [i]BepInEx\plugins\[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Copy [i]MultyModikByStaili.dll[/i] to [i]BepInEx\plugins\[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Create or join a multiplayer session — new options appear in the **run-rules menu**[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]All players in the lobby must run the same plugin + KrokMP version[/size][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Required mods (Nexus):[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/67][b]Casualties Together (KrokMP)[/b][/url] — multiplayer, run-rules menu, sync[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]CUCoreLib— [i]CUCoreLib.dll[/i] in [i]BepInEx\plugins\[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/QoL-Unknown/releases]QoL.Unknown[/url] — [i]QoL Unknown.dll[/i] in [i]BepInEx\plugins\[/i] (GitHub; Mods tab + **GIT** button)[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Required (non-mod):[/b] Casualties Unknown + BepInEx 5.4.x (Windows x64)[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Required (non-mod):[/b] Active multiplayer session (host + clients)[/size][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[b]Notes[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]Settings are in the KrokMP **run-rules menu** before starting a run[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]May conflict with other mods patching [i]SpiderHandler[/i], mob spawn, or the wound-view UI[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Used by ModikStreamer for the [i]big_spider_boss[/i] donation event (optional)[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Optional: [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/QoL-Unknown/releases]QoL.Unknown[/url] [/size][/*]
[/list]

Name: ModikDialog
Summary: LLM trader dialogues: Qwen2.5-3B + llama-server (CPU). RMB — Talk/Trade/Leave. You supply model and llama.cpp (~2 GB).
Description:
[center][b]ModikDialog[/b]
[size=2][i]LLM trader dialogues for Casualties Unknown[/i][/size][/center]
[line]

[b]Description[/b]
[size=2]A BepInEx plugin by [b]Staili[/b] for [b]Casualties Unknown[/b] single-player trader dialogue. Right-click any trader — get a custom menu instead of instant barter.

Talk to traders with a local AI model: replies use your reputation, their stock, what you're holding, and your current state. No cloud API, no API key — everything runs on your PC via [i]llama-server[/i] (llama.cpp) + [i]Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct[/i] GGUF (~2 GB, manual download).[/size]
[line]

[b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Trader menu[/b] — right-click a trader: [i]Talk / Trade / Leave[/i] (RU: [i]Общаться / Торговать / Уйти[/i]). [b]Trade[/b] opens the vanilla barter window.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]LLM dialogue[/b] — [b]Talk[/b] starts a conversation: greeting, speech bubbles, clickable question buttons. Each answer is generated locally.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Game context[/b] — the model sees trader reputation, inventory, item in hand, and player state for relevant replies.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Languages[/b] — RU / EN auto-detected from game locale (no manual language setting).[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Performance[/b] — profiles [i]Fast[/i] / [i]Balanced[/i] / [i]Quality[/i] in [i]settings.conf[/i]. CPU-only, no GPU required (AVX2, 4+ cores recommended).[/size][/*]
[/list][line]

[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases]BepInEx 5.4.x[/url] — [i]winhttp.dll[/i] next to [i]CasualtiesUnknown.exe[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Install CUCoreLib and [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/QoL-Unknown/releases]QoL.Unknown[/url] → [i]BepInEx\plugins\[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Create [i]BepInEx\plugins\ModikDialog\[/i] and copy [i]ModikDialog.dll[/i] there[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Download [url=https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases]llama.cpp[/url] ([i]llama-*-bin-win-cpu-x64.zip[/i]) — extract into [i]BepInEx\plugins\ModikDialog\models\llama\[/i] ([i]llama-server.exe[/i] + DLLs)[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Download [url=https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-GGUF]Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct Q4_K_M[/url] (~2 GB) → [i]BepInEx\plugins\ModikDialog\models\qwen2.5-3b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Right-click a trader in-game — the custom menu appears on the left[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Settings: [i]BepInEx\plugins\ModikDialog\models\settings.conf[/i] (fallback: [i]BepInEx\config\ModikDialogByStaili.cfg[/i])[/size][/*]
[/list](mirror download - https://github.com/naduvaha/ModikDialog/releases)
[line]

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Required mods (Nexus):[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]CUCoreLib — [i]CUCoreLib.dll[/i] in [i]BepInEx\plugins\[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b][url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/QoL-Unknown/releases]QoL.Unknown[/url] [/b]— [i]QoL Unknown.dll[/i] in [i]BepInEx\plugins\[/i][/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Required (non-mod):[/b] Casualties Unknown Demo + BepInEx 5.4.x (Windows x64)[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Required (non-mod):[/b] [url=https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases]llama-server[/url] + [url=https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-GGUF]Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct GGUF[/url] (~2 GB) — manual download, mod does not fetch files[/size][/*]

Name: CasualtiesUnknown-Tarkov-Style Weapon Mod
Summary: A BepInEx mod for Casualties: Unknown Demo that brings Escape from Tarkov-inspired weapons into the game - 13 custom firearms, 2 melee weapons, 9 ammo types, and 9 magazines with a fully integrated caliber isolation system, weighted world spawns, and melee weapon drops.
Description:
Casualties: Unknown - Tarkov-Style Weapon Mod
Version: 1.0.3.0
A BepInEx mod for Casualties: Unknown Demo that brings Escape from Tarkov-inspired weapons into the game - 13 custom firearms, 2 melee weapons, 9 ammo types, and 9 magazines with a fully integrated caliber isolation system, weighted world spawns, melee weapon drops, and KrokMP multiplayer compatibility.
> **Requires:** CUTarkovMedicalMod and CUCoreLib must be installed first. This mod has a hard dependency on both.
---
REQUIREMENTS
- Game: Casualties: Unknown Demo (Steam)
- Mod Loader: BepInEx 5.x
- Required Mods: CUCoreLib + CUTarkovMedicalMod (install in this order)
Installing BepInEx:
1. Download BepInEx 5.x stable (x64) from https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases
2. Extract into your game root folder (Steam/steamapps/common/Casualties Unknown Demo/)
3. Launch the game once to generate the BepInEx/ folder, then close it
---
INSTALLATION
1. Install CUCoreLib first
2. Install CUTarkovMedicalMod
3. Download CUTarkovWeaponMod_v1.0.3.0.zip
4. Extract the contents into your game root folder
  - After extraction:
    [Game Root]/BepInEx/plugins/CUTarkovWeaponMod/
      - CUTarkovWeaponMod.dll
      - Framework/Assets/  (weapon icons + gun sound effects)
      - Lang/              (EN.json, zh_CN.json)
5. Launch the game
Verify: check BepInEx/LogOutput.log for "Casualties: Unknown - Tarkov-Style Weapon Mod loaded."
---
WHAT'S NEW IN v1.0.3
- CUCoreLib hard dependency: migrated from soft dependency to hard dependency, removed Legacy mode and factory pattern
- KrokMP multiplayer compatibility:
  - World generation (supply crates/corpses/airdrops) only runs on host, clients receive items via KrokMP sync
  - Ammo/magazine unloading changed to world drop (FreshItemDrop) in multiplayer to prevent items going to host inventory
  - Synced weapons/mags/ammo display correct custom sprites (template pre-creation calls ConfigureCustomItem)
  - Inventory thumbnails show correct magazine/no-magazine state
- Console autocomplete fix: Command.argAutofill type corrected to Dictionary<int, List<string>>
- Melee weapon qualities:
  - Red Rebel ice axe: cutting 12 / hammering 18 / backflip / cangetwet / tool
  - M-2 tactical sword: cutting 30 / hammering 12 / backflip / cangetwet / tool
  - Hover description fix: no longer overwrites native detail page
- Magazine adjustments: all magazine values set to 2; UMP45 magazine icon resolution fixed (48x120 -> 13x32)
---
FEATURES
- 13 custom firearms: bolt-action snipers, semi-auto carbines, full-auto rifles, pump/semi-auto shotguns, pistols, SMG, PDW, LMG
- 2 melee weapons: Red Rebel ice axe (climbing + cutting + hammering) and M-2 tactical sword (cutting + hammering), with backflip tag for vertical back display
- 9 custom ammo types with dedicated calibers
- 9 custom magazines with correct capacity and crafting recipes
- Caliber isolation system: three-layer Harmony patches prevent cross-caliber loading
- Weighted world spawns: 35% pistol / 20% SKS+shotgun / 17% SMG / 13% rifle / 10% sniper / 5% LMG
- Melee weapon drops: 13% chance in supply crates (40% ice axe / 60% M-2 sword)
- Container drops: supply crates (6.6% gun + 10% mag), corpses (3% gun + 3% mag), airdrops (3% gun)
- Gun sound effects: unique fire/bolt/close/mag-in/mag-out sounds per weapon
- Preloaded melee swing sounds for instant playback without I/O lag
- Crafting system: magazines and ammo craftable via recipes
- Vanilla weapon replacement: original weapons/ammo/magazines blocked
- AXMC scope zoom: extended field of view when equipped
- UMP45 built-in suppressor: noise 0.2, muzzle flash disabled
- Console spawn support for all custom items
- Auto-update checker with download, progress bar, and one-click update
- Bilingual: English and Simplified Chinese
- KrokMP multiplayer compatible: host-only world generation, world drop for unloaded items, proper sprite sync
---
13 FIREARMS
1. AXMC (axmc) - Bolt-action sniper | .338 LM | 10-round mag | 310 bio dmg | Scope zoom
2. DVL-10 (dvl10) - Bolt-action sniper | 7.62x51 | 10-round mag | 205 bio dmg
3. SKS (sks) - Semi-auto carbine | 7.62x39 | 10-round internal | 150 bio dmg
4. AKM (akm) - Full-auto rifle | 7.62x39 | 30-round mag | 120 bio dmg
5. Desert Eagle (deagle) - Semi-auto pistol | .50 AE | 7-round mag | 110 bio dmg
6. M4A1 (m4a1) - Full-auto rifle | 5.56x45 | 30-round mag | 90 bio dmg
7. RPD (rpd) - Full-auto LMG | 7.62x39 | 100-round belt | 87 bio dmg
8. Glock 17 (glock17) - Semi-auto pistol | 9x19 | 17-round mag | 50 bio dmg
9. P90 (p90) - Full-auto PDW | 5.7x28 | 50-round mag | 45 bio dmg
10. UMP45 (ump45) - Full-auto SMG | .45 ACP | 25-round mag | 44 bio dmg | Built-in suppressor
11. MP-153 (mp153) - Semi-auto shotgun | 12 gauge | 8-round internal | 41 bio dmg | 8 pellets
12. MP-133 (mp133) - Pump shotgun | 12 gauge | 4-round internal | 40 bio dmg | 8 pellets
13. HK USP (usp) - Semi-auto pistol | .45 ACP | 12-round mag | 40 bio dmg
---
2 MELEE WEAPONS
1. Red Rebel Ice Axe (redrebel) - 37 bio dmg / 35 block dmg | Range 4 | Knockback 270 | INT 5 | Cutting 12 | Hammering 18 | Special: wall-climb when held in main hand, backflip
2. M-2 Tactical Sword (m2sword) - 87 bio dmg / 31 block dmg | Range 7 | Knockback 320 | INT 5 | Cutting 30 | Hammering 12 | backflip
---
9 AMMO TYPES
1. .338 LM UCW (338ucw) - For AXMC
2. 7.62x51 BPZ (76251bpz) - For DVL-10
3. 7.62x39 SP (76239sp) - For SKS / AKM / RPD
4. 12/70 8.5mm (12g85) - For MP-133 / MP-153
5. .50 AE Copper (50copper) - For Desert Eagle
6. .45 ACP FMJ (45fmj) - For UMP45 / USP
7. 9x19 PSO (919pso) - For Glock 17
8. 5.56x45 FMJ (55645fmj) - For M4A1
9. 5.7x28 SB193 (5728sb193) - For P90
---
9 MAGAZINES
1. AXMC Magazine (axmc_mag) - 10 rounds | Value 2
2. DVL-10 Magazine (dvl10_mag) - 10 rounds | Value 2
3. AKM Magazine (akm_mag) - 30 rounds | Value 2
4. Desert Eagle Magazine (deagle_mag) - 7 rounds | Value 2
5. Glock 17 Magazine (glock17_mag) - 17 rounds | Value 2
6. M4A1 Magazine (m4a1_mag) - 30 rounds | Value 2
7. P90 Magazine (p90_mag) - 50 rounds | Value 2
8. UMP45 Magazine (ump45_mag) - 25 rounds | Value 2
9. USP Magazine (usp_mag) - 12 rounds | Value 2
---
CALIBER ISOLATION SYSTEM
Three-layer Harmony patches ensure each firearm only accepts its designated ammo caliber:
- GunScript.LoadMag - magazine-to-gun caliber check
- AmmoScript.LoadRound - ammo-to-magazine caliber check
- AmmoScript.UnloadRound - prevents incorrect ammo unloading
Shared calibers:
- 7.62x39: SKS / AKM / RPD
- 12 gauge: MP-133 / MP-153
- .45 ACP: UMP45 / USP
---
CONSOLE SPAWN
All items spawnable via: spawn [itemkey]
Examples: spawn axmc, spawn akm, spawn 338ucw, spawn akm_mag, spawn redrebel, spawn m2sword, spawn usp
Toggle vanilla weapons: spawn vanilla_on / spawn vanilla_off
---
AUTO-UPDATE
The mod includes a built-in update checker:
- Automatically checks for new versions on startup
- Two update options: Auto Update (download + install + restart) or Release Page
- Download progress bar with speed indicator
- Cancel download at any time
- Auto-timeout on stalled downloads
- One-click restart after update
---
COMPATIBILITY
- Requires CUCoreLib + CUTarkovMedicalMod (hard dependency)
- KrokMP: compatible (host-only world generation, world drop for unloaded items, sprite sync)
- Other BepInEx mods: should be compatible (unique GUID, independent Harmony patches)
---
UNINSTALL
Delete BepInEx/plugins/CUTarkovWeaponMod/ folder.
---
SOURCE CODE
Open source on GitHub: https://github.com/hmm1313133/CUTarkovWeaponMod
---
BUG REPORTS & FEEDBACK
Report bugs and suggestions on GitHub Issues: https://github.com/hmm1313133/CUTarkovWeaponMod/issues
Please include:
1. Mod version (1.0.3.0)
2. Game version
3. BepInEx version
4. Other installed mods
5. Steps to reproduce
6. Log file (BepInEx/LogOutput.log)
7. Screenshots if applicable
Please check existing issues before posting to avoid duplicates.
---
CREDITS
- Escape from Tarkov by Battlestate Games - original weapon designs and mechanics inspiration
- Casualties: Unknown - the base game
- BepInEx - modding framework
- Harmony - runtime patching library
- CUCoreLib - custom item infrastructure
---

Changelogs.Changelog:
### Added
- **NewFirearms IsOnBack fix** — patches `RshGun.IsOnBack()` with a Harmony finalizer to suppress `NullReferenceException` when `NetPlayer.GetNetPlayerFromBody(body)` returns `null` during world generation
- Only logs the warning once; subsequent exceptions are silently suppressed
- **NewFirearms HandleLegacyGunUi fix** — patches `PlayerCameraPatch1.HandleLegacyGunUi()` with a Harmony finalizer to suppress `NullReferenceException` when `__instance.body` is `null` during world generation
- **NewFirearms stun collider log spam** — suppresses repeated `Debug.LogWarning("[NewFirearms] Can not add stun collider...")` from `SpiderHandlerPatch.Postfix`; only the first occurrence is logged
- **NewClothing RshClothing fix** — patches `RshClothing.Update()` with a Harmony finalizer to suppress `NullReferenceException` when `this.it` is `null`
- **Krokosha GunScriptTrackerComponent fix** — patches `KrokoshaGunScriptTrackerComponent.Update()` with a Harmony finalizer to suppress `NullReferenceException` when `PlayerCamera.main.body` is `null`
### Changed
- **Project structure** — fixer classes extracted from `Plugin.cs` into `Fixers/NewFirearmsFix.cs`, `Fixers/NewClothingFix.cs`, and `Fixers/KrokoshaCasualtiesMPFix.cs`

### Added
- Added `BuildingEntityFix`: Fixes `BuildingEntity.Update()` throwing `ArgumentException` when
`Resources.Load("DustBig")` returns `null`.
### Changed
- Refactored all Fixers to use **Prefix interception** pattern, preventing exceptions at the source instead of catching
them after the fact.
- Extracted `FixerHelper` utility class to centralize type resolution, patch installation, and exception suppression.
- Switched to `Chainloader.PluginInfos` GUID matching for identifying installed mods.
### Fixed
- `RshClothing.Update()` NullReferenceException (`this.it` is null)
- `KrokoshaGunScriptTrackerComponent.Update()` NullReferenceException (`PlayerCamera.main.body` is null)
- `RshGun.MpScareCheck()` NullReferenceException
- `RshGun.IsOnBack()` NullReferenceException
- `PlayerCameraPatch1.HandleLegacyGunUi()` NullReferenceException

### Changed
- Renamed `BuildingEntityFix` to `GameFix`, dedicated to vanilla game fixes.
- Renamed `Finalizer` method to `BuildingEntityUpdateFinalizer` for better readability.
- Removed explicit `Install()` call for `GameFix`; now handled automatically by `[HarmonyPatch]` attribute via `PatchAll()`.
### Fixed
- Added `_warned` flag to `BuildingEntityUpdateFinalizer` to prevent log spam (only outputs once).
- Fixed `GameFix` missing `[HarmonyFinalizer]` attribute, causing the Finalizer to not be recognized.

### Fixed
- Added `InitFinalizer` to catch `IndexOutOfRangeException` in `RshClothing.Init()` (caused by `secondryLimbsTexture` array length mismatch), with `_initWarned` flag to prevent log spam.

Name: CasualtiesUnknown TarkovMedicalMod
Summary: A BepInEx mod for Casualties: Unknown Demo that brings the complete Escape from Tarkov medical system into the game — 16 combat stimulant injectors, 12 medical items, and a fully integrated medical framework. Each stimulant has its own unique buff/side-effect mechanics, registered into the game's native item table via reflection. Medical kits hoo
Description:
Version: 0.2.9
Author: hmm1313133
Mod GUID: com.yourname.cu.tarkovmedicalmod
GitHub: https://github.com/hmm1313133/CUTarkovMedicalMod
===========================================================
DESCRIPTION
===========================================================
A BepInEx mod for Casualties: Unknown Demo that brings 16 Tarkov-style combat stimulants, 12 medical items, and a complete medical system into the game.

Features:
- 16 custom stimulant injectors with unique effects and side effects (no temporary skill level boosts)
- 12 medical items (first aid kits, surgery kits, ointments, pills)
- Starting item grants + world loot spawning
- Intelligence-based Recognition system (hide names/effects when INT too low)
- Buff indicator via native MoodleManager
- Tunnel vision URP Vignette post-processing
- Multi-language support (EN/zh_CN)
- CUCoreLib hard dependency (non-destructive save coordination)
- Medical effect serialization system (Eff.Ser/Res) — saves/restores all active stimulant effects across floors
- KrokMP multiplayer full support:
  - Per-player effect controllers run independently on each client
  - Health sync interception prevents host from overriding client stimulant effects
  - Client inventory save/restore on reconnect (items + medical effects)
  - Buff indicator correctly shows only local player's effects
- Console spawn support for all custom items
- Hover description (SHIFT to expand effect details)

Stimulant Overview (v0.2.9 balance changes):
- SJ1: Changed from STR+5/RES+3 → stamina cap +10%, stamina recovery +50% (+ mild opiate)
- SJ12: Removed temporary RES+2 toughness boost
- PNB: Removed temporary RES+3 resilience boost (keeps nail repair + muscle healing + permanent STR-1 penalty)
- Obdolbos2 permanent skill boosts remain unchanged
- All temporary skill level increases removed — only permanent changes remain (Propital/SJ9 penalties, Obdolbos/Obdolbos2 permanent boosts)

===========================================================
REQUIREMENTS
===========================================================
- BepInEx 5.x
- Casualties: Unknown Demo
- CUCoreLib (required — hard dependency for save coordination and item registration)
- Optional: QoL Unknown (save compatibility handled automatically via CUCoreLib)
- Optional: KrokMP (multiplayer safe mode auto-detected)

===========================================================
INSTALLATION
===========================================================
1. Download CUTarkovMedicalMod_v0.2.9.zip
2. Extract the contents directly into BepInEx/plugins/CUTarkovMedicalMod/
  (DLL, Framework/, and Lang/ should be at the top level)
3. Ensure CUCoreLib.dll is in BepInEx/plugins/
4. Launch the game

===========================================================
CHANGELOG
===========================================================
v0.2.9 - 2026-07-16
- Balance: Removed all temporary skill level increases from stimulants
  - SJ1: STR+5/RES+3 replaced with stamina cap +10% + stamina recovery +50% (+ mild opiate)
  - SJ12: RES+2 temporary toughness boost removed
  - PNB: RES+3 temporary resilience boost removed
  - Permanent skill changes remain: Propital RES/STR -2, SJ9 RES -2, Obdolbos2 STR/RES/INT +6
- Refactor: CUCoreLib changed from soft dependency to hard dependency
  - Removed LegacyMode, IIntegrationMode interface; Integration layer simplified to CUCoreLibMode only
  - BepInDependency changed from SoftDependency to HardDependency
- Feature: Medical effect serialization system (Eff.Ser/Res)
  - Serializes/restores all active stimulant effect controllers across floor transitions
  - Handles side-effect timers and phase state (SJ9/Obdolbos2/Blueblood)
  - Registered as IBodySaveProvider via CUCoreLib SaveRegistry
- Feature: KrokMP multiplayer full support
  - KrokMpHelper: ShouldApplyUseEffect guard on all 18 injector useAction delegates
  - KrokMpHealthSyncPatch: Intercepts health sync packets to prevent host overriding client stimulant effects
  - KrokMpStateBridge: Reconnect effect restoration + inventory recovery for disconnected clients
  - KrokMpLiquidSyncPatch: Prevents container item sync from resetting custom liquid items
  - QolMpSaveCompat: Patches QoL save system for custom item creation + effect injection into snapshots
  - MultiPlayerStateSaveProvider: Saves/restores non-host player state (health, skills, position, inventory, effects)
  - StimBuffIndicator: Local-body filter prevents showing remote player buff indicators
- Fix: ETG/Zagustin debuff tick now uses direct field modification instead of body.Eat()/Drink()
  (avoids KrokMP network sync interception on those native methods)
- Fix: Eff.Ser() serialization check now includes debuff/side-effect remaining timers
- Fix: KrokMpHealthSyncPatch uses __0 indexed parameters instead of named params (matches KrokMP Apply method signatures)
- Removed: NexusMods_Description_Simple.txt and NexusMods_Weapon_Description_Simple.txt (consolidated into cu.txt)

v0.2.7 - 2026-07-14
- Fix: Injectors stored inside containers (medkit) reverted to base "syringe" when
  transitioning to the next floor
  - Root cause: QoLSaveFix Phase 2 only searched by custom ID, but container items
    still had base prefab ID ("syringe") after Prefix replacement. Phase 1 only
    converted items directly in body slots, not container children.
  - Fix: Phase 2 now falls back to searching by base prefab ID when custom ID search
    fails, then converts the found item back to custom. Uses HashSet to avoid
    duplicate matches when multiple injectors share the same base prefab.
- Fix: Custom injectors disappeared when held in main hand with CUCoreLib installed
  - Root cause: CUCoreLib ApplyCustomItemComponents recalculates condition as
    liquidAmount/capacity. With capacity=1 and no liquid contents, condition=0,
    causing the item to vanish even with destroyAtZeroCondition=false.
  - Fix: Set capacity=0 (skips condition recalculation) + defaultContents=[{water,0}]
    (triggers "waterbottle" template in ChooseTemplateId, avoiding "bandage" which
    caused IndexOutOfRangeException). condition stays at 1.0 as set by ConfigureSpawnedItem.
- Refactor: Centralized item definitions in MedicalItemDefinitions (shared by both modes)

Name: Too Many Settings
Summary: Adds more run settings to the game, because you can never have too many settings.
Description:
[size=6][b]TooManySettings[/b][/size]

[quote][url=https://github.com/MelnCat/cu-toomanysettings]GitHub Repository[/url][/quote]
Adds more run settings to the game that may or may not be balanced.

Warning: Turning someone of the settings too high may result in lag,
although you should probably expect for turning something to 100x.

[size=6][b]Settings[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Minibarrel Multiplier[/b][/size]

The amount of minibarrels to spawn. Defaults to 1x.

Turn this higher if you want more minibarrels everywhere, or lower if you hate fun and gambling.

[size=4][b]Enemy Multiplier[/b][/size]

The amount of enemies to spawn. Defaults to 1x.

This can be useful if the base trap multiplier is increased, as you can use this setting to decrease enemies specifically while keeping nonliving traps still high.

[size=4][b]Geyser Multiplier[/b][/size]

The amount of geysers to spawn. Defaults to 1x.

Turn this up if you want to suffer.

[size=4][b]Plant Multiplier[/b][/size]

The amount of plants (like glowplants) to spawn. Defaults to 1x.

[size=4][b]Fluid Multiplier[/b][/size]

The relative size of naturally spawning fluid pools to spawn (like lakes and stuff). Defaults to 1x.

[size=4][b]Climbable Multiplier[/b][/size]

The amount of climbable rope/vine to spawn. Defaults to 1x.

[size=4][b]Spawn Extra Random Loot[/b][/size]

Whether to spawn random items around the world. Defaults to false.

This is NOT the random items spawned on corpses. This is a separate custom spawning mechanism.

[size=4][b]Extra Random Loot Multiplier[/b][/size]

The amount of random items to spawn for the Spawn Extra Random Loot setting. Defaults to 1x.

Does nothing if Spawn Extra Random Loot is off.

Name: More Amputation
Summary: More ways to lose your limbs. Pair with Prosthetics!
Description:
[size=5][b]Requires BepInEx and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/341]CUCoreLib[/url]! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/40]Prosthetics[/url] mod is also highly recommended![/b][/size]

This mod modifies various traps in the base game to give them a threat of amputation, so the Salad isn't the only time you need to worry about losing your arm.

- All explosions now have the [b]chance of disfigurement divided by 4[/b] to amputate any of your arm or leg limbs, up to a limit of 1 amputated limb per explosion.
- Spike traps now have a chance to [b]amputate broken hands and feet[/b].
- Bear traps have been [b]fully reworked[/b] -- they no longer let you go automatically, and [b]must be disarmed in a new minigame to free your limb from it[/b]. Be careful though -- [b]severe mistakes can break the limb's bones or, if already broken, amputate it altogether![/b]
- Alternatively, you can break the bear trap with your claws or a tool instead to free your limb, at the likely risk of [b]shrapnel damage, bleeding and pain.[/b]

[left]The mod is currently in balance testing due to the bear trap minigame -- if you believe that the minigame is too easy or too difficult, leave a comment![/left]
[left][/left]
[left]Currently supports English and Russian (Thanks to Nichs1k!), but the localization files are packaged with the mod files, so anyone can contribute![/left]
[left][/left]

Name: UCU Mod Manager
Summary: Universal Casualties Unknown ModManager is a tool for conveniently managing mods. The manager allows you to install and uninstall mods, create separate profiles, configure the loading order, compile and install modpacks, and check for and manually install updates.
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size] [/b]
The main goal of the project is to simplify working with mods so you do not have to manually rebuild the game every time you want to update mods, switch builds, or prepare a new modpack.

[b][size=4]Virtualization[/size][/b] is currently being actively tested. With this feature, the base game with BepInEx installed remains unchanged: mods are loaded through a profile overlay, and you can freely switch, edit, and create different configurations.

[color=#f1c232][b]UCU Mod Manager is currently in alpha. Please report bugs, launch errors,
Mod installation issues, virtualization problems, or any odd behavior in the manager.
[/b][/color]
[b][color=#f1c232][size=4]For now, virtualization should be treated as an alpha feature. It is [i]recommended by default[/i], but feedback and bug reports are very important.[/size][/color][/b]

[b][size=4]Important[/size][/b]
Use a clean game installation whenever possible. BepInEx must be installed into the game folder first, preferably through UCU Mod Manager itself.
The manager treats a clean game with BepInEx installed as the expected base state. Mods, profiles, modpacks, and manager data are stored inside the manager folder.

[b][size=4]Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Install mods from Nexus Mods catalog, archives or folders.[/*]
[*]Manage separate profiles with their own enabled mods and load order.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through an experimental virtual profile.[/*]
[*]Official Nexus Mods authentication using OAuth 2.0 with PKCE.[/*]
[*]Check for updates and install them automatically or via manual archive downloads.[/*]
[*]Create and import ` .UCU ` modpack recipes.[/*]
[*]Create and import `.UCUP` portable modpacks with included mod files.[/*]
[*]Show mod dependencies, warnings, conflicts, and Nexus information.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
1. Download the latest release archive.
2. Extract it into an empty folder.
3. Run `UCU Mod Manager.exe`.

[b][url=https://github.com/ArchBlake/UCUModManager]GitHub[/url][/b]

Metadata from: [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999][b]Jimmyking[/b][/url]

Changelogs.Changelog: Temporarily removing ALL API things

## Major New Feature: Nexus OAuth 2.0 with PKCE
- Added official Nexus Mods authentication using OAuth 2.0 with PKCE.
- Removed the requirement to enter or store personal Nexus API keys.
- Added secure browser-based Nexus sign-in.
- OAuth tokens are encrypted using Windows DPAPI.
- Added Nexus membership detection.
## Nexus Premium Features
- Premium users can download and install mods directly from the Nexus Mods catalog.
- Premium users can automatically download and install available mod updates.
- Added direct mod reinstallation from Nexus.
- `.UCU` modpacks can automatically download and install missing Nexus mods for Premium users.
Non-Premium users can still open Nexus mod pages, download archives manually, and install them through UCU Mod Manager.
## Nexus Mods Browser
- Added a visual tile-based Nexus Mods catalog.
- Added an optional compact table view.
- Added search, status filters, and sorting options.
- Added mod images and image galleries.
## New Features
- Added SHA-256 checksums for every distributed file.
- Added archive safety validation for mods and portable modpacks.
- Added automatic free disk space checks before extraction.
- Added automatic update checks for Mod Manager.
- Added validation for `.UCU` and `.UCUP` modpack structure and load order.
- Added Premium automatic installation and manual-download fallback information to modpack imports.
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed the application not responding to clicks during the first few seconds after startup.
- Fixed repeated virtual overlay calculations during interface refresh.
- Fixed newly installed mods being skipped when Auto Link was already running.
- Fixed incorrect `.UCU` and `.UCUP` installed-mod detection.
- Modpack entries now require a matching Nexus file ID or compatible version.
- Fixed malformed or unsupported modpacks being accepted during import.
- Fixed outdated Nexus thumbnails continuing to load after changing pages or view modes.
- Fixed incomplete archive files remaining after failed extraction.
- Fixed portable builds accepting missing or invalid version numbers.
- Fixed some installed mods remaining in the `Check needed` state after startup.
- Improved Nexus update verification to reduce phantom update notifications.
## Security and Reliability
- Added protection against oversized archives and ZIP Bombs.
- Added limits for file count, individual file size, total extracted size, and compression ratio.
- Added validation for embedded archive names inside `.UCUP` files.
- Added detection of truncated or incorrectly declared archive entries.
- OAuth callback state and returned token claims are validated.
## Performance Improvements
- Nexus Auto Link processing now runs outside the interface thread.
- Startup update now run in the background.
- Virtual overlay previews are reused during the same refresh cycle.
- Duplicate startup interface refreshes were removed.

[line]

[size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size]

[b]RshCCL[/b] is a drop-in replacement for RshLib [i](in most cases)[/i]. It keeps the [i]Plugin.RegisterItem(string, RshItem)[/i] API surface so older mods work unchanged, while internally routing all registrations through CUCoreLib.

[b]Key features:[/b]

[b]RegisterItem[/b] – Converts [i]RshItem[/i] → [i]CustomItemInfo[/i], then calls [i]ItemRegistry.Register[/i]

[b]onSpawn callback[/b] – Injected via CCL [i]SpawnComponents[/i] + [i]RshSpawnCallback[/i] MonoBehaviour

[b]krokMpEnabled / togetherMpEnabled[/b] – Provided as backwards‑compatible fields

[b]Conflict avoidance[/b] – Removes self from [i]Chainloader.PluginInfos[/i] so mods like NewClothing use their native CCL path

[b]Console autofill[/b] – Patches [i]spawn[/i] command to include every CCL‑registered item

[b]Recipe‑list crash guard[/b] – Harmony finalizer catches NRE in [i]RefreshRecipeList[/i]

[line]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

Install [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx 5.x[/url] for Casualties Unknown.

Install [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CUCoreLib]CUCoreLib[/url] ≥ 1.0.1 — place [i]CUCoreLib.dll[/i] in [i]BepInEx/plugins/[/i].

Download the latest [i]RshCCL.dll[/i] from [url=https://github.com/CNCUMC/RshCCL/releases]Releases[/url].

Place [i]RshCCL.dll[/i] in [i]BepInEx/plugins/[/i].

[b]Remove[/b] the old [i]RshLib.dll[/i] if it exists.

[quote][b]⚠️ Important:[/b] RshCCL uses the same BepInEx GUID as old RshLib ([i]com.rushellxyz.rshlib[/i]).

Only [b]one[/b] [i]RshLib.dll[/i] should be present in your plugins folder.[/quote]
[line]

[size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]

RshLib itself never provided path or resource‑loading APIs. Older mods that hard‑code paths like [i]"BepInEx/plugins/MyMod/image.png"[/i] must update their own resource‑loading code.

Consider migrating to CCL's [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CUCoreLib]AssetLoader[/url] which resolves paths relative to the calling DLL.
[quote]⚠️ Some compatibility issues are not caused by RshCCL and also occur with original RshLib.
For those, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/424]CUModFixer[/url] as well.[/quote]
[line]

[size=4][b]Project Structure[/b][/size]
[code]
RshCCL/
├── Plugin.cs # Entry point: compatibility API + conflict avoidance
├── RshItem.cs # Legacy RshItem type (backwards compat)
├── RshItemAdapter.cs # RshItem → CustomItemInfo converter + onSpawn callback
├── Patches.cs # ConsoleScript, GlobalDark, RefreshRecipeList guard
├── RshLib.csproj # Project file (depends on CUCoreLib)
├── CHANGELOG.md # English changelog
├── CHANGELOG_ZH.md # Chinese changelog
├── README.md
└── README_ZH.md[/code]
Author: CNCUMC

Changelogs.Changelog:
### Added
- **SaveGame guard**: Harmony finalizer catches `ArgumentException` from CCL SaveCoordinator duplicate component keys (e.g. NewFirearms.RshGun)
- **Bark localization** (soft dependency): auto-detects missing translations, registers EN/zh-CN/zh-TW fallbacks via `Lang/EnLangGenerator`, `ZhCnLangGenerator`, `ZhTwLangGenerator`
- **Reflection-based Bark integration**: No hard reference to Bark.dll — gracefully degrades when Bark is absent
- **Log localization system**: `LogInfo`/`LogWarning`/`LogError` with locale keys, falling back to English `Regex.Replace`
### Changed
- **Dependency**: CUCoreLib ≥ 1.0.1 → 1.0.2
- **Dependency**: Bark `org.cucnmc.bark` added as soft dependency
- **Mod name**: `"Rsh CCL"` → `"RshCCL"` (no space)
- **Conflict avoidance**: Changed from "permanently remove self" to "temporarily hide → Chainloader.Start Postfix restore", so mods that depend on RshLib can still find it after loading
- **StartGame.ps1**: `$ModNamespace = "RshLib"` for DLL name, `$ModName = "RshCCL"` for folder/display

### Removed
- **Bark dependency**: RshCCL no longer requires or references Bark. All localization is handled directly through CCL's `LocaleRegistry`.
- **Lang/ directory**: EnLangGenerator, ZhCnLangGenerator, ZhTwLangGenerator — no longer needed.
- **InitializeLocalization()**: Method removed.
- **LocaleLog()**: Method removed.
- **barkLoaded**: Field removed.
- **using System.Reflection**: Import removed (no longer needed for Bark reflection).
### Changed
- **Simplified logging**: `LogInfo`/`LogWarning`/`LogError` now use simple `Regex.Replace` formatting instead of locale keys.
- **Project structure**: Patches moved to `Patchers/` subdirectory for better organization.

### Added
- **Body.UseItem guard** — Prefix routes wearable items to `WearWearable` path; finalizer swallows NRE for non-wearable
items (fixes NewClothing crash when equipping items)
- **IngredientNamePatch** — Preserved from original RshLib — displays custom crafting qualities (cutting, hammering,
etc.) in recipe ingredient lists
### Changed
- **krokMpEnabled** — Now defaults to `false` and marked `[Obsolete]`, matching original RshLib v3.2.0 behavior. This
prevents NewFirearms from incorrectly enabling MP features and crashing.

Name: Massive Casualties
Summary: MMO-like multiplayer: connects every session together and allows travel between them. Meet new friends or get help from others as you brave the depths!
Description:
[center][size=2][img width=700]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/400/400-1783307655-1303799286.png[/img][/size][/center]
[center][size=2]Note: this mod is [b]extremely WIP[/b], and bugs are expected. If you encounter any issues, please let me know![/size][/center]

[color=#3d85c6][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]As you search the target planet, you'll find "Improvised Lifts" scattered throughout your world, allowing you to freely travel between sessions while keeping your character and world intact. Each lift is permanent bridge between two worlds, letting you explore not only your own cave, but the ones others are trapped in as well. Who will you meet along your journey?[/color]

[color=#3d85c6][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]First, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/67]Casualties Together[/url][/color][color=#ffffff] [/color]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/341]CUCoreLib[/url], then download this mod and unzip it inside your BepInEx/plugins directory. To play, start a multiplayer server through the multiplayer menu (make sure it says "Massive Casualties: Enabled"), or join a server with the mod installed. MassiveCasualties is fully compatible with the multiplayer mod, and can be enabled/disabled as needed.

Since this mod is very early in development, there probably won't be many sessions online. Stick with it, and that might soon change!

[color=#3d85c6][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Multiplayer travel: let your character move between sessions while keeping all your items (and injuries) intact.[/*]
[*]Return to your own world as you left it: worlds are saved automatically when moving between sessions, and are automatically loaded when you go back to them.[/*]
[*]Automatic host switching: when the host of a lobby disconnects, someone else takes their place instead of the entire server going down and everyone losing progress.[/*]
[/list]Note: these features are only available in Massive Casualties-enabled lobbies, and are automatically disabled otherwise for compatibility.

[b][color=#3d85c6][size=4]Support[/size][/color]
[/b]The quickest way to contact me is through the [url=https://discord.gg/ehCptz9pwU]Casualties: Unknown Modding Discord[/url]. A lot of other mod authors hang out there, so it's a good place to get support for their mods as well.

If the lift isn't working, there's a few main reasons why:
[list=1]
[*]There aren't any other Massive Casualties-enabled lobbies online.[/*]
[*]The lobby the lift is linked to no longer exists.[/*]
[*]The world you're trying to go to is "owned" by someone else on the server, and they need to go through the lift first.[/*]
[/list]The easiest fix is to have other people try the lift, and to find a different lift to try.
Author: PintTheDragon

Changelogs.Changelog:
This has all the initial networking-side features, and is fairly stable. You can go in and out through teleporters, they stay locked to the lobbies they were assigned to, and your character and world are preserved (to go back to your world, just go back through the teleporter). It also has host switching, so if the host of your session leaves, someone else will become the host instead of the whole server going down.
Note: if there are no lobbies available, the teleporters won't work. If a lobby was shut down (for example, if everyone left a world), the teleporter will still work but only by the person who hosted that lobby. For everyone else, the teleporter does nothing until the old host enters it, after which the lobby is now accessible. I'll be adding some feedback messages for this stuff in the future.
I'm sure there are a good amount of bugs, so please let me know if you encounter any! Currently, this should be totally compatible with KrokMP, so you can host a world and people without the mod can enter it. You can also enter normal KrokMP lobbies, but the mod will just do nothing then.

* Fix save/load not working properly (certain items not loading and sometimes the whole load failed and broke the game).
* Fix players who joined before world generation not loading in.
* Fix layer changes destroying items.

Fix a bug where all the entities in the world disappear.
Fix some bugs causing items to duplicate.
Add outdated version handling (update prompt in the menu, and allows players on slightly different versions to play together).

Name: ShatteredPrism
Summary: A Shader Loader mod for Casualties Unknown.
Description:
[center][size=6][b]ShatteredPrism[/b][/size]
[size=3][i]A screen-space shader loader for Casualties Unknown[/i][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][i]wiki:  [url=https://wiki.ethertaco.org/shatteredprism/]ShatteredPrism - Ethertaco Docs[/url][/i][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]概述 / Overview[/b][/size]

[b]ShatteredPrism[/b] is a screen-space shader loader. It allows modders and pack authors to layer custom full-screen shader effects onto the game without writing a single line of C# code. By simply dropping in a JSON manifest and a pre-compiled AssetBundle.

[b]ShatteredPrism[/b] 是一个屏幕后处理（screen-space）着色器加载器。它允许模组制作者和效果包作者在不编写任何 C# 代码的情况下，将自定义全屏 Shader 叠加到游戏画面上。只需放入一个 JSON 清单文件和一个预编译的 AssetBundle。

[line]

[size=5][b]需求 / Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]BepInEx 5.4.x[/b][/*]
[*][b]ScavLib API (SLA)[/b] — This mod is built upon the ScavLib Shader API. / 本模组构建在 ScavLib API 的 Shader API 之上。[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]安装 / Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Ensure BepInEx and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/83?tab=files]SLA[/url] are installed. / 确保已安装 BepInEx 与 SLA。[/*]
[*]Place [b]ShatteredPrism.dll[/b] into [font=Courier New]BepInEx/plugins/ShatteredPrism/[/font]. / 将 [b]ShatteredPrism.dll[/b] 放入插件目录。[/*]
[*]Create an [font=Courier New]effects/[/font] folder in the same directory. / 在同目录下建立 [font=Courier New]effects/[/font] 文件夹。[/*]
[*]Drop your [b].json manifests[/b] and [b]AssetBundles[/b] into the effects folder. / 将你的 [b].json 清单[/b]与 [b]AssetBundle[/b] 放入该文件夹。[/*]
[*]Launch the game and enter any level to see the results. / 启动游戏，进入任意关卡即可看到效果。[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]制作效果包 / Authoring an Effect[/b][/size]

Each effect consists of two files: a [b]JSON manifest[/b] describing parameters and an [b]AssetBundle[/b] containing your URP shader.
每个效果由两个文件组成：一个描述参数的 [b]JSON 清单[/b]，以及一个包含 URP Shader 的 [b]AssetBundle[/b]。

[size=4][b]1. Manifest Example / 清单示例 (effects/my_effect.json)[/b][/size]

[code]
{
  "id": "author:vignette",
  "shader": "MyMod/Vignette",
  "bundle": "my_effects",
  "order": 100,
  "enabled": true,
  "floats": [
    { "name": "_Intensity", "value": 0.9 }
  ],
  "colors": [
    { "name": "_Tint", "hex": "#0A0014FF" }
  ],
  "pulses": [
    { "name": "_Intensity", "amplitude": 0.1, "speed": 2.0, "offset": 0.9 }
  ]
}[/code]
[list]
[*][b]id[/b]: Unique identifier for the pass. / 效果的唯一标识。[/*]
[*][b]shader[/b]: The name declared in the shader file's [font=Courier New]Shader "..."[/font] header. / Shader 文件顶部声明的名字（[b]非文件名[/b]）。[/*]
[*][b]bundle[/b]: AssetBundle filename relative to the manifest. / AssetBundle 文件名（相对路径）。[/*]
[*][b]order[/b]: Rendering priority; lower values render first. / 渲染顺序；数值越小越先渲染。[/*]
[*][b]floats / colors / pulses[/b]: Uniforms passed to the shader. [i]Pulses[/i] are animated via sine waves. / 传给 Shader 的变量；[i]Pulses[/i] 会随时间进行正弦波动。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]2. Shader Requirements / Shader 技术要求[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Must be a [b]URP[/b] shader compatible with [b]Unity 2022.3 / URP 14[/b]. / 必须是兼容 [b]Unity 2022.3 / URP 14[/b] 的 [b]URP[/b] 着色器。[/*]
[*]The source image is bound to [font=Courier New]_BlitTexture[/font]. Use [font=Courier New]SAMPLE_TEXTURE2D_X[/font] for sampling. / 源图像绑定在 [font=Courier New]_BlitTexture[/font]，请使用 [font=Courier New]SAMPLE_TEXTURE2D_X[/font] 采样。[/*]
[*]To prevent pink "fallback" shaders, add your shader to [i]Always Included Shaders[/i] before building the bundle. / 为防止变体剔除导致画面变粉，打包前请将 Shader 加入 [i]Always Included Shaders[/i]。[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]工作原理 / How It Works[/b][/size]

ShatteredPrism itself does not contain any shaders. It acts as a bridge between your assets and the ScavLib Shader API. It handles manifest parsing, asset loading, and pass registration, while ScavLib manages the heavy lifting: URP injection, uniform updates, and frame blitting.

ShatteredPrism 本身[b]不包含任何 Shader 和 API 实现[/b]。它充当了你的资源与 ScavLib Shader API 之间的桥梁，负责解析清单、加载资源与注册通道；而 ScavLib 则负责核心渲染工作：URP 注入、变量更新以及每帧的图像 Blit。

[line]
Author: QinShenYu and Kanisuko

Name: CasualtiesTogether - AutoLoadRunSettings
Summary: Automatically loads run settings from a .txt file to easily re-apply configured run settings.
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This is a small extension mod for  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/67]Casualties: Together[/url], adding simple control over your run settings that are then sent to other clients when the server starts. Works for both dedicated servers and regular servers.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]GitHub [url=https://github.com/DarkDibblez/casualtiestogether-autoloadrunsettings]here[/url].[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Install [b]BepInEx[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Install [b]Casualties: Together (aka KrokMP)[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Install [b]AutoLoadRunSettings[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Update runsettings.txt with your own run settings (copy from in-game after tweaking your settings to your liking)[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Whenever the host starts the run, the mod will attempt to load runsettings.txt and apply it to the game. The file is reloaded at the start of every run so feel free to replace the settings between runs if you wish.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][size=3]I have not made any efforts (yet) to improve compatibility with other mods. If it doesn't play nice with the base Cas:T mod, this will most likely not do so, either. Most functionality I leverage is present in the Cas:T mod so compatibility will be largely dependent on them.[/size][/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][size=4][b]Known incompatibilities[/b]: [/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][size=4][b]QoL:[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][size=3]Loading QoL saves will always overrule the settings from my mod. I believe this to be intentional as a mid-layer QoL save saves a LOT of information that can and will affect layer generation.[/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][size=3]Not sure how QoL behaves when starting a new run.[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/67]Casualties: Together[/url][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to [url=https://github.com/OzzySpaghettiTeam]OzzySpaghettiTeam[/url] for the ScavTemplate repo and [url=https://github.com/Krokosha666]Krokosha666[/url] & [url=https://github.com/creaturefeaturelarry]CreatureFeatureLarry[/url] for their work on the Cas:T mod.[/color]

[size=5][b][color=#00e676]What It Does[/color][/b][/size]
[b]Casualty Vitals[/b] replaces the base game's ECG display with a multi-channel patient monitor, new medical items, and an optional complication layer.

[list]
[*]Replaces the vanilla health panel ECG with a custom multi-channel monitor overlay.[/*]
[*]Adds selectable waveform channels: [color=#00e676]HRT[/color] (ECG), [color=#00e5ff]SPO2[/color] (Plethysmograph), [color=#ffee58]RESP[/color] (Capnography), [color=#ef5350]ABP[/color] (Arterial Blood Pressure), and [color=#ba68c8]ETCO2[/color] (End-Tidal CO2).[/*]
[*]Channels can be previewed by hovering and pinned by clicking.[/*]
[*]Adds monitor alarm tinting and affected-channel button pulsing instead of blocking text.[/*]
[*]Supports a photosensitive alarm mode with slower, softer pulsing.[/*]
[*]Hides the custom monitor in unchipped mode so vanilla behavior shows through.[/*]
[*]Adds manual pulse checks on limbs for unchipped or low-information runs.[/*]
[*]Manual defibrillator features full multi-channel viewing, torso-placement signal scaling (torso gives a full signal; limbs give faint noise), and optional condition wear per shock.[/*]
[*]Adds dynamic hemodynamic bleeding: wound loss rates dynamically scale with blood pressure, circulating blood volume (up to 7.5L hypervolemia), and limb vascular calibers, with live flow readouts in WoundView.[/*]
[*]Adds over 20 heart rhythms and irregular patterns (SVT, AFib, A-Flutter, VTach, TdP, Heart Blocks, WPW, and VFib).[/*]
[*]Unorganized VFib (>= 88%) blanks readouts to [color=#ef5350][b]---[/b][/color] and [color=#ef5350][b]---/---[/b][/color], while recovery (< 78% fib) engages a 1.4-second pulse recalculation sequence.[/*]
[*]Adds 10 custom medical items through CUCoreLib.[/*]
[*]Optional complications include electrolyte imbalances (from drug overdoses or banana binges), respiratory collapse, shock, and Elder Thornback dread effects.[/*]
[*]Includes a guide / wiki ([url=https://github.com/IzaCarlos/CasualtyVitals/blob/main/GUIDE.md]GUIDE.md[/url]) explaining all items, waveforms, and treatment tips if you get lost (also included in the mod download).[/*]
[/list]

Casualty Vitals adds 10 items through CUCoreLib:

[spoiler]
[list]
[*][b]Albuterol Inhaler (cv_albuterol)[/b]: 10-puff inhaler for bronchospasm and potassium clearance (-0.10 mmol/L per puff). Overdose causes rapid breathing and tachycardia.[/*]
[*][b]Adrenaline Auto-Injector (cv_epinephrine)[/b]: 120ml pressor solution (Adrenaline + Noradrenaline + Carrier). Ramps over 3–5s for +36 bpm rate and +28/18 mmHg pressure support.[/*]
[*][b]Atropine Auto-Injector (cv_atropine)[/b]: Dual auto-injector (Atropine + Pralidoxime) for bradycardia, AV blocks, and creature venom (venomCurrent -45).[/*]

[size=5][b][color=#00e676]Developer API (v2.0)[/color][/b][/size]
Casualty Vitals includes an API for other mods to read live vitals, listen to events, inject modifiers, or require a simulation mode:

[code]
// Require Advanced mode for a custom pharmacology mod
CasualtyVitalsApi.RequireSimulationMode("my_mod_id", SimulationMode.Advanced, "Requires blood gas & electrolyte simulation");

// Read live patient state
if (CasualtyVitalsApi.TryGetVitals(body, out VitalsSnapshot snap))
{
    Debug.Log($"Rhythm: {snap.Rhythm}, HR: {snap.HR}, K+: {snap.Potassium} mmol/L");
}[/code]
Full API documentation and code examples are available at [url=https://github.com/IzaCarlos/CasualtyVitals/blob/main/API.md]API.md[/url] (available on github).

Name: Pet Mod
Summary: Have goofy pets with audio!!! MP SUPPORTED!!!
Description:
[size=6][b]Cosmetic Pet Mod for Casualties Unknown[/b][/size]

Welcome to the [b]Cosmetic Pet Mod[/b], a companion experience for [i]Casualties Unknown[/i] with smooth physics-based following, advanced multiplayer synchronization, and full audio support!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]🚀 KEY FEATURES & MECHANICS[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[size=4][b]1. 🦘 Physics-Based Follow Behavior[/b][/size]
[*][b]Horizontal Lag:[/b] Trails behind you at a configurable follow distance with smooth exponential interpolation — no rigid snapping.[/*]
[*][b]Auto-Flipping:[/b] Detects your facing direction (or movement delta) with a 150ms hysteresis lock to prevent rapid flutter, always looking the correct way.[/*]
[*][b]Teleport Protection:[/b] Two-tier guard — soft reset above 8 units, hard snap above 18 units — stops the pet from warping across the screen during fast movement.

[size=4][b]2. 🌍 Auto-Leveling Ground System[/b][/size][/*]
[*][b]Multi-Raycast Sampling:[/b] Three rays span the pet's left, center, and right edges to bridge 1-tile gaps and step smoothly over terrain.[/*]
[*][b]One-Way Platform Filtering:[/b] Ignores pass-through platforms unless the player is standing on or very close to them.[/*]
[*][b]Spring-Damper Suspension:[/b] [color=#f1c40f]Mathf.SmoothDamp[/color] ground interpolation with a small threshold gate ([color=#f1c40f]0.35u[/color]) to suppress flat-ground micro-jitter while still gliding over stairs.[/*]
[*][b]Item Ignore:[/b] The pet sees through all dropped/physical world items — no snapping onto boxes or bags.

[size=4][b]3. 🪟 Smart Ceiling Squishing[/b][/size][/*]
[*][b]Lookahead Pre-Pass:[/b] Ceiling scanning starts [i]before[/i] the pet enters an overhang, triggered from a stable origin point above the player.[/*]
[*][b]Accurate Clearance:[/b] Measured from the pet's actual bottom edge, not the player origin.[/*]
[*][b]Asymmetric Interpolation:[/b] Compresses 2.5× faster than it expands for a satisfying jelly squish feel.[/*]
[*][b]Minimum Squish Cap:[/b] Pet can compress down to [b]0.15×[/b] its height to squeeze through very tight gaps.[/*]
[*][b]Ceiling-Aware Wall Rays:[/b] Horizontal wall collision checks are clamped below detected ceilings so the pet can slide sideways without corner-snagging.

[size=4][b]4. 💃 Walking Wiggle & Squash-and-Stretch[/b][/size][/*]
[*][b]Tilt Wiggle:[/b] [color=#f1c40f]Mathf.Sin[/color]-driven left/right rotation when walking.[/*]
[*][b]Squash & Stretch:[/b] Vertical compression and horizontal expansion synchronized to stride rhythm.

[size=4][b]5. 🛸 Simple Mode (Noclip)[/b][/size]
Toggle [b]Simple Mode[/b] to bypass all collision checks entirely. The pet smoothly hovers and bobs alongside you, gliding freely through any geometry. Walk wiggles remain active. Useful if you experience physics issues in unusual map geometry.

[size=4][b]6. 🔊 Audio Pack Support (Up to 500%)[/b][/size]
Drop WAV, OGG, or MP3 files into an audio pack folder and the pet will randomly play them on a configurable interval:[/*]
[*][b]500% Volume Cap:[/b] Volume goes up to [b]5.0×[/b] using [color=#f1c40f]PlayOneShot[/color] to bypass Unity's standard [color=#f1c40f]1.0[/color] clamp.[/*]
[*][b]Configurable Intervals:[/b] Set minimum and maximum seconds between sounds independently.

[size=4][b]7. 🛡️ 100% Invincibility[/b][/size]
A pure cosmetic companion — no colliders, no health, completely immune to game physics, enemies, and player collision.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]🌐 MULTIPLAYER SYNCHRONIZATION[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

An industry-grade P2P and Steam Lobby sync architecture so everyone in your session sees (and hears!) your pet perfectly.

[size=4][b]👥 Personalized Follow Dynamics[/b][/size]
All movement parameters ([i]Follow Speed, Follow Distance, Wiggle Speed[/i], etc.) are client-authoritative and broadcast via Steam lobby member metadata. Each player's pet moves with their chosen settings, independently per-player.

[size=4][b]🖼️ P-2-P Custom PNG Transfer[/b][/size]
When you load a custom local skin that other players don't have, the mod automatically transfers it:
1. Remote clients detect a new SHA1 hash via lobby metadata.
2. They issue a reliable P2P request on Channel [b]1337[/b].
3. You send the raw image bytes directly.
4. They cache it by hash in [color=#1abc9c]Pets/Cache/[/color] for instant loading next session.

[size=4][b]🎵 Multiplayer Audio Sync[/b][/size]
When your pet plays a sound, a tiny 6-byte P2P packet (type [b]2[/b], unreliable delivery) is broadcast to all lobby members. Each receiver plays the clip on their local copy of your pet's [i]AudioSource[/i], positioned in 3D space at the pet's location. If a player doesn't have your audio pack installed, they simply hear nothing — no crash, no error.

[size=4][b]🤫 Anti-Jitter Motion Filtering[/b][/size][/*]
[*]Position deadzone [i]0.02u/frame[/i] to suppress floating-point noise when standing still.[/*]
[*]Facing-direction flip locked behind [i]0.05u[/i] movement delta and 150ms sustain timer.[/*]
[*]Low-pass velocity smoothing so walk animations start and stop organically.

[size=4][b]📥 Importing Custom Sprites[/b][/size]

Paste a full file path or direct image URL into the settings window and click [b]Import Image File / URL[/b]. The mod downloads, caches, and applies it mid-session.

[size=4][b]🎵 Installing Audio Packs[/b][/size]
Create a folder inside [color=#1abc9c]BepInEx/plugins/CosmeticPetMod/AudioPacks/<pack_name>/[/color] and place [color=#1abc9c].wav[/color], [color=#1abc9c].ogg[/color], or [color=#1abc9c].mp3[/color] files inside. Name: Manual Breathing
Summary: Uhh, breathe manually, like a chud
Description:
[size=6][b]Manual Breathing Mod — Technical Overview & Design[/b][/size]

This mod introduces a high-fidelity, immersive, and tactile [b]Manual Respiration System[/b] to [i]Casualties Unknown[/i], completely transforming the gameplay loop by requiring the player to actively manage their inhalation and exhalation cycle to maintain cellular oxygenation.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]🧬 RESPIRATION MECHANICS & LUNG SIMULATION[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Rather than treating breathing as a binary state, the mod implements an organic, physical model of the human respiratory tract:

[size=4][b]1. The Respiratory State Model[/b][/size]
Each conscious local player's body tracks two continuous properties:
[*][b]Lung Volume ([color=#f1c40f]lungAir[/color]) [0.0 - 1.0]:[/b] The physical volume of gas currently occupying the lungs.[/*]
[*][b]Oxygen Freshness ([color=#f1c40f]lungFreshness[/color]) [0.0 - 1.0]:[/b] The concentration of fresh, absorbable oxygen vs. accumulated, stale carbon dioxide.

[size=4][b]2. Anatomical Dead Space Simulation (Capped Freshness)[/b][/size]
To prevent a single inhale from magically "fully charging" the respiratory system to 100% capacity from an empty state, the mod models [b]Anatomical Dead Space[/b] (the residual volume of stale air trapped in non-exchanging airways).

During inhalation, incoming ambient air is mixed with a maximum fresh efficiency of [b]0.85[/b] instead of a perfect 1.0:

[code]lungFreshness_new = ((lungFreshness * lungAir_prev) + (0.85 * addedAir)) / lungAir_new[/code]
This means your lungs always maintain a realistic residual mixing of gases, preventing instantaneous maximum charges and forcing a consistent ventilatory rhythm.

[size=4][b]3. Deep Inhale Alveolar Boost (Low-Volume Efficiency)[/b][/size]
Gas exchange is most efficient at low lung volumes where the partial pressure gradient of oxygen is steepest. The mod rewards realistic deep breathing cycles by introducing the [b]Deep Inhale Alveolar Boost[/b]:[/*]
[*][b]Inhaling at low lung volumes[/b] ([color=#f1c40f]lungAir[/color] close to 0) directly adds a substantial amount of oxygen to your blood ([color=#f1c40f]bloodOxygen[/color]).[/*]
[*][b]Inhaling at high lung volumes[/b] (shallow breathing/panting at the top, e.g., from 0.8 to 1.0) provides [b]virtually zero[/b] direct blood oxygen gain.

[code]ΔbloodOxygen = addedAir * (1.0 - lungAir_prev)^2 * 32.0[/code]
This makes shallow, rapid inhalations highly ineffective, forcing the player to fully empty their lungs ([color=#f1c40f]lungAir[/color] to 0.0) before taking deep breaths to maximize oxygen absorption!

[size=4][b]4. Metabolic Oxygen Depletion[/b][/size]
Oxygen is constantly consumed from the lungs. The rate of depletion scales dynamically with the character's physical state:[/*]
[*][b]Baseline Consumption:[/b] It takes approximately 22 seconds of breath-holding to fully deplete oxygen under quiet conditions.[/*]
[*][b]Cardiovascular Scale:[/b] High heart rate ([color=#e74c3c]body.respiratoryRate[/color]) increases oxygen consumption.[/*]
[*][b]Exertion Scale:[/b] Low stamina ([color=#e74c3c]body.stamina[/color]) indicates high fatigue, compounding oxygen consumption up to [b]2.2x faster[/b].

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]🫁 VENTILATION RATE RISKS (NEW PHYSIOLOGY)[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The mod features a sophisticated, real-time [b]Ventilation Rate and Rhythm Tracker[/b] that monitors the duration and frequency of your breathing phases. Deviations from a steady, natural cycle introduce severe physiological and visual penalties.

[size=4][b]1. Hyperventilation (Breathing Too Fast)[/b][/size]
Triggered by rapid, shallow tapping (breathing phase duration less than [b]0.85s[/b]), which simulates hypocapnia (extreme depletion of blood carbon dioxide leading to respiratory alkalosis):[/*]
[*][b]Lightheadedness & Drowsiness:[/b] Your consciousness ([color=#e74c3c]body.consciousness[/color]) is continuously drained. If it falls below 30%, you pass out.[/*]
[*][b]Dizziness Camera Sway:[/b] The camera sways gently in a circular sinusoidal motion, mimicking a spinning head.[/*]
[*][b]Muscle Twitches & Jitter:[/b] Under extreme hyperventilation (level > 50%), the player experiences high-frequency tremors (muscles spasming due to alkalosis), making the camera shake rapidly.[/*]
[*][b]Staggering Slowdown:[/b] Lightheadedness saps coordination, slowing down character movement speed up to [b]36%[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Peripheral Glare Vignette:[/b] A vibrant, flickering white-blue glare border vibrates at 20Hz around the screen edges, blinding peripheral vision.

[size=4][b]2. Hypoventilation (Breathing Too Slow / Holding Breath)[/b][/size]
Triggered by prolonged inactivity, holding breath, or holding a single key down without cycling (duration greater than [b]5.5s[/b]), which simulates hypercapnia (severe CO2 retention and respiratory acidosis):[/*]
[*][b]CO2 Retention Fatigue:[/b] Blood oxygen ([color=#f1c40f]bloodOxygen[/color]) is actively destroyed by hypercapnia.[/*]
[*][b]Anoxic Exhaustion:[/b] Stamina ([color=#e74c3c]stamina[/color]) rapidly drains due to toxic lactic acid build-up in muscles.[/*]
[*][b]Severe Tachycardia:[/b] Heart rate surges up to 195 bpm to compensate for oxygen deprivation.[/*]
[*][b]Cardiac Throb Camera Shake:[/b] The screen physically throbs and shakes in [b]perfect synchronization[/b] with your actual heart rate ([color=#e74c3c]body.heartRate[/color]), simulating high-pressure pulsing blood.[/*]
[*][b]Sluggish Exhaustion:[/b] Movement speed is slowed by up to 30%.[/*]
[*][b]Claustrophobic Tunnel Vision:[/b] A dark, heavy charcoal vignette starts closing in from the screen boundaries, squeezing your field of view down to a narrow slit.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]🌊 UNDERWATER ASPHYXIATION HAZARDS[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If the player submerges in water without a Scuba Gear accessory:[/*]
[*]Inhaling draws in water instead of air, instantly dropping [color=#f1c40f]lungFreshness[/color] to [b]0.0[/b].[/*]
[*]Water inhalation induces [b]alveolar trauma[/b], dealing steady, direct damage to [color=#e74c3c]body.brainHealth[/color].[/*]
[*]Choking and coughing sounds are triggered at random, short intervals to communicate panic.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]🎛️ PROCEDURAL RESPIRATION AUDIO SYNTHESIZER[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The mod synthesizes breathing audio [b]procedurally in real-time[/b] on startup. This completely eliminates loading lag and guarantees high portability.

[size=4][b]The DSP Filter Pipeline[/b][/size][/*]
[*][b]Noise Source:[/b] Generates uniform white noise samples.[/*]
[*][b]RC Lowpass Filter:[/b] Airway geometry shifts during breathing. The synthesizer uses an RC lowpass filter with a dynamic coefficient (alpha):
    * [b]Inhaling:[/b] Air passages dilate, allowing higher-frequency transmission. Alpha ramps up dynamically to widen the filter.
    * [b]Exhaling:[/b] Air passages relax and constrict. Alpha ramps down to produce a warm, deep, muffled wind sound.[/*]
[*][b]Volume Envelope:[/b] Smooth sinusoidal contours with click-softening boundaries on the edges to simulate realistic lung expansion and contraction.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]🖥️ DYNAMIC GLASSMORPHIC HUD & VIGNETTES[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The HUD is designed to feel cohesive, luxurious, and completely integrated into the game's atmosphere:

[size=4][b]1. Organic Fading (Dynamic Visibility)[/b][/size]
The HUD remains completely hidden while the player is healthy and resting to maximize screen space. It smoothly fades into view (alpha transitions via [i]Time.deltaTime * 3.5f[/i]) only when:
1. The player is actively pressing Inhale/Exhale keys.
2. Blood oxygen falls below 88%, lung freshness drops below 35%, or ventilation rates become unstable.
3. The character is submerged underwater.

[size=4][b]2. Progressive Blackouts[/b][/size]
As consciousness drops below 55% due to hyperventilation or hypoxia, the screen gradually fades out to complete black, perfectly simulating passing out right before the character collapses into a limp ragdoll.

[size=4][b]3. Beautiful Interface Aesthetics[/b][/size][/*]
[*][b]Glassmorphic backing panel:[/b] A semi-transparent dark charcoal panel with crisp slate borders.[/*]
[*][b]Dual Micro-Progress Bars:[/b]
    * [b]Lungs Bar:[/b] Changes color organically from [b][color=#9b59b6]deep magenta-purple[/color][/b] (stale/carbon dioxide) to [b][color=#1abc9c]vibrant electric-teal[/color][/b] (fresh oxygen).
    * [b]Blood Oxygen Bar:[/b] Transitions from emerald green to amber orange, culminating in an [b][color=#e74c3c]urgent flashing crimson[/color][/b] during extreme hypoxia.[/*]
[*][b]Hypoxia Vignette:[/b] When blood oxygen drops below 50%, the entire screen starts thumping with a glowing, pulse-modulated full-screen crimson warning vignette.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]⚙️ CONFIGURATION & MODSETTINGSLIB INTEGRATION[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The mod features [b]seamless native integration[/b] with [b]ModSettingsLib[/b] (the official, standard menu configuration library for [i]Casualties Unknown[/i]).

[size=4][b]1. Robust Soft Dependency Architecture[/b][/size]
The mod is built using a resilient soft-dependency pattern:[/*]
[*][b]If ModSettingsLib is installed:[/b] The mod automatically registers a beautifully designed, native configuration tab under the game's "Mod Settings" menu. The player can adjust and rebind all breathing settings in-game with real-time feedback.[/*]
[*][b]If ModSettingsLib is missing:[/b] The mod gracefully falls back to using the standard BepInEx .cfg configuration file without throwing any assembly load errors or crashing.

[size=4][b]2. Localization & Description Registration[/b][/size]
The mod plugs into the game's native localization system ([i]Locale.currentLang.other[/i]) to inject highly descriptive titles, keybind labels, and interactive hover tips:[/*]
[*][b]Tab Title:[/b] Manual Breathing[/*]
[*][b]Enable Mod:[/b] Manual Breathing Mod — [i]Enable or disable all manual breathing mechanics and HUD features.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Inhale Key:[/b] Inhale Key — [i]The key you hold down to draw fresh air into your lungs.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Exhale Key:[/b] Exhale Key — [i]The key you hold down to push stale carbon dioxide out of your lungs.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Autonomic Respiration:[/b] Autonomic Respiration (Sleep) — [i]If true, your character will breathe automatically (slowly/shallowly) while unconscious. If false, you will suffocate.[/i]

[size=4][b]3. Real-Time Dynamic Synchronization[/b][/size]
No restarts required! Any changes made in the in-game "Mod Settings" tab are:
1. Instantly updated in the game's runtime memory.
2. Dynamically picked up by the BreathingController in real-time.
3. Automatically saved to disk back into the BepInEx config file.

Name: Manual Blinking
Summary: Blink manually or sum, don't die
Description:
[size=6][b]Manual Blinking & Focus Mod 👁️[/b][/size]

An immersive, high-stakes physiological simulation mod for [b]Casualties Unknown[/b]. This mod replaces passive visual clarity with a manual ocular regulation loop. Players must periodically blink to moisten their eyes, manage ocular dryness under harsh environmental conditions, and survive high-tension involuntary squinting or forced blinking during critical gameplay moments.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]CORE MECHANICS[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[size=4][b]1. The Dryness Loop (drynessLevel)[/b][/size]
[*]Your eyes dry out naturally over time.[/*]
[*][b]Base Dryness Rate:[/b] Takes roughly [i]0.8 seconds[/i] (with default [color=#f1c40f]BaseDrySpeed = 1.25f[/color]) to go from fully hydrated to dangerously dry. This ensures players must blink regularly and keep watch of ocular state.[/*]
[*][b]Environmental & Physical Scaling:[/b]
    * [b]Wind / Movement Velocity:[/b] Movement speed (retrieved via [color=#e74c3c]body.rb.velocity[/color]) pushes air into your eyes, increasing dry-out speed by up to [b]2.2x[/b] at terminal velocities.
    * [b]Submersion (inWater):[/b] Opening eyes underwater or getting splashed increases irritation and salt/chlorine drying by [b]3.0x[/b].
    * [b]Severe Injury / Pain:[/b] Ocular fatigue increases under intense pain or high heart rate.

[size=4][b]2. Manual Blinking & Eye Closure[/b][/size][/*]
[*][b]Manual Blink Key:[/b] Pressing a single key (default: [b]CapsLock[/b]) triggers a quick blink cycle, resetting [color=#f1c40f]drynessLevel[/color] back to [color=#f1c40f]0.0f[/color].[/*]
[*][b]Ocular Focus (Holding closed):[/b] Keeping the blink key held down closes your eyelids permanently.
    * [b]Smooth Cinematic Fading:[/b] Instead of instantly snapping dark, the eyelids fade to dark [b]really fast[/b] (~0.06 seconds) when closed, and fade back to normal [b]slightly slower[/b] (~0.25 seconds) when released, providing a smooth visual transition.
    * [b]Benefits:[/b] Rapidly relieves dryness, aids in recovering from temporary blindness (e.g., flashes/glare), and dampens intense camera shakes.
    * [b]Consequence:[/b] Complete blackout—you are blind to your surroundings while your eyes are closed.

[size=4][b]3. The Threat: Dry Eye Penalties[/b][/size]
As [i]drynessLevel[/i] passes certain thresholds, your ocular control degrades progressively:[/*]
[*][b]Stage 1: Cinematic Squint (> 40% Dryness):[/b] Two dark cinematic eyelid bands close in from the top and bottom of the screen, physically narrowing your vertical field of view to simulate squinting through dry irritation.[/*]
[*][b]Stage 2: Stinging Red Vignette & Violent Spasms (> 50% Dryness):[/b]
    * A custom, procedurally generated red vignette crawls onto the edges of your screen and pulsates, simulating throbbing eyeball irritation.
    * Visual camera twitches and muscle spasms increase in frequency and violence as dryness reaches 100%.[/*]
[*][b]Stage 3: Stamina Drain, Slowdown & Pain Groans (> 70% Dryness):[/b]
    * [i]No Automatic Blinking:[/i] You will [b]never[/b] automatically blink when it is too late. You must manage eye closure manually.
    * [i]Stamina Exhaustion (> 70% Dryness):[/i] Eye strain drains body stamina ([i]body.stamina[/i]) steadily over time.
    * [i]Slowdown (> 85% Dryness):[/i] Movement velocity slows down as severe eye irritation disrupts spatial coordination.
    * [i]Agony Vocalizations (100% Dryness):[/i] Stinging eye pain triggers periodic choking or gasping vocalizations from your player character.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]TECHNICAL ARCHITECTURE[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[size=4][b]Plugin.cs[/b][/size][/*]
[*]Initializes the BepInEx plugin and hooks into [i]Body.HandleCirculation[/i] to dynamically inject the [i]BlinkingController[/i] component onto the player character.[/*]
[*]Handles native configuration bindings ([i]ConfigEntry[/i]) for blink keybinds, dry-out speed multipliers, and visual scales.[/*]
[*]Registers with [b]ModSettingsLib[/b] (soft dependency) to add an [b]"Ocular Care / Manual Blinking"[/b] settings tab directly inside the game's native options screen, allowing toggleable configurations and custom keys.

[size=4][b]BlinkingController.cs[/b][/size][/*]
[*]Maintains the state variables ([i]drynessLevel, blinkProgress, isBlinking[/i], etc.).[/*]
[*]Monitors physical speed via [i]body.rb.velocity.magnitude[/i] and environmental factors.[/*]
[*]Features a custom [i]OnGUI()[/i] HUD layer that draws:
    * [b]The Cinematic Eyelid Squint:[/b] Dual horizontal black boxes expanding towards the center as dryness rises.
    * [b]The Complete Blackout:[/b] Fullscreen fade-to-black when eyes are closed or blinking.

Name: ExpSneeze
Summary: Congratulations, your Experiment has allergies now. Adds periodic sneezing as a mechanic to Casualties: Unknown! Fully configurable!
Description:
Adds a sneezing mechanic to Casualties: Unknown.

Sneezes build up slowly over the course of 7.5 minutes on their own, but are accelerated by digging (getting dust in your nose!). When you're ready to sneeze, you'll start sneezing a random number of times, briefly losing consciousness, receiving mild knockback, and losing 1% of your stamina for each sneeze. There is also a 1 in 10 chance for you to drop whatever you're holding in your mouth each sneeze. You will never sneeze if you're wearing a dust mask!

All values are configurable in the game settings, tweak to your heart's content!

[size=5][b]Requires BepInEx and CUCoreLib![/b][/size]

Banner art by me :3

GitHub Repository: [url=https://github.com/IAmLeftie/ExpSneeze]https://github.com/IAmLeftie/ExpSneeze[/url]
Author: IAmLeftie

- Made it so you can no longer sneeze while unconscious (different from sleeping) or concussed.

- Can now craft a dust mask using the makeshift mask and other materials.

Name: All Wearable Can Be Held
Summary: Allows all wearable equipment to be held and stored in your inventory. 让所有可穿戴装备都能手持和放入道具栏。
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Tired of juggling two packs or bags just to move items around? Wondering why a foliage bag with two ropes can't be carried in hand?
Now all wearable equipment — armor, backpacks, and everything else — can be held in hand and stored in your inventory.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Make sure BepInEx is installed
2. Place "AllWearableCanBeHeld.dll" into "BepInEx/plugins/" folder
3. Launch the game[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]All wearable items (armor, backpacks, etc.) can now be equipped, held in hand, or stored in the inventory — just like an Autopump.
Does not affect any other stats or attributes of the items.
Multiplayer compatibility has not been tested yet — hopefully it works![/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]BepInEx (5.4.x)[/color]

[b][size=4]介绍[/size][/b]
厌恶了来回装备两个背包来倒腾道具吗？疑惑为什么加了两根背带的纤维袋就不能抓在手里了吗？
现在所有的装备（无论是护甲还是背包）都可以手持和放入道具栏了。

[b][size=4]安装方法[/size][/b]
1. 确保已安装 BepInEx
2. 将 AllWearableCanBeHeld.dll 放入 BepInEx/plugins/ 文件夹
3. 启动游戏即可

[b][size=4]功能[/size][/b]
所有能装备的道具（无论是护甲还是背包）都可以像自动泵那样，既能装备，也能手持和放入道具栏了。
不影响装备的其他数值。
尚未测试多人联机的兼容性——希望是兼容的。

[b]前置依赖[/b]
BepInEx (5.4.x)
