Description:
Quick Medical Automation is a BepInEx medical automation mod made for Scav Prototype / Casualties Unknown Demo.
It automatically evaluates the player's current condition and uses accessible medical supplies in priority order, focusing first on critical life signs, severe blood loss, major bleeding, glass / shrapnel, fractures / dislocations, infection / sepsis, and severe pain or opiate withdrawal.
The goal of this mod is not to “play the game for you,” but to reduce repetitive medical micromanagement so you can focus more on exploration, survival, and combat decisions.
[b]Main Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Automatically evaluates the player's current vitals and injuries[/*]
[*]Automatically uses accessible medical supplies for treatment[/*]
[*]Recursively scans inventory slots and container contents for medical items[/*]
[*]Prioritizes severe blood loss, open wounds, and critical conditions[/*]
[*]Automatically removes glass / shrapnel[/*]
[*]Automatically handles dislocations and fracture splinting[/*]
[*]Automatically handles infection, sepsis, and local disinfection[/*]
[*]Automatically manages pain relief and opiate withdrawal when needed[/*]
[*]Supports both Chinese and English[/*]
[*]Includes an in-game standalone configuration panel[/*]
[*]Supports notification mode, scan interval, panel scale, and opacity adjustment[/*]
[/list][b]How to Use[/b]
[b]Default Hotkeys[/b]
[list]
[*]F8: Toggle auto treatment on / off[/*]
[*]F9: Run one immediate smart treatment pulse[/*]
[*]F11: Open / close the config panel[/*]
[/list][b]Interface[/b]
[list]
[*]Open the standalone settings panel in-game[/*]
[*]Settings can be changed live without restarting the game[/*]
[/list][b]Configurable Options[/b]
[list]
[*]Master automation toggle[/*]

[*]Treatment mode (Conservative / Balanced / Aggressive)[/*]

[*]Scan interval[/*]
[*]Panel scale[/*]
[*]Panel opacity[/*]
[*]Whether specific medicine, dressing, and splint categories may be used automatically[/*]
[/list][b]Currently Supported Major Item Types[/b]
[list]
[*]Combat Pen[/*]
[*]Blood bag / Human blood bag[/*]
[*]Blood coagulant[/*]
[*]Various bandages, dressings, and suturing items[/*]
[*]Tweezers[/*]
[*]Splint / Carcass splint[/*]

Tired of the same linear progression? This mod randomizes your journey through the layers! Start on a random layer and each time you go deeper, you teleport to another random layer. 

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install BepInEx (if not already installed)[/*]
[*]Copy RandomLayer.dll to BepInEx/plugins[/*]

[/list][b][size=4]Configuration[/size][/b]

After launching the game once with the new version, a configuration file will appear at: BepInEx/config/com.purpleuser.randomlayer.cfg
Open it with any text editor. You can change the following settings:

Setting: StartLayer
Values: -1 (random), 0, 1, 2, 3, 4
Layer you start on. -1 = random (original behaviour).

Setting: RandomTransitions
Values: true / false
If true, every time you go down you teleport to a random layer. If false, normal linear progression (0→1→2→3→4).

Setting: ExcludeLayers
Values: comma‑separated numbers, e.g. 4 or 3,4
Layers you want to skip during random transitions. Useful for avoiding unbalanced or disliked layers.
Example – always start on layer 1, go random, but never go to layer 4 (overgrown):
StartLayer = 1
RandomTransitions = true
ExcludeLayers = 4

After editing the file, save it and restart the game.

[list]
[*]BepInEx 5[/*]

Tools = true – infinite tools
Weapons = true – infinite weapons
Armor = true – infinite armor
Backpacks = true – infinite backpacks
Containers = true – infinite containers
Clothing = true – infinite clothing

[heading]📋 Requirements[/heading]
◆ BepInEx 5.x or newer
◆ Casualties Unknown Demo
═══════════════════════════════════════
[heading]✓ Compatibility[/heading]
Works with existing saves. No known conflicts with other mods.
═══════════════════════════════════════

Name: DG-Lab EXP BodySync
Summary: Real‑time DG‑Lab haptics for 《Casualties: Unknown》, featuring graded waveforms, strength feedback, dual‑channel body‑part routing, and Socket v2 support.
Description:
[center][size=5][b]DG-Lab EXP BodySync[/b][/size]
BodySync-style DG-Lab feedback for [i]Casualties Unknown[/i][/center]

[line]

[size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size]

[b]DG-Lab EXP BodySync[/b] adds a BodySync-style DG-Lab layer to [i]Casualties Unknown[/i].

Instead of working as a simple damage trigger, it follows the character's body state more closely. Local injuries, body-part changes, pain, bleeding, fractures, dislocations, infection, shock, hypoxia, temperature, consciousness, and related conditions can all become part of the feedback logic.

The result is a more connected DG-Lab experience where feedback can follow both [b]where[/b] something happens and [b]what kind[/b] of condition the character is experiencing.

[line]

[size=4][b]What BodySync Does[/b][/size]

BodySync reads the game's body-state system and sends feedback through [b]DG-Lab Socket v2[/b]. Local effects can be routed by body part, while systemic conditions can be mixed into the background output.

For example, you can bind the head, upper torso, and arms to one DG-Lab channel, while assigning the abdomen and legs to another. Direct injuries can then lean toward the matching channel, while broader physical states may affect both.

This makes the feedback less like a single on/off reaction and more like a layered response to the character's current condition.

[line]

[size=4][b]Main Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]BodySync-style DG-Lab support for [i]Casualties Unknown[/i].[/*]
[*]DG-Lab Socket v2 connection support.[/*]
[*]Embedded Socket backend with in-game QR code generation.[/*]
[*]External Socket backend support for custom setups.[/*]
[*]Configurable A/B channel strength limits.[/*]
[*]Configurable body-part binding for local injury routing.[/*]
[*]Feedback based on injuries, pain, bleeding, fractures, dislocations, infection, shock, hypoxia, temperature, consciousness, and related states.[/*]
[*]In-game DG-Lab menu opened with [b]F10[/b].[/*]
[*]Status overlay, waveform monitor, and debug display.[/*]
[*]Offline status and waveform preview for checking the setup before connecting a device.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]Getting Started[/b][/size]

Install the mod with [b]BepInEx 5[/b], then launch the game and press [b]F10[/b] to open the DG-Lab menu.

If you use the embedded backend, keep your phone and the PC running the game on the same local network. Select the correct LAN address in the menu, refresh the QR code, and scan it with the DG-Lab app.

Before testing, set low A/B strength limits and check the connection state, current strength, and waveform output with the status overlay or waveform monitor.

[line]

[size=4][b]Safety Note[/b][/size]

This mod maps in-game injuries and body states into simulated DG-Lab waveform and strength changes.

Start with low A/B strength limits. Keep the DG-Lab app or device stop controls within reach. Stop immediately if you feel pain, numbness, dizziness, panic, skin irritation, or anything unusual.

[line]

[center][size=4][b]中文说明[/b][/size][/center]

[b]DG-Lab EXP BodySync[/b] 是一个面向 [i]Casualties Unknown[/i] 的 BodySync 风格 DG-Lab 支持模组。

它并不是简单的“受伤就触发输出”。模组会读取角色的身体状态系统，将局部伤害、身体部位变化、疼痛、出血、骨折、脱臼、感染、休克、缺氧、体温、意识等相关状态纳入反馈逻辑。

BodySync 可以根据身体部位将局部效果路由到不同的 DG-Lab 通道，也可以把全身状态混合进背景反馈中。这样反馈不仅能反映“哪里出了问题”，也能反映角色当前处于怎样的整体身体状态。

[size=4][b]主要功能[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]为 [i]Casualties Unknown[/i] 添加 BodySync 风格 DG-Lab 支持。[/*]
[*]支持 DG-Lab Socket v2。[/*]
[*]内置 Socket 后端，可在游戏内生成二维码。[/*]
[*]支持外部 Socket 后端和自定义网络环境。[/*]
[*]可配置 A/B 通道强度上限。[/*]
[*]可配置身体部位绑定，用于局部伤害路由。[/*]
[*]根据伤害、疼痛、出血、骨折、脱臼、感染、休克、缺氧、体温、意识等状态生成反馈。[/*]
[*]按 [b]F10[/b] 打开游戏内 DG-Lab 菜单。[/*]
[*]提供状态悬浮窗、波形监视器和调试显示。[/*]
[*]未连接设备时也可以查看状态和波形，方便先检查设置。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]快速开始[/b][/size]

使用 [b]BepInEx 5[/b] 安装模组后，启动游戏并按 [b]F10[/b] 打开 DG-Lab 菜单。

如果使用内置后端，请确保手机和运行游戏的电脑在同一局域网。然后在菜单中选择正确的局域网地址，刷新二维码，并使用 DG-Lab App 扫码连接。

测试前请先将 A/B 强度上限调低，并通过状态悬浮窗或波形监视器确认连接状态、当前强度和波形输出。

[size=4][b]安全提示[/b][/size]

本模组会根据游戏中的受伤和身体状态，让 DG-Lab 设备输出模拟对应体感的波形和强度变化。

首次使用请从较低的 A/B 强度上限开始，并确保 DG-Lab App 或设备停止控制随时可触达。如果出现疼痛、麻木、头晕、恐慌、皮肤不适或任何异常感受，请立即停止。

[line]

[url=https://github.com/FurLC/DGLab-EXP-BodySync]GitHub Repository[/url]

  行生成或开启联机刷物品规则。
  如果房主没有安装本 Mod，客户端也可以自动回退到 KrokMP 原生的 admin 密码授权方式，不需要单独再换另一套插件。

  Installation instructions

  1. 先安装 BepInEx
  2. 将 ItemSpawnerMenuCN.dll 放入 BepInEx/plugins/
  3. 启动一次游戏，必要时让配置文件自动生成
  4. 进入游戏后按 F7 打开菜单

  联机说明：

  1. 如果想使用“房员申请 -> 房主弹窗确认授权”功能，房主和房员都需要安装本 Mod
  2. 如果房主没有安装本 Mod，也仍然可以通过 KrokMP 的 admin 密码方式授权
  3. 联机刷物品仍然依赖 KrokMP 的管理员权限和服务器规则设置

  Main features

  - F7 打开中文刷物品菜单
  - 支持中文物品名搜索、英文 ID 搜索、分类筛选
  - 支持设置生成数量
  - 支持设置物品耐久 / 状态
  - 支持选择生成位置，例如玩家脚下、鼠标位置、随机位置
  - 提供生成指令预览
  - 重做了整体 UI，界面更清晰、更美观
  - 左侧物品列表和右侧说明区都支持独立滚动
  - 优化了长物品名和长说明的显示，不会再把按钮或布局顶出界面
  - 支持单机直接生成物品
  - 支持联机下通过 KrokMP 管理员命令生成物品
  - 支持房员向房主申请联机刷物品权限
  - 支持房主确认后自动授予管理员权限
  - 支持当房主未安装本 Mod 时自动回退到 admin 密码授权方式

  Requirements

  - BepInEx
  - Casualties Unknown Demo
  - KrokMP / KrokoshaCasualtiesMP（联机功能需要）

  补充说明：

  - 单机使用本 Mod 不依赖 KrokMP
  - 联机刷物品功能需要 KrokMP 的联机环境
  - 房主确认弹窗功能要求房主和房员都安装本 Mod
  - 如果只有客户端安装本 Mod，则会使用 KrokMP 原生管理员密码授权逻辑
  - 联机中如果服务器未开启相关规则，仍需由有权限的一方开启联机刷物品权限

Name: Unknown Enough Items
Summary: A JEI-style item, liquid, and recipe helper for Casualties Unknown Demo, with search, favorites, recipe usages, crafting jumps, and KrokMP multiplayer compatibility.
Description:
[quote][b]Github:[url=https://github.com/MAakber/Unknown-Enough-Items]Github[/url][/b][/quote]
[b][color=#ff7700]Description[/color][/b]

Unknown Enough Items, or UEI, is a JEI-style helper mod for Casualties Unknown Demo. It adds an in-game item, liquid, and recipe browser beside the native inventory and backpack UI, without replacing the original crafting system.

UEI reads runtime game data directly, so it can show item sources, recipe results, usage recipes, generic ingredient candidates, and related crafting chains.

[color=#ff7700][b]Installation instructions[/b][/color]

1. Install BepInEx for Casualties Unknown Demo.
2. Download `UEI.build.dll`.
3. Put the file here:
[code]BepInEx/plugins/UEI/UEI.build.dll[/code]4. Launch the game.
5. Open the native inventory or radial backpack UI to show UEI.

[b][color=#ff7700]Main features[/color][/b]

[list]
[*]Browse runtime items and liquids.[/*]
[*]Search items and filter by category.[/*]
[*]Favorite entries and pin useful recipes.[/*]
[*]Left-click an entry to view source recipes.[/*]
[*]Right-click an entry to view usage recipes.[/*]
[*]Click recipe materials or results to jump through recipe chains.[/*]
[*]Jump to the original crafting panel and select the matching recipe.[/*]
[*]Hover an inventory item and press `U` to open its UEI usage panel.[/*]
[*]Chinese and English UI support.[/*]
[*]KrokMP multiplayer compatibility.[/*]
[*]Cheat mode respects multiplayer command/admin permissions and disables itself when unavailable.[/*]
[/list]
[b][color=#ff7700]Requirements[/color][/b]

- Casualties Unknown Demo
- BepInEx
- TextMeshPro runtime dependencies from the game
- KrokMP is optional and only required for multiplayer compatibility features

[color=#ff7700][b]Shout outs[/b][/color]

Inspired by JEI-style item and recipe browsers. Thanks to the Casualties Unknown community for testing, feedback, and multiplayer compatibility reports.

[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]

ScavLib is a foundational developer-focused API and utility library designed to simplify mod development for [b]Scav Prototype (a.k.a. Casualties Unknown)[/b]. It streamlines common tasks such as building in-game menus, managing configurations, registering console commands, handling custom events, interacting safely with the game state, and working with player vitals, skills, and items.

[quote][b]Note for players:[/b] This is a core dependency library. It does not add any content on its own, but is required by other mods to function.[/quote][line]
[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Ensure you have [b]BepInEx 5[/b] installed for Scav Prototype.[/*]
[*]Download [font=Courier New]ScavLib.dll[/font].[/*]
[*]Place [font=Courier New]ScavLib.dll[/font] into your game directory under [font=Courier New]BepInEx/plugins/[/font].[/*]
[*]Launch the game. To verify it loaded correctly, open the developer console and type:
[code]scavlib status[/code]You should see ScavLib's version, authors, and all registered mods printed to the console.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b][size=5]Regarding multiplayer support[/size][/b]
[b]Multiplayer games are theoretically supported, both the client and server need to have ScavLib installed.[/b]

[b]Of course, if you discover any new issues, we recommend that you submit an issue report to the DLL repository on GitHub.[/b]

Name: Cu-SaveManager
Summary: Roll back a fixed world—same layer, same layout, same spot. Save & exit to menu; your EXP dog survives. Multi slots, timed backups, death rollback. QoL/KrokMP.||固定世界可回档：同层地形、落点都能复现。随时存档并退出回主菜单，EXP 小狗不会自爆。多槽+定时备份。兼容 QoL、KrokMP
Description:
[b][u]SaveManager[/u][/b]

推荐选择生成世界的方法使用本mod的，KrokMP当前保存世界会固定保存到下一层级，而不是保存当前层级

Fixed-world multi-save for *Casualties: Unknown*—rollback brings back the same layer, terrain, and position. **Save & Exit** writes your run and returns to the main menu; your EXP dog does not die on exit. Timed auto-backups, manual slots, death rollback. Soft-compatible with QoL Unknown and KrokMP (host-driven rollback in multiplayer).
[b]
Installation[/b]

Install to:

`<GameFolder>/BepInEx/plugins/SaveManager/SaveManager.dll`

If you use a mod manager, create a `SaveManager` folder inside `plugins` and move this mod into it.
[b]
How to use[/b]

- Main menu: click **Save Manager** (panel is English / Chinese).
- **Saves**: snapshot the current run into slots; load or delete later.
- **Save & Exit**: save and quit to the menu without killing your EXP dog.
- **Rollback**: rewind to a recent slot; optional auto-rollback on death.
- **Settings**: timed backups, fixed-world engine (QoL or this mod), seeds, position mode, hotkeys.

CuHotbar merges its settings as an extra tab when SaveManager is installed.
[b]
Links[/b]

- GitHub: [[url=https://github.com/huanxin996/Cu-SaveManager]huanxin996/Cu-SaveManager[/url]]
- Details: see the GitHub README.

---

《未知伤亡》固定世界多存档模组——回档可复现同层地形与落点。**存档并退出**会写盘并回到主菜单，EXP 小狗不会因退出而自爆。支持定时自动备份、手动多槽、死亡回档；软兼容 QoL Unknown 与 KrokMP（多人由主机驱动回档）。

[b]安装[/b]

安装路径：

`<游戏目录>/BepInEx/plugins/SaveManager/SaveManager.dll`

若使用 mod 管理器，建议在 `plugins` 下新建 `SaveManager` 文件夹并放入本模组。
[b]
使用[/b]

- 主菜单点击 **存档管理**（面板支持中/英）。
- **存档**分页：把当前冒险快照到槽位，随时读取或删除。
- **存档并退出**：保存后回主菜单，EXP 小狗不会死。
- **回档**分页：回到最近槽位；可开启死亡自动回档与倒计时。
- **设置**分页：定时备份、固定世界引擎（QoL 或本 mod）、种子、位置模式、快捷键。

安装 SaveManager 后，CuHotbar 可把设置合并为额外分页。

[b]链接[/b]

- GitHub：[[url=https://github.com/huanxin996/Cu-SaveManager]huanxin996/Cu-SaveManager[/url]]
- 详细说明见 GitHub README。

To deal with this, download it from its repository [url=https://github.com/bepinex/bepinex]here[/url], extract it in your 'Casualties Unknown Demo' folder, and run the game once to let it generate all its associated folders and stuff.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Second: Get RshLib, which is a prerequisite library that enables custom items, and the Gun Loader relies upon it. You may find it [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/32]here[/url], and just plop and extract this in the 'plugins' folder within the 'BepInEx' folder. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Third: Get the New Gun Loader mod. You can find it [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/57?tab=description]here[/url], and just extract it in the same way as RshLib in the 'plugins' folder.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Fourth: Download this mod and overwrite (or just add) its contents into the 'NewGun' folder by the Gun Loader mod.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Fifth: Happy hunting![/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[b][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][u]Guns Featured:[/u][/size][/color][/b]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Desert Tech MDRx Micron '[i]Interceptor[/i]': An exceptionally compact, yet powerful semi-automatic rifle that makes it a good all-rounder for any solo incursion. While this would be tiny in a regular human's hands, it fits perfectly for an expie to wield with little issue. Be sure to still consider its somewhat bulky nature however, as the polymer body does take up a good chunk of storage regardless.[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]KRISS Vector '[i]Prototype[/i]' (Moniker shamelessly ripped from Gunsaw): A 9mm submachine gun with a lightweight stock and a unique design that lets it mitigate the emitted recoil significantly, so much so that you can use it one-handed without too much trouble. Its only limiting feature is that it shares its magazines with the 17-round pistol ones, which could fare a detriment in more 'prolonged' engagements.[/size][/color][/*]
[*][size=3]SIG MCX Raptor '[i]Rabid[/i]': A fast-firing automatic carbine, intended to just get as much lead out the barrel as fast as possible. While it's somewhat lightweight and packs quite a punch, its recoil is borderline uncontrollable under full blast even with the stock. It's still however, a great option if you happen to have way too much rifle ammunition sitting around that you want to burn through.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]KelTec KSG '[i]Oppressor[/i]': A notoriously unusual pump-action shotgun, with the distinct ability to house a whopping fifteen shells in a relatively tight gun, split across two barrels. This lets you fire for much longer, and more accurately thanks to the choked design of the shotgun. It is however, a bit too large for an expie to comfortably wield, and as such is cumbersome to both store and use.[/size][/*]
[/list]

# Multiplayer Sprite Replacer 1.2.0
- Updated compatibility for Krokosha Multiplayer 4.0.0.
- Added `st0` skin slot support with a default `Keypad0` keybind.
- Added the `msr` console command.
- Added `msr equip <slot>` to equip a local slot such as `st1`.
- Added `msr download <slot> <url>` for remote skins, for example `msr download st1 https://skin.cat-bot.de/d/423`.
- Added `msr reload` to reload the current slot from disk.
- Added `msr ban <username>` and `msr unban <username>` to locally hide or restore another player's custom skin.
- Added `msr bans`, `msr list`, and `msr verbose <true|false>`.
- Added an MSR tab to the in-game settings menu.
- Added slot equip, reload, and URL download controls in the settings menu.
- Added a settings-menu URL textbox for remote skin downloads.
- Added in-game keybind editing for `st0` through `st9`.
- Added automatic refresh when the current slot's PNG files change on disk.
- Added persistent saving for the last selected slot, downloaded slot URLs, recent URLs, and banned players.
- Added a verbose logging setting for debugging.
- Fixed non-MSR players sometimes receiving mismatched `st1` limb sprites.

[b][color=#ff7700]Description[/color][/b]

Item Spawner is an in-game item spawning plugin for Casualties Unknown Demo V6.1.

It adds a draggable item spawner panel that lets you search registered game items, filter by category or favorites, and spawn items with configurable quantity, durability, and spawn mode.

This mod is intended for local testing, debugging, sandbox play, and single-player convenience.

[b][color=#ff7700]Compatibility[/color][/b]

Tested only on Casualties Unknown Demo V6.1.

Compatibility with other game versions is unknown.

[b][color=#ff7700]Installation instructions[/color][/b]

1. Install BepInEx for the game.
2. Download the mod archive.
3. Extract the archive into the game root folder.
4. Confirm the DLL is located at:
[code]BepInEx/plugins/ItemSpawner/ItemSpawner.build.dll[/code]5. Launch the game.
6. Press `LeftControl + I` to open or close the panel.

[b][color=#ff7700]Main features[/color][/b]

[list]
[*] Search and spawn registered in-game items.[/*]
[*] Category filter.[/*]
[*] Favorites filter.[/*]
[*] Persistent favorites.[/*]
[*] 中文 / English UI.[/*]
[*] Draggable and scalable panel.[/*]
[*] Passthrough mode, allowing player controls while the panel is open.[/*]
[*] Native item tooltip when hovering item icons.[/*]
[*] Spawn to inventory, at player position, or at mouse position.[/*]
[/list]
[b][color=#ff7700]Requirements[/color][/b]

[list]

Thanks to the Casualties Unknown Demo community and BepInEx modding ecosystem.

Name: Killer's Guns
Summary: Adds firearms! Woo!
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Adds a handful of guns, using sprites I made for a ss14 fork called FarHorizons (SS14 sprites and Casualties Unknown's are, interestingly, very compatible with eachother)[/color]

Mostly a personal mod.
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Install New Gun Loader [/color]
Install this mod
Put the contents of Killer_Guns.zip into the NewGun folder
Enjoy :D
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod adds

Shotguns -
- Sentinel (24 round semiautomatic, has a 0.5s delay between shots)
The SS14 version of this is mag-fed but pump action. As funny as this would be, no shotgun magazines so you're spared.. for now.

- Combat Shotgun (12 round semiautomatic)
Holds more, with more recoil.

- Krammer5001 (8 round semiautomatic, low recoil)
Better shotgun, not much to say.

LMGs -
- M429 (Manually loaded like a shotgun, 100 rifle rounds. Does a bit more damage than a rifle.)
I would have LOVED to give this thing magazines, but, making items by json isn't a thing. Yet. Best I could do.

Rifles -
- Lecter Type-T (Low recoil)
Just a better rifle. Added stock makes the gun actually controllable.

- Lecter Type-F (Low recoil, higher damage than a rifle. 0.5s delay between shots)
An advanced Lecter, same concept. Shoots slower though.

Pistols -
- P91 (Machine pistol, extremely fast RoF but almost no accuracy)
Hold down left trigger and watch the utter obliteration of something two feet in front of you.

- N1984 (.44 Magnum, extremely high damage/recoil, uses pistol magazines and has a 0.5s delay between shots)[/color]
Solid sidearm if you can find it. Salad doesn't stand a chance against someone who can aim.

Railguns - 
- N2461 (Pistol / 2k damage per shot / High recoil / 1s delay between shots / Loud)
Just a good sidearm. Will deafen you.

- IFV-2461 (Rifle / 6k damage per shot / Ridiculous recoil / 3s delay between shots / Loud / Heavy)
The recoil generated by this weapon is high enough to perform gun-jumps, but the game is weird about it. If you aim too far up you will be launched upwards, and if you aim too far down you will be crushed into the ground. Consider this your warning before you accidentally end your run. Do gun-jumps at an angle.

Originally was going to use shotgun rounds to round out advanced weapons, but then I couldn't do magazine states which is part of the appeal of me doing high-tech guns.

Description:
[center][b][size=5]《维基中文》(更强大的翻译)[/size][/b][/center]
[center][img width=320,height=320]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dodo23333/cu-chinese-wiki-translations/main/docs/images/logo.png[/img][/center]
[center][img]https://img.shields.io/github/license/dodo23333/cu-chinese-wiki-translations[/img] [img]https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/dodo23333/cu-chinese-wiki-translations[/img] [img]https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/yaml?label=beta-version&url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Fdodo23333%2Fcu-chinese-wiki-translations%2Fmain%2F%25E7%25BB%25B4%25E5%259F%25BA%25E4%25B8%25AD%25E6%2596%2587%25E4%25B8%25AD%25E9%2597%25B4%25E6%2596%2587%25E4%25BB%25B6.yaml&query=%24.version&color=orange[/img] [img]https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/dodo23333/cu-chinese-wiki-translations/total?logo=github&color=blue[/img] [img]https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://gist.githubusercontent.com/dodo23333/ef17a6816a5bbc1928c4c1a329683a4a/raw/scavprototype-64-downloads.json[/img][/center]
[b][size=4]说明：[/size][/b]
[b]《维基中文》(更强大的翻译)[/b]是一个扩展性中文翻译
将[b]大量的数值，功能描述及游戏心得[/b]添加进了几乎所有物品、建筑、液体、健康面板以及生物的描述之中
数据来源主要通过官方中文wiki以及解包，因此称为"维基中文"，简称"维中"

Name: Comprehensive revision
Summary: A comprehensive series of modifications to the game's own DLLs (not involving cheating)
Description:
Description
本 DLL 补丁深度重写了《Casualties Unknown》的技能与生存系统。原版游戏技能超过 31 级或更高的等级会导致经验值溢出并卡死，角色成长上限低，大量属性（如智力）缺乏存在感。此模组彻底修复溢出问题，将所有属性上限安全扩展至 1000 级，并为力量、韧性、智力新增了全面且符合直觉的加成——高力量能强化装备效果，高韧性获得更强恢复和防御，高智力则加速全局经验获取。角色将随着等级提升感受到真正的数值碾压。
详细改动列表已随附在下载文件中。

Description
This DLL patch deeply rewrites the skill and survival systems of Casualties Unknown. In the original game, skills exceeding level 31 or higher cause experience overflow and freeze, with a low growth ceiling and many attributes (like Intelligence) lacking presence. This mod completely fixes the overflow issue, safely extending all stat caps to level 1000, and adds comprehensive, intuitive bonuses for Strength, Resilience, and Intelligence – high Strength enhances equipment effectiveness, high Resilience grants stronger recovery and defense, and high Intelligence accelerates global experience gain. As you level up, you will truly feel the numerical domination.
A detailed change log is included with the download.

Installation instructions
1. 打开游戏安装目录：
  Steam\steamapps\common\Casualties Unknown Demo\CasualtiesUnknown_Data\Managed
2. 备份原始 Assembly-CSharp.dll 文件（强烈建议）。
3. 将下载的 Assembly-CSharp.dll 复制到上述目录，覆盖原文件。
4. 启动游戏即可生效。

Installation instructions
1. Navigate to the game installation folder:
  Steam\steamapps\common\Casualties Unknown Demo\CasualtiesUnknown_Data\Managed
2. Back up the original Assembly-CSharp.dll (strongly recommended).
3. Copy the downloaded Assembly-CSharp.dll into the above folder, overwriting the original file.
4. Launch the game – the changes will take effect.

Main features
- 突破等级30+经验限制：所有技能上限扩展至 1000 级，经验值不再溢出，告别卡死 bug。
- 技能效果全面重做：
  - 力量：增强装备护甲效率。
  - 韧性：提升凝血、血液再生、伤口愈合、体温稳定、意识恢复等几乎所有身体恢复能力，并提供裸体减伤。
  - 智力：按等级指数级加速所有经验获取，让智力真正成为成长的核心。
- 修复官方未处理的溢出 bug：疼痛为负、反冲力自伤等问题已修正。
- 最小侵入改动：仅修改公式数值，未改变游戏核心架构。
- 支持原版存档，无需新开游戏。（大概吧？）

Main features
- Break through the level 30+ experience limit: all skill caps extended to level 1000, experience no longer overflows, goodbye freeze bug.
- Comprehensive skill effect rework:
  - Strength: boosts equipment armor efficiency.
  - Resilience: improves blood clotting, blood regeneration, wound healing, body temperature stability, consciousness recovery, and almost all other bodily recovery abilities, while also providing unarmored damage reduction.
  - Intelligence: exponentially accelerates all experience gain based on level, making Intelligence a true core growth stat.
- Fixed official overflow bugs: negative pain values and self-damage from recoil have been corrected.
- Minimal invasive changes: only formula values were modified; the core game architecture remains untouched.
- Supports existing save files, no new game required. (Probably?)

Requirements
- 目前仅针对 Steam Demo 版本 v0.61 制作和测试。其他版本可能不兼容。

Requirements
- Currently made and tested only for Steam Demo version v0.61. Other versions may be incompatible.

Shout outs
- 本模组的代码修改全程使用 DeepSeek 专家模式（AI）辅助分析、设计和编写。
- 详细的改动记录随附于下载文件中。任何玩家若有意将其制作为独立 Mod 发布，欢迎自由使用这些修改，无需另行授权。

Shout outs
- The code modifications for this mod were entirely assisted by DeepSeek's Expert Mode (AI) in analysis, design, and writing.
- A detailed change log is attached in the download. If any player wishes to turn these modifications into a standalone mod, feel free to use them without additional permission.

Summary: Fork of Player Sprite Replacer by Karlo Poljančić (dogederp). Switch player sprites in-game using NumPad keys 1-9 without leaving the game.
Description:
[center][quote][b][size=4]ORIGINAL MOD - [/size][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/15?tab=description][b][size=4]https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/15?tab=description[/size][/b][/url][/quote][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/15?tab=description]
[/url]

[left][/left]
[/center]
[left][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/left]
[color=#D4D4D8]This is a modified fork of the original Player Sprite Replacer mod by Karlo Poljančić (dogederp), distributed under the MIT License.

You do NOT need the original mod. This version works completely standalone – just install it as described and it will function on its own.

The original mod allowed replacing the player sprite by manually swapping files. This version adds the ability to switch between multiple custom sprites directly while playing, using the NumPad keys 1 through 9 – no need to leave the game.

HOW IT WORKS:
Inside the CustomSprites folder, there are subfolders named st1, st2, ... st9. Each of these folders contains two subfolders: "head" and "body", which hold the corresponding sprite parts for that slot. The mod comes with pre-loaded sprites in these folders so you can test the functionality immediately. You can replace the contents of st1–st9 with your own sprites as long as you keep the head/body structure.

The code edits were done with the help of an AI neural network. I have no experience in C# programming, so the implementation may not be perfect, but it works. All credit for the core functionality and original assets belongs to Karlo Poljančić.

NOTE: If you don't have a NumPad but really want to use the mod, I can make a separate version with different key bindings. Let me know in the comments.[/color]

[size=4][b]Media
[img]https://i.ibb.co/PvzjkW0B/Video-Project-3.gif[/img]
[youtube]tRlZNJFllXo[/youtube]
Installation instructions [/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Make sure BepInEx is installed for Casualties Unknown Demo.
2. Extract the contents of the ZIP archive into the folder:
  …\steamapps\common\Casualties Unknown Demo\BepInEx\plugins
3. The folder structure should look like:[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[i]  BepInEx\plugins\body_sprite_replacer.dll
  BepInEx\plugins\CustomSprites\[/i][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
      ├── st1\
      │  ├── head\
      │  └── body\
      ├── st2\
      │  ├── head\
      │  └── body\
      └── ... (up to st9)
4. The mod already includes test sprites inside st1–st9, so you can try it out right away.
5. Launch the game.
6. While playing, press NumPad keys 1 through 9 to switch between the sprite sets instantly.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]- Fully standalone – does not require the original mod to be installed.[/b][/color]
- Switch between 9 different sprite sets in real time using NumPad 1-9 keys.
- Each set is stored in a dedicated folder (st1 to st9) with "head" and "body" subfolders.
- Pre-loaded with test sprites so you can see the mod in action immediately.
- Easy customisation: just replace the images inside st1–st9/head and body with your own.
- No need to replace files manually or restart the game.
- Preserves the original sprite replacer functionality.
- Works with the Casualties Unknown Demo (Scav Prototype).
- If you lack a NumPad, a custom keybinding version can be provided upon request (ask in comments).

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Casualties Unknown Demo (Scav Prototype) installed via Steam.
- BepInEx mod loader configured for the game.
- (No other mods are required.)[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to Karlo Poljančić (dogederp) for creating the original Player Sprite Replacer mod and releasing it under the MIT License, which allowed me to make this modified version.

Also thanks to the AI tools that helped me edit the code despite my lack of C# knowledge.

Original game assets by Orsoniks.[/color]

Name: Project Mechanism
Summary: Your Sawian is replaced with a killing machine with the intent of eliminating any unchipped Sawians it can find in the vast cave system below.
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Mechanism Prototype Preview 1.0.8[/b][/size]
[i]A hostile mechanism preview build for Casualties: Unknown[/i][/center]

[size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size]

Mechanism Prototype Preview is an early BepInEx prototype mod for [i]Casualties: Unknown[/i].

It turns your Sawian into a hostile mechanism unit equipped with experimental built-in weapons, protocol tools, diagnostic UI changes, and prototype target/NPC systems. This is not a finished alternate campaign or polished gameplay overhaul yet. It is a preview build meant for footage, testing, and feedback on the core weapon/mechanism concept.

[size=4][b]Current Features[/b][/size]

[b]Mechanism Weapon Selector[/b]
The mechanism has its own built-in weapon selector separate from normal held items. Scroll the mouse wheel to select a mechanism weapon, then use left click to fire, charge, aim, or activate the selected system.

[b]Protocol Laser[/b]
Protocol Laser is a charge weapon with multiple release levels. Select Protocol Laser with the mouse wheel, then hold left click to charge. A quick tap fires a small finger shot; a longer hold releases a sustained palm beam; a full charge releases a much larger two-hand termination beam. Larger beams can keep applying damage while sustained, push through bodies, tear into blocks/buildings, and apply heavier trauma or dismember pressure.

[b]Beam Clash[/b]
Beam Clash is a debug-target interaction for testing opposing Protocol Laser beams. Spawn a debug target with
[code]mechanismbody cursor[/code], then use
[code]mechanismbody clash[/code]or the beam commands to make it fire back. If both beams meet, they can lock into a shared clash point with camera framing and beam-struggle audio. Spam click during the clash to push harder and overpower the opposing beam.

[b]Protocol Scan[/b]
Protocol Scan identifies debug targets before the full protocol flow. Select Protocol Scan with the mouse wheel and left click a target, or use
[code]mechanismbody scan[/code]for testing. Scan tells the mechanism whether a target is chipped, unchipped, unverified, cleared, or valid for protocol escalation.

[b]Protocol Command / Compliance[/b]
Protocol Command lets you order a scanned target to comply instead of immediately executing it. Select Protocol Command and left click after a successful scan, or use
[code]mechanismbody command[/code]. Depending on trust, fear, suspicion, pain, distance, and chip status, the target can submit, resist, flee, panic, become cleared, or become a valid protocol target.

[b]Protocol Evidence HUD[/b]
A diagnostic protocol panel shows scan readiness, aim/range failures, chip verification, trust-floor checks, and target behavior.

[b]Protocol Scan Pulses / Laser Legality Colors[/b]
Scan success/refusal produces a small colored world-space pulse, and Protocol Laser visuals distinguish unverified, cleared, and valid protocol targets.

[b]Head Turret[/b]
Head Turret fires fast head-mounted shots without needing a held gun. Select Head Turret with the mouse wheel and left click, or press [b]G[/b] for the direct debug key.

[b]Sound Cannon[/b]
Sound Cannon is a charge-and-release sonic blast. Select Sound Cannon and hold/release left click, or press [b]H[/b] for the direct debug key. It is a forceful area hit rather than a precise projectile, with pressure-wave distortion and color separation.

[b]Spike Hand[/b]
Spike Hand extends a blade from your arm. Select Spike Hand and hold/release left click, or press [b]J[/b] for the direct debug key. Stab a wall to pin yourself there until you release, which can be used to hang from surfaces or stop movement. Stab a body to impale it and keep it attached to the blade until click/release. While a target is pinned, keep aiming the arm to drag, lift, or turn the body with the spike.

[b]Rocket Hand[/b]
Rocket Hand fires an explosive rocket from the mechanism arm. Select Rocket Hand, hold left click to raise the arm and project a red laser aim line, then release to fire. Rockets travel at medium speed, leave a trail, explode on impact or timeout, damage bodies/buildings/blocks, and shove ragdolls with the blast.

[b]Offhand Grapple[/b]
Offhand Grapple fires a hook from your secondary arm. Select Grapple and left click, or press [b]K[/b] for the direct debug key. Hold after latching to pull yourself toward the latch point or drag against it, then release to retract.

[b]Jump Pad Punch[/b]
Jump Pad Punch is a launch-force melee hit. Select Jump Pad Punch and left click, or press [b]L[/b] for the direct debug key. It can throw you or targets upward and can sometimes trigger Black Flash.

[b]Black Flash[/b]
Black Flash is a high-impact strike with a brief impact-frame effect. Press [b]E[/b] for a guaranteed Black Flash punch. Jump Pad Punch also has a 1-in-6 chance to trigger it.

[b]Perception Module[/b]
Perception Module highlights threats and adds danger projections. Use
[code]mechanismperception 0[/code]through
[code]mechanismperception 3[/code]to change levels. At higher levels the mechanism can respond to incoming hazards more aggressively, including ducking or planking under horizontal turret fire and using head-turret recoil as an airborne emergency dodge when available.

[b]Mechanism Health Panel[/b]
The player identity and several stat labels have been adjusted toward the mechanism theme. The Install Bay/loadout work is where experimental built-in systems are being organized, and the health panel now uses a chip-style mechanism button.

[b]Debug Target Body[/b]
Debug Target Body spawns a passive cloned test body for demonstrating weapons, protocol systems, beam clashes, ragdoll recovery, speech reactions, and targetable limbs. Use
[code]mechanismbody cursor[/code]to spawn one at the cursor, or
[code]mechanismbody[/code]to remove spawned debug bodies.

[b]Gunsaw Sawian Test Bodies[/b]
Gunsaw Sawian Test Bodies are experimental Gunsaw-style debug bodies for visual and combat testing. Use commands such as
[code]gunsawbody base cursor[/code],
[code]gunsawbody all cursor[/code], or
[code]gunsawbody roza cursor armed[/code]. Some have imported sprites, tails, blood colors, and weapon profiles, making them useful for testing impales, rockets, sonic blasts, lasers, and ragdoll behavior.

[b]NPC 9mm Handling[/b]
NPC 9mm Handling lets debug bodies be armed for combat testing without inheriting normal player control. Use the armed Gunsaw/debug body commands or related mechanismbody testing commands to stage weapon interactions.

[b]Testing Tools[/b]
Includes commands for god mode, Gunsaw visual debugging, perception levels, protocol testing, heavy diagnostics, health UI tuning, headless perception tests, Gunsaw runtime prefab tests, and navigation descent self-tests. Most of the prototype's best scenes come from spawning a body, arming it, then combining scan/command/beam clash/spike/rocket/sound cannon interactions.

[size=4][b]Basic Controls[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Scroll Wheel - select mechanism weapon[/*]
[*]Left Click - fire/use selected weapon[/*]
[*]E - guaranteed Black Flash[/*]
[/list]
[b]Direct debug keys still work for quick testing:[/b]

[list]
[*]G - Head Turret[/*]
[*]H - Sound Cannon[/*]
[*]J - Spike Hand[/*]
[*]K - Offhand Grapple[/*]
[*]L - Jump Pad Punch[/*]
[/list]
Mod keybinds are ignored while the in-game console is open.

[size=4][b]Console Commands[/b][/size]

[b]Spawn or remove the main debug target body:[/b]
[code]mechanismbody cursor[/code]
[b]Run without cursor to remove spawned debug bodies:[/b]
[code]mechanismbody[/code]
[b]Show or hide simple debug target thoughts:[/b]
[code]mechanismbody thoughts on
mechanismbody thoughts off[/code]
[b]Beam clash testing:[/b]
[code]mechanismbody clash
mechanismbody beam
mechanismbody beam big[/code]
[b]Protocol testing:[/b]
[code]mechanismbody scan
mechanismbody command
mechanismbody execute
mechanismbody status
mechanismbody chipped
mechanismbody unchipped
mechanismbody resetprotocol[/code]
[b]Heavy debug diagnostics:[/b]
[code]mechanismbody debug
mechanismbody debug on
mechanismbody debug off[/code]
[b]Perception module:[/b]
[code]mechanismperception 0
mechanismperception 1
mechanismperception 2
mechanismperception 3
mechanismperception status
mechanismperception debug[/code]
[b]Gunsaw-style debug bodies:[/b]
[code]gunsawbody base cursor
gunsawbody all cursor
gunsawbody roza cursor armed[/code]
[b]Gunsaw visual debugging:[/b]
[code]gunsawdebug dump
gunsawdebug tail
gunsawdebug rig on
gunsawdebug rig off
gunsawdebug autofit on
gunsawdebug autofit off[/code]
[b]Testing god mode:[/b]
[code]mechanismgod on
mechanismgod off
mechanismgod status[/code]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

This mod requires BepInEx 5.

Extract the archive into your game folder so that the DLL ends up here:

[code]BepInEx/plugins/HeadTurret.dll[/code]
The included weapon sounds should end up here:

[code]BepInEx/plugins/HeadTurretSounds/[/code]
The included Gunsaw/Sawian visual assets should end up here:

[code]CasualtiesUnknownMods/Assets/GunsawExtracted/Sprites/[/code]
[size=4][b]Important Notes[/b][/size]

This is a prototype preview build, not a polished final release.

Expect rough edges, debug behavior, balance issues, unfinished systems, and possible weirdness. It is being shared for footage, testing, and feedback on the core weapon/mechanism concept.

You also can add your own clothing by .json edits!
Doc:
[spoiler]{
    "baseItem": "string", // Advanced only, enter only vanilla items here, remove if you're unsure on what you are doing
    "notWearable": false, // i guess we are doing items now
    "notPaintable": false, // Allows usage of FF00FF
    "limbs": [ "string", ], // All limbs beside "desiredWearLimb" affected by clothing
    "fullname": "string", // Displayed name
    "description": "string", // Displayed description
    "category": "string", // "utility" droppable as utility item, "custom" only traders, "unobtainable" only console commands
    "decayMinutes": 0.0, // Set to 0 to not decay
    "scaleWeight": false,
    "weight": 0.0,
    "desiredWearLimb": "string", // Main limb it worn on, dismembrent bans wearing. If not wearable only defines file name
    "wearSlotId": "string", // Player cant put on 2 wearables with same slot id
    "wearableIsolation": 0.0, // Isolation from temperatures provided by wearable, multiply by 100 to get in %. Doesn't affected by "limbs"
    "wearableArmor": 0.0, // Armor provided to "desiredWearLimb" and "limbs", multiply by 100 to get in %
    "wearableHitDurabilityLossMultiplier": 0.0, // Multiplier of damage wearable takes
    "wearableVisualOffset": 0, // Lower values makes wearable be visually putted below ones with highers value
    "rippableAmount": 0, // Defines rippable quantity
    "value": 0,
    "recognition": 0,
    "decayInfo": 6, // 6 by default
    "isBulletproof": false, // Used by New Firearms 1.5.0+. No effect if no new firearms

    "container": false, // Conflicts with "bottle"
    "maxWeight": 0.0,
    "maxWeightPerItem": 0.0,
    "encumberanceMult": 0.0, // Weight of items in container multiplier by this value
    "itemsVisible": false,
    "tagRestriction": [ "string", ], // Leave empty/null to not have restrictions

    "weightReduction": false, // Requires "container"
    "weightReductionSelf": -0.0, // If operational, this value will get ADDED on top of current enumberance

    "maxBatterySize": 0, // not 0 makes clothing battery powered, 1 - small, 2 - medium, 3 - large

    "explodeAtZero": false, // Explode similar to gravbag when condition reaches below 0.5% and (if battery powered then also have battery)

    "bottle": false, // Confilicts with "container",
    "liquidCapacity": 0.0,
    "defaultLiquid": "string",
    "autoFill": "string",
    "fillmentSpritesPath": "string",
    "drinkAmount" 0.0, // mL to drink on use if notWearable

    "autoZoomBehaviour": false,
    "climbingClawsBehaviour": false, // doesnt drain condioton on walljumps
    "headlampBehaviour": false,

[/list][color=#00ff00]Prosthetic [b]EYE[/b][/color]:

 — a one-shot surgical tool that opens an augment socket directly in a biological arm or leg. Now you can run Powergrip, Steady Hand, Multi-Hacking, or Powersteps without committing to a full prosthetic.

[list]
[*]Powered by small,medium batteries[/*]
[*]Restores sight if its powered[/*]

[*]You can take out the battery while its in your head via wound ui, or pull it out into inventory and do it there[/*]
[*]Battery in the prosthetic eye will take damage instead of the eye if it comes to that, if theres no battery the prosthetic eye may be broken same way a normal eye can.[/*]
[*]Prosthetic eyes can break. If a battery is loaded when it would break, the battery gets destroyed instead and the eye survives — so a charged eye is its own shield.[/*]
[*]Restores your colourvision when mindwiped[/*]
[/list]
[b]Bonesaw[/b]:
[b]Added:[/b] Two new bonesaws — a Makeshift Bonesaw you can craft, and a Medicinal Bonesaw that must be found in the world.
Both allow you to sever a limb regardless of its current state, and do so more efficiently than any other tool.

[b]Plastic fork[/b]: Allows  you to get rid of your "useless" biological eye out to make space for an upgrade.

[color=#9900ff][b]NEW CHALLENGE MODE:[/b][/color]
You start with wooden limbs and an empty prosthetic eye, but just to make it a little more fair you start with 13 int and a flimsy knife at your feet.

[b][color=#00ffff][size=5]NEW UI[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Press V to activate[/*]
[*]You can equip/unequip augments and mods via this interface.[/*]
[*]You can see the statuses of your augmentations and mods (battery charge, uses left ext.)[/*]
[/list][heading]Brain Mods[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Pain Blocker[/b] — Halves all incoming pain. [i]Ejection: brain flash + vomiting.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Trap Detector[/b] — Red glow on beartraps, mines, coils, turrets, spikes. [i]Ejection: brain flash + vomiting.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Sonic Screamer[/b] — Active. 25-unit sonic burst sends nearby creatures fleeing for 2s. [i]3 uses, safe to eject.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Maso chip [/b]— Pain hurts 10% more, but mood rises the more you suffer. [i]Ejection: 5 brain damage, brain flash, 15 head pain.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Adrenaline Surge[/b] — Active. Stand up from any ragdoll, even mid-air. Hurts like hell. [i]3 uses, safe to eject.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Sandivistian[/b] — Active. Military reflex booster, slows perceived time. Severe sickness after 10s. [i]3 uses, can't eject while active, auto-breaks on last use.[/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Scanning Chip [/b]— hold an item, activate, 3 s scan reveals the recipe and permanently marks the item as recognized (saved across runs)[color=#00ff00] ALSO GIVES A DISCOUNT ON RECIPES OF SAID SCANNED ITEMS[/color][/i][/*]
[*][b][i]Lockin  Chip - [/i][/b]keeps your concsiousness at 100% for 30s at the cost of brain damage and head hp, then drops to 30% and normalises

[color=#a4c2f4]Notes:
- brain mods will now be in their own category of items
- brain mods can be found in new Neuromod boxes (1-3 spawn on each layer, you'll need to find em)
- Milkies are more likely to have one brain mod in their catalogue[/color][/*]
[/list]
[color=#ff0000][b]Augmenting Biological Limbs[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#ffffff][b]Augment Implant Tool[/b] — a one-shot surgical tool that opens an augment socket directly in a biological arm or leg. Now you can run Powergrip, Steady Hand, Multi-Hacking, or Powersteps without committing to a full prosthetic.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Use it in the wound view on a Shoulder or Thigh.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]The socket dies with the limb — if the limb gets cut off, the socket is gone.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Augments now are in a sep category, drop only in augment crates and as items in the store[/color][/*]
[/list]
[color=#9900ff][size=5][b]Limb Augments[/b] [/size][/color]
Battery-powered modifications you install into prosthetic limbs (or into a biological limb if you've used an Implant Tool — see below). All come with their own sprites and sound effects. Toggle them and check status from the cybernetics panel (V by default).
[list]
[*][b]Steady Hand[/b] — wrist gyroscope. Cuts gun recoil in half while powered, and shows a live ammo count next to your held item. Small or medium battery.[/*]

Limb mods!

Steady Hand — wrist gyroscope. Cuts gun recoil in half while powered, and shows a live ammo count next to your held item. Takes a small or medium battery.

Other Changes
Prosthetic eyes can now break. If the eye has a battery loaded when it would break, the battery gets destroyed instead and the eye survives.
Titanium arms nerfed. They no longer halve held-item weight, and their hitting / digging damage was lowered.
Titanium legs nerfed. Base speed/jump bonus cut in half (from +25% to +12.5%).
Balance Neuromod is now infinite use with a 1-minute cooldown.
Grappling Hook mod now has a 1-second cooldown between shots.
All titanium limbs have 2 mod slots (up from 1 on legs) — stack two augments per limb.
Leg augments now show up in the cybernetics panel the same way arm ones do.
Trader prices are now correct for every augment, whether it's empty or has a battery in it.
Multiplayer Improvements
Rejoin and your stuff comes back — leave the server and come back, and your prosthetics, augments, batteries, eyes, and brain chips are all restored automatically.
Better sync for mod interactions — installing, ejecting, swapping batteries, and attaching prosthetics all sync more reliably between host and clients.

Name: Re-Growth Serums
Summary: Adds 3 Serums to regrow lost Eyes, Disfigurement, or Limbs! Craftable and Findable! It hurts though, make sure you are prepared. Similar to the Neuralbooster.
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Tested and made on Steam version 7.0

Adds 3 Craftable and Findable Serums to regrow lost Eyes, Disfigurement/Jaw or Limbs!

It hurts regenerating eyes, and quite violent to your body for limbs though, so make sure you are prepared.

Should Fully work in Steam MP with latest CUCore
Also basically compatible out of the box with [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/YOU1ARE0IC][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/YOU1ARE0IC]YOU1ARE0IC[/url]'s wonderful [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/40]Prosthetics[/url] mod[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Just install like other Item mods that use CUCore, right into your "/BepInEx/plugins" folder
Should have ReGrowthSerums.dll next to the CUCoreLib.dll[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b][u][i]Eye Growth Serum:[/i][/u][/b]
- Regrows one eye per use[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Used like a Neural Booster
- Similar side effects as if using a second NeuralBooster (Much much lighter though, mostly just some pain, minor head tissue damage, drop in hunger, and jump in body temp)

- Can even use after losing both eyes from the NeuralBooster! (Weakens the boosters effects though, and causes new and stronger side effects, you got a bigger brain so...)
- Rough effects If used after having used any Neural Booster: 
50 sickness
10 brain damage
Vomit
Undo part of the effect of the booster by 10% (Boosters Increase by 25%, so getting one eye back would result in the booster only boosting stats by 15%, and both eyes would be only a 5% boost.)

-Also, same mindwipe and hollow effect if used under the effects of brain grow sickness.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[b][i][u]Limb Re-Growth Serum:[/u][/i][/b][/color]
- Used like an L.R.D. on the health panel. (But Sir, how can I apply to the missing limb?)
- Use on an existing limb! Regrows an adjacent limb! (If you got no arms, use on your chest and a new stubby bicep will grow, just the bicep though, need multiple usages to regrow a whole arm or leg)
- Very violent, so does a bunch of pain and tissue damage to the host limb, breaks their bones, and leaves open and internal wounds on both limbs. (so be prepared to patch it up)
- Fresh new limb starts with 0 usability, you need to let it heal/regrow after.
- Some strong disinfectant is also applied with the usage, but not enough to fully prevent infection if you have low immunity

- Restrictions: Cannot use on a very damaged limb, you need to have at least 80 skin and muscle health on the donor limb. (Broken bones are fine!)

[b][u][i]Disfigurement Growth Serum:[/i][/u][/b]
- Regrows Disfigurement/Jaw
- Used like a Eyegrowth Serum

- Much safer to use then the other, just causes a bit of sickness and minor negative effects of the eye growth serum.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]CUCoreLib and its requirements[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]RushellXYZ for their RshLib and their other mods with their source code so I could see how it was done for the first version.
CUCoreLib and their team for a very nice and easy to work with framework.[/color]

Name: RshLib
Summary: Small library for adding custom items. Doesn't do anything on its own.
Description:
[size=4][font=Arial][url=https://github.com/rushellxyz/rshlib]GitHub[/url] repository[/font][/size]

[b][size=4][font=Arial]Installation instruction[/font][/size][/b]
Download `RshLib.3.1.0` and put RshLib.dll into BepInEx/plugins
You can ensure that RshLib is loaded by seeing "This is a modded beta" in top of screen

[size=4][b]If you're installing mods for first time (dont have BepInEx)[/b][/size]
Go to BepInEx download page
https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases/tag/v5.4.23.5
And download BepInEx_win_x64_5.4.23.5
Open steam, choose browse local file
Extract BepInEx contents into game folder's root (winhttp.dll should be in same folder as executable)
Open game once and close
Now folder BepInEx/plugins should be created

Additional instruction for Linux users:
[spoiler]Add  `WINEDLLOVERRIDES="winhttp=n,b"  %command%` into launch arguments[/spoiler]
[b][size=4]Multiplayer support![/size][/b]
Both client and server should have RshLib and all other mods

[b][size=4]Known bugs[/size][/b]
Kind of conflicts with CUCoreLib
Kind of conflicts with Casualties xl


[b][size=4]For developers[/size][/b]
[spoiler]Why are you even need RshLib?
In a nutshell: If two different mods try to implement code for custom items, only one will work. RshLib implements this code and other mods now tells RshLib to add they're item into that code

Building example
Put RshLib.dll into BepInEx/plugins/
In RshLibExample.csproj replace all /home/rushell/Documents/CU/ to your path to game
then `dotnet build`
Put RshLibExample.dll from bin/Debug/netstandard2.1/ to BepInEx/plugins/
And put neuraldestroyer.png to BepInEx/plugins/ too

Writing plugin for custom item:
There's source code of example, you might wanna check it
Firstly add reference to RshLib.dll into csproj
Add com.rushellxyz.rshlib to BepInExDependency
Create new ItemInfo, you can see how it works in game's code
Give your item fullname, description
ALWAYS call SetTags() for every ItemInfo
And call RshLib.Plugin.RegisterItem(itemId, new RshItem
{
  sprite = Sprite,
  info = ItemInfo
})
There's also onSpawn option in case if you wanna add component to item and baseItem if you wanna fix to shitty colliders

P.S. The thumbnail is supposed to be like a gears, but im not an artist to draw >< if someone could upload something better i will make it a thumbnail[/spoiler]

Name: Time Limit Unknown
Summary: A very basic, and lightweight mod that allows you to change the default Time Limit in Casualties: Unknown.
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]

[i]Note:  To my knowledge, Time Limit: Unknown is fully compatible with the latest Steam Demo / Beta release (v6.x)[/i]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I created Time Limit: Unknown, to fix a simple problem I had with the built-in Time Limit in Casualties: Unknown.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Although you can toggle the Time Limit On / Off using the built-in difficulty settings, there is no way to configure the actual Time Limit itself. This mod aims to fix that problem by allowing you to adjust the Time Limit using a configuration file.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Do you want to double the Time Limit, and set it to something like 2 Hours? You can do that.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Trying to speed run? You want to make the Time Limit even less forgiving, like 20 or 30 minutes? You can do that. [/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Do you absolutely hate yourself? Do you hate having fun? Do you want the Rad Line to start immediately? You can do that. Just set it to 0 or 1.[/color][/size]



[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]

You will need BepInEx / Harmony in order for Time Limit: Unknown. If you don't know how to install or use BepInEx with this game, see the installation instructions.



[size=4][b]Installation and Usage Instructions
[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Full Installation Instructions:[/size][/color]
[spoiler][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][i]Note for Linux users:  You will likely need to use something like Wine or Proton to run the game when using a Linux based Operating System. Modded or not.
[/i][/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*]Download BepInEx from the official repository:  [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases/download/v5.4.23.5/BepInEx_win_x64_5.4.23.5.zip]https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases/download/v5.4.23.5/BepInEx_win_x64_5.4.23.5.zip[/url] ([url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases]https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases[/url]). Make sure to specifically download the win_x64 version.[/*]
[*]Go to the folder / directory where the Casualties: Unknown game is located / installed (specifically, the folder containing CasualtiesUnknown.exe).[/*]
[*]Extract / Copy all of the contents in the BepInEx archive directly into the folder (the one containing CasualtiesUnknown.exe)[/*]

Overview

This mod completely reworks corpse detection mechanics. Instead of vanilla instant detection within a 7-tile radius (ignoring walls and lighting), players must now actually see the corpse

Realistic Visibility Checks

    Line of sight check (corpses behind walls are not detected)

    Lighting check (corpses in complete darkness are not noticed)
    
Gradual Detection

    Distant corpses (≥45m) take longer to notice (~1.5s)
    Low consciousness adds up to +3.5s detection delay

Multiplayer Support

    Works correctly for both host and clients

Installation

    Place it in BepInEx/plugins/

Configuration

Currently no configuration file.

Name: ScavShrapnelMod v1.0
Summary: Tired of simple flashes and disappearing smoke? This mod replaces vanilla explosions with hundreds of real, physically simulated fragments that fly through the air, ricochet off metal, embed into walls, and seriously injure anyone caught in the crossfire.
Description:
Shrapnel Overhaul completely transforms the way explosions and gunfights feel in Scav.

Tired of simple flashes and disappearing smoke? This mod replaces vanilla explosions with hundreds of real, physically simulated fragments that fly through the air, ricochet off metal, embed into walls, and seriously injure anyone caught in the crossfire.

Gunfights are equally brutal: bullets kick up massive directional dust clouds, rip chunks out of walls, and create blinding showers of sparks when hitting metal.

Everything is fully synchronized in multiplayer and heavily optimized so your game won't lag, even during massive chain reactions.

💥 Key Features
- Explosions that Matter: Real flying debris (metal, stone, wood) that can hurt players, enemies (spiders), and destroy turrets. Ground mines form an upward cone of death, while dynamite throws heavy, blunt rocks.
- Intense Gunfights (Updated for v1.0!): Bullets transfer kinetic energy through walls. Dust sprays backward from the impact, metal conducts energy creating spark showers, and guns emit a concussive gas blast from the muzzle.
- Dynamic Environments: The mod reacts to the world. Sand flies in the desert, steam hisses in the freezing cold. Hot metal glows in dark caves and sizzles if it lands in water.
- Watch Your Step: Shrapnel stays on the ground. If you step on sharp glass or metal barefoot, you'll bleed. Wear boots to protect yourself!
- Smooth Performance: Built on a custom "Zero-GC" particle engine. Even with thousands of particles on screen, your game won't freeze or drop frames.

🌐 Multiplayer Compatibility
This mod is 100% compatible with the Co-op Multiplayer Mod. Every spark and shard is synced between players using a highly optimized, server-authoritative custom network protocol.
*(Note: It works perfectly in singleplayer too!)*

🛠️ Installation
1. Install BepInEx 5.4.21+ in your game folder.
2. Place ScavShrapnelMod.dll into CasualtiesUnknownDemo/BepInEx/plugins/
3. Launch the game! (A configuration file will generate automatically, allowing you to tweak particle counts, lifetimes, and more).

⌨️ Console Commands
Open the in-game console with `~`.
- `shrapnel_explode dynamite` - Spawns an explosion at your cursor.
- `shrapnel_shot rifle R -metal` - Tests the bullet impact effects.
- `shrapnel_clear` - Destroys all active shrapnel to clean up the map.
- `shrapnel_status` - Shows mod performance and network stats.

P.S: I know that my game screenshots are outdated, and I will try to update them as soon as possible...

Changelogs.Changelog:
True Lighting & Shadows
Universal Language Support (Russian/Localization Fix)
True Multi-Directional Shockwaves
Visible Pressure Waves
Perfect Explosion Symmetry
Performance Optimizations

Built a fully custom, server-authoritative network protocol from scratch. Physics are handled entirely by the host, while clients use advanced parabolic extrapolation and interpolation for buttery smooth visuals. No more "phantom shards" or desync!
Replaced Unity's standard particle instantiation with a custom AshParticlePoolManager and GPU-batched sparks. This completely eliminates Garbage Collection (GC) spikes, ensuring zero micro-stutters even during massive chain explosions.
Mob & Trap Damage: Shrapnel is no longer just for players and blocks! Flying shards will now legitimately damage and kill enemies (spiders), destroy traps (turrets), and trigger explosive barrels.
The "Fake Fall Damage" Fix: Fixed a notorious vanilla bug where broken Grav Bags would trigger a ghost explosion, causing the mod to spawn shrapnel inside the player's torso (resulting in instant, lethal internal bleeding that players mistook for fall damage).
Reduced the default amount of ground debris by 50% based on player feedback, keeping the aftermath of battles looking realistic but less messy.
Completely overhauled the console commands (shrapnel_explode, shrapnel_debris). Arguments are now order-independent and support shorthand flags (like -e for effects-only, -v for verbose, and -net for network diagnostics).

**Fixed invisible shrapnel damage:** Shards that had visually decayed to near-invisible   (≤32% scale, ≤24% alpha) could still deal damage via their active collider. Collider is   now disabled before the shard becomes invisible, and the GameObject is destroyed when   visually depleted (`NormalizedLifetime ≤ 0.02`). Affects both singleplayer and multiplayer.
**Fixed massive chain-destruction bug:** Flying shrapnel would instantly destroy grounded   debris upon touching it, causing 80%+ of shards to disappear prematurely. Debris and   stuck shards now only break from high-velocity impacts with non-shrapnel objects (terrain,   entities). Shrapnel-on-shrapnel contacts are filtered out entirely.
**Fixed integer overflow desync:** Large world coordinates or rotations caused overflow   in packed network fields, sending shards to completely wrong locations on clients.   All packed fields now use `Mathf.Clamp` before cast to `short`.
**Fixed client mirrors vanishing mid-flight:** Destroy messages from the server now   trigger a smooth 150ms shrink-and-fade effect (`BeginFadeDestroy`) instead of instantly   popping the mirror out of existence.
**Fixed "ghost shard" desync (server has shard, client doesn't):** Client-side at-rest   mirrors were self-destructing after 90 seconds (`RestTimeout`) while server shards live   for 300+ seconds (configured debris lifetime). At-rest mirrors now use `_restTimer` vs   `_debrisLifetime`, matching server `ShrapnelProjectile.UpdateDebris` lifetime exactly.
**Fixed "phantom shard" desync (client has shard, server doesn't):** Flying mirrors   orphaned by a lost `MSG_DESTROY` packet now fade out gracefully after 5 seconds without   a server snapshot (`SnapshotStaleTimeout`), down from the previous 30-second hard timeout.
**Fixed at-rest shards spawning with wrong rotation on client:** Spawn message now   includes Z rotation (`RotZ`, ×100 precision). Client mirrors apply server rotation on   creation instead of always spawning at 0°. Flying shards still derive rotation from   velocity after first frame.
**Fixed zero base scale on flying fragments:** `_originalScale` is now set immediately   on `Create` for all mirror states. Previously only set in `ApplyRestState`, causing   flying mirrors and mirrors created as `atRest=true` to have `_originalScale = (0,0,0)`,   making them completely invisible during visual decay and fade-out.
**Fixed misleading network diagnostics:** `States sent` counter was counting packets   instead of individual state transitions, showing `39 sent` vs `154 received` for the   same session. Both sides now count individual transitions.

Real Client-Side Physics
Ricochets Work on Clients
Bandwidth Reduced ~90%
Server REST Correction
All Damage Stays Server-Side

Critical Power Fix: Bullet effects were running at only 5% power in the last update. The game's data stores `shotsPerFire = 0` for single-shot weapons (like the rifle), which accidentally multiplied the entire power formula by zero! This is now fixed: rifles, pistols, and shotguns now unleash their full, glorious kinetic energy, spawning proper fragments and massive spark showers.
Kinetic Energy Transfer: Bullets don't just spark anymore; they transfer momentum *through* blocks
marter Muzzle Blasts: Replaced the old brute-force grid scan with a highly efficient "Column-Scan" algorithm. It now perfectly finds the actual ground, ceilings, and walls around the barrel. Because it's so much faster, the muzzle blast radius has been increased from 8 to 12 blocks (18 for turrets!).
New Developer Tools (Commands)
And a lot fixes of bags & Optimize! Optimize!
For details you can check CHANGELOG.md

Full Scav v6.1 Support
Dynamic Contact Support (No More Floating Shards)
Ballistic Physics & Polish
High-Energy Sparks & Enhanced Visibility
Extreme Performance Tuning

Name: Player sprite replacer

Description:
[size=6][b]Casualties Unknown - Player Sprite Replacer[/b][/size]

A small hobby mod for Casualties Unknown that swaps your character's body and head sprites at runtime using BepInEx. Single-player, numpad-driven.

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Loader: [b]BepInEx 5.4.23.5[/b][/*]
[*]Game version: [b]Casualties Unknown demo v6.1[/b][/*]
[/list]
The game is still in demo — file layouts can change between versions, which may break the mod until it's updated.


[size=5][b]Permissions[/b][/size]

This is a hobby project I made for fun. If the game creator [b]Orsoniks[/b] does not want this mod public, please contact me and I will take it down.


[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]1. Prerequisite[/b][/size]

Install BepInEx 5 if you haven't already — official guide: [url=https://docs.bepinex.dev/articles/user_guide/installation/index.html]https://docs.bepinex.dev/articles/user_guide/installation/index.html[/url]

[size=4][b]2. The mod[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Open the mod archive and look inside
[code]body-sprite-replacer/plugins[/code].[/*]
[*]Copy its contents into your game's
[code]BepInEx/plugins[/code]folder — the same folder used by other mods. You should end up with the Player Sprite Replacer DLL and a
[code]CustomSprites[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Start the game.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Usage[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]In-game, press [b]Numpad 1 through 9[/b] to instantly switch between different character sprites.[/*]
[*]The mod looks for sprites in
[code]CustomSprites/st1[/code]through
[code]CustomSprites/st9[/code].[/*]
[*][b]No numpad?[/b]
[code]st1[/code]is loaded automatically on startup, so drop your preferred skin into
[code]st1[/code]and you're set.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Sprite credits[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][code]st1[/code]— [b]Mottrew[/b] by [b]beebigirl[/b]: [url=https://skin.cat-bot.de/?skinid=163&page=4#skin-163]https://skin.cat-bot.de/?skinid=163&page=4#skin-163[/url][/*]
[*][code]st2[/code]–
[code]st9[/code]— sprite files copied from GitHub user [b]Paili-16[/b]. (I could have extracted them from the game myself but wanted to save time.)[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Making your own sprites[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Back up the
[code]Body[/code]and
[code]Head[/code]folders inside the
[code]st1[/code]–
[code]st9[/code]slot you're going to modify.[/*]
[*]Replace the PNGs with your own art.[/*]
[*][b]Keep the file names exactly the same[/b] — sprites are matched by file name; renaming them breaks replacement.[/*]
[*]Try to match the original image dimensions. I haven't tested what happens when they don't, so YMMV.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Finding sprites[/b][/size]

Places to grab community sprites:

[list]
[*][url=https://skin.cat-bot.de/]https://skin.cat-bot.de/[/url] — note: this mod expects
[code]Body[/code]and
[code]Head[/code]as separate folders, so you'll need to split the downloaded files until I add single-file support.[/*]

[code]sharedassets1.assets[/code]for this mod.[/*]

Name: Custom Structures
Summary: Mod for Casualties: Unknown, adding limitless custom user-generated structures!
Description:
[center][size=6][b]CU-Custom-Structures[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]BepInEx mod for Casualties: Unknown, adding custom user-generated structures
[/b][/size]
[img]https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e5339102-374f-4d4d-904d-f3b21a762686[/img]
[url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CU-Custom-Structures/raw/refs/heads/main/CustomStructures.zip][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-v1.2.1-orange?logo=github[/img] [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/9][img]https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Fjimmyking9999999%2FMetadata-generator%2Fmain%2Fbadges%2Fcustom-structures.json[/img][/url][/center]

[size=5][b]Overview[/b][/size]
A [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx[/url] mod for [url=https://orsonik.itch.io/scav-prototype]Casualties: Unknown[/url] that adds support for custom user-generated structures, including over 130 pre-made structures and a webtool to create and share your own.

[list]
[*]Adds >250 new custom structures to CU[/*]
[*]A tool to implement your own custom structures with any object in-game[/*]
[*]Easy editing and sharing of structures via .txt files on the online webtool[/*]
[/list]

[line]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
Please follow these steps exactly to ensure your mod loads correctly!

[spoiler]
[size=4][b]Installing the Mod Loader (BepInEx)[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download [b]BepInEx v5.4.23.3[/b] (x64) from the official repository: [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases/download/v5.4.23.3/BepInEx_win_x64_5.4.23.3.zip]Download BepInEx_win_x64_5.4.23.3.zip[/url][/*]
[*]Navigate to your [i]Casualties: Unknown[/i] game folder (the folder containing [font=Courier New]CasualtiesUnknown.exe[/font]).[/*]
[*]Extract the contents of the downloaded zip file directly into this folder.[/*]
[*]If prompted, choose to "Replace all files."[/*]
[*]Run the game once to generate the necessary configuration folders, then close the game.[/*]
[*]If you have a [font=Courier New]BepInEx/Plugins[/font] folder, you have done this correctly![/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[spoiler]
[size=4][b]Installing CU-Custom-Structures[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Navigate to your game folder and open the newly created path: [font=Courier New]BepInEx/Plugins[/font].[/*]
[*]Download the mod: [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CU-Custom-Structures/releases/]Download CustomStructures.zip[/url][/*]
[*]Extract the zip file directly into the [font=Courier New]BepInEx/Plugins[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game.[/*]
[/list]
Your filesystem should look as follows:
[code]
CasualtiesUnknownDemo/
└── BepInEx/
└── plugins/
├── CustomStructures.dll
└── Structures/
└── (your .txt structure files go here!)[/code][/spoiler]

[line]
[size=5][b]Webtool[/b][/size]
The structure editor webtool is hosted at [url=https://cu-structure-editor.web.app]cu-structure-editor.web.app[/url]. Create your own custom structures and share the .txt file with the world!
 [img]https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d1b36828-1c37-4237-a98d-10fbc1dd28ac[/img]

[size=4][b]Keybinds[/b][/size]
[list]
- Middle mouse button to pick block & pan- ⁨Shift⁩ to toggle Precision mode. Drag to adjust location. - Shift + Ctrl⁩ to rotate, ⁨Shift + Alt to scale- ⁨Space to toggle foreground/background mode- ⁨Ctrl + C / V⁩ to copy-paste[/list]

[line]
[size=5][b]Downloading Additional Structures[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Visit the [url=https://cu-structure-editor.web.app/structures.html]structures page[/url] and download any structure .txt files you want.[/*]
[*]Move the files into [font=Courier New]BepInEx/Plugins/Structures[/font].[/*]
[*]Reload the game![/*]
[/list][img]https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/da769ece-e5b0-4aba-b919-fe0e2bb4c1a4[/img]

[line]
[size=5][b]Console Commands[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]structure {id}[/font] — spawns a custom structure[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]locatestructure {id}[/font] — locates a custom structure[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]togglemorestructures {true/false}[/font] — enable/disable the mod until the command is run again[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]reloadstructures[/font] — reloads all .txt files and refreshes changes[/*]
[/list]

[img]https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d507e195-c90c-4390-8247-1251e4d11314[/img]
Author: Jimmyking

Changelogs.Changelog: Initial Release. Enjoy the mod!

Console commands support for v503
Added all removed content back
Added new structures to webapp visualizer
Added new items to webapp visualizer
structuremulti console command, to change your global structure amount multiplayer. (I.e. structuremulti 0.5 turns 5 structures/layer to 2 structures, with a 50% chance of 3 structures)
Minor optimizations, I can't do much without a massive overhaul of the structure process. So I guess prebaked regex and better data structure will have to do for now :>
QoL mod seeded support
Update checker for new versions

The editor is now like an actual professional editor, yay! This was heavily inspired by Aseprite, so the keybinds you're familiar with (if you use aseprite) work here
Swapped to a react framework with the Pixi renderer, which allows for seamless movement across hundreds of thousands of tiles.
Added custom properties to multitudes of things.
Want to make a crate only drop a specific item? Sure.
Want to have a 50% chance of spawning a minibarrel with 10000ml of fent and 50% chance of it being full of mold? You can do that.
Want to drop a 1% condition material pouch with 40 1% condition canvases in it? Yeah, sure
You can write your own messages on wall notes
Added lifepod buttons and an ID system. Anything sharing the same ID will be triggered. Doors, turrets, landmines, lifepod showers, lights, etc... ||Sorry, ac will have to wait a bit||
Added background objects, and cheated a bit to add custom new v6 background objects ;)
Lifepod pumps now work, and divert water to the nearest `pipeoutside`
Added layers, we're a real pixel art program here now
Added unlimited custom objects and items
Added a project save viewer, so you don't need to carry .txt files around (still do, though)
You can now update (and soon delete) your own created structures. Woah.
Made the web browser use the pixi renderer, so you can see everything clearly ^^
Updated many sprites to match their iname version
Added a new level save format (~saving 44% space despite all the new features)

Added an in-game structure browser
Readded 5 missing objects
Lag fixes (!)
Fixes for item pool condition precents
Webapp QoL
Fix climbing ropes
Add no overlap flag
Per-structure spawn multipliers
Rendering fixes (for the webapp, for the sake of optimization the in-game browser is still not great)

Mod now fully works in multiplayer. This is a server-side mod, and all clients must also have the mod for full functionality. It works if only the host has it, but only tiles and other objects will sync
Said multiplayer functionality includes synced worldgen, synced doors, backgrounds, props/decor, structure console commands, and other fun id toggles
Fixed many issues and bugs in-game
Fixed that one super annoying click-through-ui-bug
Large reworks to allow for something special in the future ;)
The webapp has a voting system. There is limited anti-abuse measures, but I'm keeping an eye on it and it's prone to just getting removed if that happens. I trust all of you :sweat_smile:
Large-scale structures are a lot more optimized, layer/worldgen update *soon*
Discord embeds! Yay!
Many small changes that will now be listed rapidfire: better infinite scroll, first-time mod download support, load optimizations, backend changes, ctrl + f, structure browser screen effect fix, better qol integration, better in-game browser, zipped mass-downloads, mod size compression

V7 compatibility!
Added magma, new items, new crystal enemy/food
I will probably not add said crystal effects for the time being
All entity objects now have a health you can set
Updated to fix v7 UI clickthrough bugs
New filters for the structure browser
Fixed ultra-wide resolution scaling
Updated names and added automatic mapping, so old structure work without manual adjustment

[size=5][b]Overview[/b][/size]
This mod is a general quality of life mod for [url=https://orsonik.itch.io/scav-prototype]Casualties: Unknown[/url], meant to introduce accessibility and QoL features without changing the core mechanics of the game.

This mod works alongside mosother public mods!
[line]
[size=5][b]
Features[/b][/size]

[spoiler]
[b]UI, UX, Visuals[/b]
[list]
[*]Automatic integrated Discord Rich Presence game support[/*]
[*]Adjustable luminosity and bloom settings[/*]
[*]Adjustable screen effect intensity[/*]
[*]Anti-flash/epilepsy toggle[/*]
[*]Added up/down arrow navigation to select different choices for autofill in the console, as well as other console improvements[/*]
[*]Console spawn command now autofills and has a visual guide[/*]
[*]Enhanced the crafting menu item preview, with autocraft and multi-craft additions[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/21be03c0-8182-4666-a6ba-eb4b0c6f29b9[/img][/spoiler]

[spoiler]
[b]Inventory[/b]
[list]
[*]Quick-transfer for liquids and items via [b]Shift + Drag[/b][/*]
[*]Inventory auto-sort, prioritizing saved slots at low total weight, and lowest weight otherwise[/*]
[*]Scroll bars for containers that go offscreen[/*]
[*]Quick item pickup using middle-mouse button[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3898e7f5-5c83-4aae-80cd-b4eab6437833[/img][/spoiler]

[list]
[*]Mid-layer saves that retain world generation, traps, enemies, etc...[/*]
[*]1-tile water no longer pushes the player, and water physics is more lenient[/*]
[*]Seeded runs for consistent worlds. (This syncs worlds down to the same keycode and items from drop pods!)[/*]
[*]Layer modifiers are able to be adjusted individually (e.g., enabling only dried layers)[/*]
[*]Difficulty sliders are no longer restricted[/*]
[*]Sound cannon indicator[/*]
[*]Extra settings to retain several v6 behaviour[/*]

[img]https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/77c1b3b8-9edf-4496-80b6-30b3c9902a4c[/img][/spoiler]

[list]
[*]In-game options menu[/*]

[list]
[*]Migrating from a non-modded run to a modded run works normally! (and vice versa)[/*]

[/list][b]Does this support multiplayer?
[/b]
[list]
[*][list]
v1.0.4.1 and above support multiplayer! Yay! Not all players need the mod for it to work, and it functions independantly.[/list][/*]
[/list]

Name: Cursor Character Drag (OUTDATED)
Summary: Allows you to drag your character around with a cursor like a puppet
Description:
[b]WARNING: The mod is not compatible with the newest version of the game![/b]

I probably should have written this earlier, but yeah, the newest version broke the mod completely. The short answer to why is that this mod has a ManagerObject dependency at its core, and this dependency breaks it in the newest version of the game. I tried to make a completely new mod from scratch that wouldn't require ManagerObject dependency, but I failed each time. So yeah, there's a good chance that this mod will not be coming back for a good while. I will try again when the game updates a bunch, in hope to find some solution to implement a cursor drag mechanic again.

As it stands now, Cursor Character Drag is only compatible with the [b]V5 pre-testing 5[/b] version of the game. Sorry, everyone!

How to install it:
Install BepInEx in the game's executable folder.
Navigate to the folder: BepInEx > plugins, and extract SandboxDragMode.dll there.

How to use it:
You can enable and disable SandboxDragMode by pressing F1 in-game (activation is only visible in console ~, there's no UI to indicate that the mode is active).
When SandboxDragMode is active, your attack is disabled, and you can drag your character around with your mouse however you like.
When SandboxDragMode is disabled, you can attack again.

If you encounter any issues, it's very likely that I won't be able to fix them.

If some actual coder wants to take my mod, improve it and reupload it, go ahead, don't even ask for my permission. Consider this piece of code a public domain.
